title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Mexico.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

Accountabilities

  • IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications.
  • Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations.
  • Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary.
  • IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage.
  • Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones.
  • Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous.
  • Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your area of work, manage your tasks independently, and contribute directly to operational improvements.
  • Professional Development: Build practical cybersecurity experience through hands-on projects involving vulnerability research, endpoint hardening, incident response, and compliance.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and progress into a broader role as the team grows.
  • Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET).
  • Practical Security Experience: Develop your technical capabilities while working across IT administration, endpoint management, automation, and security operations.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

title: Assistant Video Editor (Part-time)
company: Old Republic National Title Insurance Company
description:
WESTERN TITLE DIVISION

Job Description:

The Assistant Editor supports Video Editors and Producers in creating polished, professional video content for social media and digital marketing campaigns. This role combines hands-on editing with post-production support, including organizing footage, preparing graphics, refining audio, adding captions, and delivering finished content.

The ideal candidate has strong technical editing skills, an eye for visual storytelling, and the ability to turn raw footage into engaging, brand-consistent videos. Attention to detail, collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple projects and incorporate feedback are essential.


This is a part-time (20 hours/week) remote position but will require some travel to locations in Oregon and Washington (additional other western states as needed).


Required Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, including timeline editing, media management, audio synchronization, basic color correction, and export settings.
  • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, including motion graphics, text animation, and working with existing templates.
  • Working knowledge of Canva and the ability to use established brand templates.
  • Demonstrated experience creating professional social media videos with clear storytelling, intentional pacing, clean graphics, and consistent audio.
  • Understanding of platform-specific video formats, aspect ratios, captions, and placement of text within safe viewing areas.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow creative direction, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines across multiple projects.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively.
  • Travel as needed to film on location, including setting up and operating camera, lighting, and audio equipment.

Portfolio Requirement

Please submit a portfolio or links to video samples demonstrating your editing, motion graphics, and social media production skills. Include a brief description of your contribution to each example.


Benefits may include:

  • Comprehensive medical, prescriptions, dental and vision plans

  • 401(k) plan with a discretionary company match

  • Shareholder Purchase and Reinvestment Plan

  • Basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance premium paid by the company

  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance for employees, spouses and dependent children

  • Fertility and Family Building Benefits

  • Paid Disability benefits

  • Paid time off programs

  • 11 Company paid holidays per year

  • Flexible spending account

  • Health savings account (available to High Deductible Health Plan participants only)

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Educational Assistance Program

  • Voluntary benefits, such as Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Accident Insurance

  • Title insurance policies and certain escrow services for the employee’s primary personal residence at no charge

  • Transportation benefit plan for mass transit, parking and vanpool, in several markets

title: Pit Party Manager
description:
Advances and executes Pit Parties for premier live motor sports events “Monster Jam”. Works with event personnel, performers, vendors and sponsors in all aspects of the event including pre-planning, load in/out and event execution. Must be highly motivated and organized; attention to detail is a must. Experience with live events/festivals is preferred.

Essential Functions

  • Advances all operational aspects of the Pit Party from advance planning, load in/out process, and the Pit Party itself.
  • Work with venue staff to ensure all company needs and requests are met in order to produce the highest quality of entertainment.
  • Coordinate and arrange travel and transportation for all operations pit party event staff to and from the events as needed.
  • Coordinate with onsite management staff in advance to ensure all department needs are met.
  • Collects and disseminates information that pertain to show personnel, event information, accommodations, transportation, medical as it relates to Workers Comp and Insurance claims.
  • Responsible for calling various types of vendors to secure items needed to produce the events. This will include some cold calls and negotiating in order to find the best deal possible.
  • Prepare agreements and have them approved by supervisor. Then follow up and see to it that all points of the agreements are met by both parties involved.
  • Responsible for own professional standards of conduct, appearance, and work performance.
  • Manage all MJ Pit Party Operations trailers to include inventory, clean out’s, loads/unloads and routing as needed.
  • Work with Pit Party Director to create all Pit Party maps as well as fencing and tent overlays for both Live Event and Pit Party.
  • Assist Pit Party Director in coordination of part-time Pit Party Coordinators to include weekly replenishments, organization of post-event information/photos, Smartsheet management and organization and Pit Party map updates/changes.
  • Full-time Pit Party Manager available for special events, international events, pre-trips, etc. as needs arise.
  • Work with Global Partnerships on standardized activation processes and procedures and activation implementation.
  • Assist Pit Party Director in annual Pit Party Coordinator training by coming up with new and exciting ways to distribute information and keep employees engaged.
  • Assist MJ Operations with the advance planning, set up and execution of the bi-annual MJ Training Summit.
  • Assist Pit Party Director in yearly budget and Cap-Ex planning as well as 3–5-year creative planning.
  • All other job-related duties as assigned by supervisor.

Qualifications

  • Associate degree (A.A.) or three+ years related experience or equivalent combination of training, education, and/or experience.
  • A thorough understanding of festivals/outdoor events/live events preferred.
  • Experience working with and managing large groups/events.
  • Highly developed organizational, research, business negotiation, communication, financial and time management skills.
  • Must possess strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Must possess a Valid driver’s license and Passport.

Skills & Abilities

  • The ability to read and interpret documents, such as contracts, track maps, operating/maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, safety manuals, and hiring guidelines. The ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • The ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral and/or diagram form, and the ability to solve practical problems and interpret diverse instructions in a variety of forms.
  • The ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals, and to be able to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
  • Ability to communicate across various organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with computer networking and MS Office programs such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with AutoCAD preferred.
  • Able and willing to work irregular hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • The ability and willingness to travel internationally and domestically 70% of the time.
  • The ability to sit and stand for long periods of time, climb stairs, lift 50 pounds and walk long distances.

About Feld Entertainment
Feld Entertainment®, family owned and operated, is the worldwide leader in producing and presenting live touring family entertainment experiences that bring people together and uplift the human spirit. Properties include Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey®, Monster Jam®, Disney On Ice, Monster Energy AMA Supercross, and the SuperMotocross World Championship. Across the brand portfolio, Feld Entertainment has entertained millions of families in more than 80 countries and on six continents. Visit for more information.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Feld Entertainment is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug Free Workplace. We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for our employees, customers, and partners worldwide. We celebrate diversity and encourage our profoundly talented workforce to express themselves proudly. Our successful business model requires different perspectives and voices so that we can create the incredible live shows we put on. Come join us and help us light up the world.

title: 2nd Shift Team Leader - Production
description:
Join Litehouse as a Team Leader in Production/Manufacturing!


Location: [Lowell]
Shift: [3pm - 11:30pm]
Starting Pay:$22.59/hr
Additional Pay: 2nd shift is $1.50/hr, 3rd/D/C Shift is $3/hr

Are you a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, team-focused environment? Litehouse Foods is seeking a full-time Team Leader to join our growing manufacturing team! In this role, you'll lead your crew to success by improving performance across safety, quality, training, and production-while supporting our mission of community, ownership, and excellence.


About Litehouse Foods

Litehouse started in the Hope, Idaho restaurant of the Hawkins family 60 years ago. Since that time, we have become the leader in refrigerated salad dressings, dips, sauces, herbs, and cheese, manufacturing these delicious products at our four U.S. facilities based in Michigan, Utah, Virginia, and Idaho. Litehouse offers its diverse portfolio of products through general retail, e-commerce, foodservice, deli, member stores, and value-added goods where Litehouse products are featured in meal and salad kits. We keep a strong commitment to our employees and the communities in which we operate.

Great People Deserve Great Benefits!

  • 401(k) + 401(k) Matching
  • Dental, Health, Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off + Additional Personal Day
  • Biweekly pay
  • 8 Paid Holidays
  • Paid sick time after 6 months
  • Shift Differentials
  • Career advancement opportunities and recognition programs

What You'll Do:

  • Coach team members on safety awareness and personal responsibility

  • Address and resolve unsafe conditions promptly

  • Support employee growth by communicating training needs and plans

  • Facilitate strong communication between shifts and departments

  • Oversee and verify production records (HACCP, sanitation checklists, etc.)

  • Lead setups, changeovers, and ensure production runs within operating standards

  • Conduct root cause analyses for issues and help implement solutions

  • Maintain accurate documentation and provide timely coaching on errors

  • Promote a positive, supportive training experience for new hires

  • Perform other duties as needed to support the department

What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED strongly preferred

  • 1–3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment

  • Solid understanding of manufacturing equipment and work processes

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills

  • Ability to work independently and lead by example in a fast-paced setting

Apply today to grow your career with Litehouse Foods and lead a team that's passionate about quality, collaboration, and community.

We do not offer sponsorship

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Healthcare Construction Planner
description:
SJS Executives, LLC (SJS), also doing business as SJS Industrial, is currently seeking a talented Healthcare Construction Planner that will support ongoing construction operations within a local VA healthcare facility.

SJS is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with 150 employees coast to coast and a headquarters in Virginia Beach, Virginia; it specializes in professional services to support federal and military organizations.

The pay for this position will be $38.94/hr. The benefits included in this position are: 11 paid federal holidays per year, 80 hours of annual accrued PTO, and medical, health, dental, life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, and critical illness.

Qualified Candidates will be contacted via text. Do not call.

This person will enjoy collaborating with a team and know how to conduct themselves with decorum, as they will be working on a property owned by the United States federal government and interacting with federal government employees and service members.

Responsibilities

  • Assist VA staff with the preparation and ongoing maintenance of the Project Management Plan, Construction Management Plan, and Risk Management Plan.
  • Provide mini master planning services for specific functional areas, clinical service lines, and campus buildings.
  • Develop space planning documents, layouts, equipment lists, and project cost estimates.
  • Use AutoCAD and/or Revit to develop project programming documents.
  • Participate in Project Development Integrated Process Teams (IPTs).
  • Facilitate the development of technical documents required for procurement packages.
  • Conduct existing conditions assessments and space utilization analyses to support planning efforts.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff, facility leadership, engineering, and project stakeholders to define space and functional requirements.
  • Prepare architectural programming documents in accordance with VA design criteria, federal standards, and applicable healthcare planning guidelines.
  • Evaluate facility operations and workflows to support efficient space utilization and patient care delivery.
  • Review design documents for compliance with approved programming requirements and project objectives.
  • Assist in developing phased occupancy and decanting plans to support renovations while maintaining ongoing clinical operations.
  • Support capital planning initiatives by identifying facility deficiencies, future space needs, and infrastructure requirements.
  • Participate in project meetings, site visits, and design reviews, documenting planning decisions and action items.
  • Coordinate planning activities with architects, engineers, consultants, and government stakeholders throughout project development.
  • Maintain planning documentation, databases, and project records in accordance with VA policies and contract requirements.

Qualifications

  • In accordance with federal regulations, possession of a valid Real ID is a requirement for this position.
  • US Citizenship is Required.
  • AutoCAD and/or Revit experience is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Preferred.
  • In lieu of a qualifying degree, an additional six (6) years of relevant planning experience may be substituted.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in healthcare planning, Preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with healthcare or clinical environments, procurement processes, and contract support services.
  • Must be able to successfully pass a drug test and a thorough background check for access onto a military installation; please note the background check for this position extends past 7 years, in conformance with federal law and US Department of Justice guidelines for work on a military installation.

SJS Executives, LLC (SJS), also doing business as SJS Industrial, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy status and/or gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, parental status, military service or other non-merit factors.

title: BHS Technician II
description:
JSM Airport Services is seeking a highly motivated BHS Technician II at Boston Logan International Airport (BOS). This is a career-track opportunity, and we are looking for an individual ready to commit to a long-term professional future with our company, starting with an expected commitment of one year or more. The primary function of this position is to provide electro-mechanical operational, preventative, and emergency maintenance support.

Compensation:

  • Full-Time
  • Weekly Pay
  • Hourly Rate: Starting at $25.00 (Depending on Experience)

Work Schedule:

Must be able to work as scheduled (this is a 24-hour, seven-day-a-week operation). Holidays will be included if they fall on a scheduled workday. Shift assignments are based on the airport and company requirements, as well as a technician's strengths, skill set, and experience. Our technicians are expected to be flexible in terms of prospective shift assignments.

Benefits and Perks You’ll Appreciate:

  • Ongoing career development and training opportunities
  • Collaborate with a team in a dynamic environment
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Wellness Program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Retirement Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Education and Tuition Assistance Program
  • Employee Discounts
  • Uniform/Footwear Program

Job Responsibilities:

  • Work with a variety of tools/hand tools safely and properly, as well as utilize any/all appropriate safety and personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Perform basic preventative maintenance tasks, which will include, but not be limited to, cleaning of conveyor and surrounding areas, removal of debris from between conveyors, removal and replacement of conveyor cover for inspection and cleaning, and the recognition of potential issues through audio and visual inspection
  • Diagnosing equipment failures under the guidance of senior staff
  • Make minor adjustments to ensure system functionality and reliability pertaining to both electrical and mechanical items
  • Clear and reset baggage handling system jams in a safe and efficient manner
  • Take temperature and speed readings of components and belting
  • Perform full replacement and adjustment of components, including but not limited to: bearings, motors, reducers, belts (replacement and repair), belts (tensioning and tracking), photoelectric cells, and pushbuttons
  • Perform repair and troubleshooting of electrical components (MCP’s, local functional electrical switch boxes, VFD’s, ATR’s, belt shaft encoders, general wiring)
  • Work safely in a variety of locations that may include moving equipment and electricity, as well as small spaces, high spaces, dirty spaces, and/or hot spaces
  • Attend requested/required training, demonstrating a willingness to learn
  • Follow and comply with any company and/or federally established policies and procedures
  • Safety and compliance training as required
  • Perform other reasonable ancillary duties to support the operation and our customer
Qualifications:
  • Education: High School Graduate or General Education Degree (GED)
  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Must be able to read and interpret repair manuals and basic mechanical schematics
  • Must have at least three (3) years of mechanical work experience
  • Must have at least one (1) year of basic electrical and/or electronic systems work experience
  • Must be able to undergo a 10-year background check and be able to obtain/maintain security clearance
  • Must possess a valid drivers' license (with a clean driving record)
  • Must be able to work independently

Physical Requirements:

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing all day
  • Frequently lifting/moving items that may range in weight up-to 50 pounds, occasionally up-to 100 pounds
  • Work safely in a variety of locations that may include moving equipment and electricity, as well as small spaces, high spaces, dirty spaces, and hot spaces
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Be aware of moving equipment, as well as areas where electricity is present

Additional Requirements:

The applicant must be able to successfully pass a drug screen (we promote/maintain a Drug Free Workplace), a driver's license check, a background check, and required federal fingerprinting, security threat assessment, as well as airport security badging, for continued employment.

At JSM, we recognize that Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Good for Business.

Our goal is to attract good job candidates, retain our best employees, and create a more engaged and productive workforce. We want all our team members to feel safe, valued, respected, and involved in their roles at JSM. Together, we unite for diversity and inclusion. JSM is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status, and will not discriminate against anyone based on a disability. title: Distribution Associate
description:
Job Description

About Company:

PBD Worldwide is a full-service third-party logistics and fulfillment company helping growing businesses simplify e-commerce fulfillment, B2B and retail distribution, warehousing, and shipping. Since 1976, we have combined efficient operations, integrated technology, and strong carrier partnerships to help our clients ship faster and scale with confidence. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, PBD Worldwide offers a collaborative environment where accuracy, service, teamwork, and continuous improvement are valued

About the Role:

The Distribution Associate plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient and accurate handling of products within the supply chain. This position is responsible for managing the receipt, storage, and distribution of goods to meet customer demands and maintain inventory accuracy. The role requires close collaboration with warehouse teams, logistics partners, and inventory management systems to optimize workflow and minimize errors. The Distribution Associate contributes to maintaining a safe and organized work environment while adhering to company policies and regulatory standards. Ultimately, this position supports the seamless movement of products from suppliers to customers, directly impacting overall operational success and customer satisfaction.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic experience in warehouse or distribution operations.
  • Ability to lift and move heavy objects up to 50 pounds regularly.
  • Familiarity with inventory management systems or willingness to learn.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience operating forklifts or other warehouse machinery with valid certification.
  • Experience with barcode scanning technology and warehouse management software.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and best practices in warehouse environments.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and logistics partners.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends or overtime, as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, and verify incoming shipments against purchase orders and packing lists.
  • Organize and store products in designated warehouse locations to ensure easy retrieval and inventory accuracy.
  • Pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment according to company standards and customer specifications.
  • Operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and barcode scanners safely and efficiently.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and data entry into inventory management systems.
  • Coordinate with logistics and transportation teams to schedule and track outbound shipments.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized work environment to prevent accidents and product damage.
  • Assist in identifying process improvements to enhance distribution efficiency and reduce errors.

Skills:

The Distribution Associate utilizes organizational and detail-oriented skills daily to ensure accurate inventory management and order fulfillment. Physical stamina and safe equipment operation skills are essential for handling and moving products efficiently within the warehouse. Communication skills facilitate effective coordination with team members and external partners to maintain smooth distribution processes. Familiarity with inventory software and barcode scanning technology supports accurate data entry and real-time tracking of goods. Problem-solving abilities help identify and implement improvements in workflow and safety, contributing to overall operational excellence.

title: Senior Technical Solutions Consultant, Auto Partner Engineering (Korean, English, Chinese)
description:
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.

You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

The Android Partner Engineering team engages with the industry to maximize Android Auto adoption and shape the Android Automotive platform and Google Automotive Services. Our mission is to deliver "a safe and seamless connected experience in every car."

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will manage projects with leading automotive players integrating Android Auto and Digital Car Key into next-generation vehicles. Leveraging your expertise in head units, in-vehicle software, keyless entry architectures, and BLE/UWB/NFC protocols, you will act as a trusted advisor to Google engineering and industry partners.

You will guide the planning, implementation, and certification of these systems, solving problems at scale to make a lasting impact across the automotive industry.

description:
Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for an IT System Investigation Coordinator to support the VA ESOM contract. The System Administrator, Senioris responsible for coordinating and driving Problem Management investigations from initiation through completion. Working as part of a cross-functional Problem investigation team, this role brings together the people, information, and activities necessary to understand complex Problems, identify contributing factors and impacts, develop appropriate corrective actions, and maintain progress toward resolution.

The IT System Investigation Coordinator works closely with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), Problem Records Analysts, product and support teams, and other subject matter experts. While the role does not serve as the primary technical investigator, it requires sufficient technical understanding to effectively facilitate investigations, identify information gaps, ask meaningful questions, and connect technical findings with business, operational, and user impacts.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $71,000–$80,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.


Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and drive day-to-day Problem and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigation activities across technical, product, support, and business stakeholders.

  • Develop and coordinate process, operational, and business-oriented recommendations and corrective actions that complement technical remediation identified through the investigation.
  • Work with Problem Records Analysts to ensure investigation findings, impacts, decisions, recommendations, and corrective actions are accurately represented in RCA and Problem documentation.
  • Review investigation outputs to identify missing context, inconsistencies, or areas requiring clarification prior to completion.
  • Identify relationships among incidents, active Problems, known errors, recurring conditions, and other relevant information that may indicate broader or systemic issues.
  • Track corrective actions, ownership, dependencies, and investigation progress and escalate barriers or unresolved needs as appropriate.
  • Coordinate multiple concurrent Problem investigations while maintaining appropriate organization, stakeholder engagement, and momentum.
  • Use approved AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support research, information synthesis, pattern identification, and investigation coordination while independently reviewing and validating outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, electronics engineering or other engineering or technical discipline OR 8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education
  • 5 years of relevant experience

  • Experience in conducting standard IT system administration activities and recording meaningful data in systems of record or ITSM tools

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to organize and drive complex work across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Strong critical-thinking and information-gathering skills, including the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and unanswered questions and determine appropriate follow-up.
  • Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business processes, systems, and technical concepts sufficiently to facilitate effective investigation.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers, technical SMEs, product teams, operational teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to synthesize information from multiple sources and maintain a clear understanding of investigation status, findings, outstanding needs, and next steps.
  • Ability to understand and articulate the business, operational, service, and user impacts associated with technical Problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate complex discussions and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple investigations, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to maintain follow-through, appropriately challenge incomplete information, and escalate barriers when necessary.
  • Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM), Problem Management, incident management, Root Cause Analysis, or similar investigative environments is preferred.

title: Senior Director, Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PV)
description:
About Artiva:

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies. Our mission is to develop effective, safe, and accessible cell therapies for patients with devastating autoimmune diseases. We aim to develop therapies that patients and physicians can utilize in a community setting. Our lead product candidate,AlloNK®, is a non-genetically modified, cryopreserved NK cell therapy being evaluated in combination with B-cell targeted monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). We believe the compelling cell killing properties of NK cells, when combined with mAbs for targeting, creates an opportunity to generate potentially transformative therapies.

For more information, visit .

Job Summary:

The Senior Director, Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PV) is responsible for leading, building, and managing Safety and PV activities across all clinical programs at Artiva, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and internal standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee global Safety and PV activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and guidances.
  • Oversee adverse event case processing (ICSRs) and aggregate reporting (DSUR) to ensure high-quality safety reports are submitted within required timelines to regulatory agencies and external stakeholders.
  • Lead the preparation and review of safety-related sections for clinical and regulatory documents.
  • Partner with Clinical Leads and Medical Monitors for medical review and reporting of individual adverse events and reactions, ensuring appropriate assessment of case seriousness, causality, expectedness, medical coding, and case follow-ups.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with internal departments and external partners on Safety and PV related issues.
  • Develop and update drug safety forms and templates, ensuring harmonization with clinical operation functions during study start-up and conduct of clinical studies.
  • Manage Safety and PV vendor relationships, execution of responsibilities, and ensuring compliance with safety data processing and submission activities.
  • Ensure effective serious adverse event (SAE) reconciliation between clinical and safety databases.
  • Develop and implement Safety and PV process improvements, tools, systems, and procedures.
  • Provide input into responses to regulatory inquiries and safety issues.
  • Contribute to the development and updates of safety documents, including core data sheets, investigator brochures, labels, and RMPs as required.
  • Participate in regulatory inspections and internal audits and author responses to findings.
  • Maintain close interactions and oversee the assessment and performance of assigned personnel, fostering an environment of professional development.
  • Able to work cross-functionally with other development and functional areas in the organization.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of Drug Safety and PV experience in a biopharma or biotech organization.
  • A health care professional background (e.g., MD, RN, BSN, PharmD, Physician Assistant) is required.
  • Strong understanding of global Safety and PV regulations, including EU and US regulations and ICH guidelines.
  • Excellent understanding of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices, GCP, clinical trial methodology, and medical terminology.
  • Proficiency with safety databases (e.g. Argus), regulatory regulations, and MedDRA coding.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management and problem-solving abilities.
  • Attention to detail and quality-focused approach.
  • Proven ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated initiative and flexibility through effective, innovative leadership.
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to operate in a global, culturally diverse environment
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team setting.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

Why you should apply:

We have a fantastic team and philosophy! We are passionate – We deeply care about our team, our science, and improving the lives of autoimmune and cancer patients. We are tenacious – we are laser-focused on our mission and undeterred in our commitment to make cell therapies broadly accessible to patients with autoimmune disease. We are innovative - pushing into new frontiers for patient benefit. We are transparent - believers in flat, accessible, and open communication paths. We are inclusive – committed to the diversity of our team and ensuring that all voices are heard.

In addition to a great culture, we offer:

· A beautiful facility

· An entrepreneurial, highly collaborative, and innovative environment

· Comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Long Term Disability (LTD)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Company paid holidays, including the year-end holiday week
  • Our recognition program, Bonus.ly, is where you can trade in points earned for things you want.

If all this speaks to you, come join us on our journey!

title: Associate, Corporate Development
description:
The opportunity ahead
This is a critical, high-impact role at the center of Spotnana's business. Reporting directly to the Chief Corporate Development Officer, you will lead diligence workstreams, drive integration planning and execution, and support the evaluation of new opportunities. You'll work regularly with Spotnana's C-suite and partner with leaders across every function of the business. As an early member of the Corporate Development team, you'll also help build the playbooks, tools, and processes that define how Spotnana does M&A and critical partnerships.

How you'll help us build
We expect diligence and integration to make up roughly 60-70% of the role, with deal evaluation and execution making up the remaining 30-40%.

Diligence
  • Plan and manage diligence processes end to end, including scoping workstreams, coordinating internal functional leads, and managing external advisors such as banking, accounting, legal, and consulting firms.
  • Pressure-test diligence findings and turn them into clear implications for valuation, deal structure, and integration planning.
  • Manage data room reviews, track open issues, and prepare diligence summaries for senior leadership.

Integration planning and execution
  • Help run integration management offices (IMOs) for acquisitions, including workstream planning, governance cadence, and progress reporting.
  • Drive Day 1 readiness and post-merger integration across functions such as finance, HR, IT, product, engineering, and commercial teams.
  • Build and maintain synergy tracking, measuring realized value against the deal model and flagging risks early.
  • Manage transition services agreements (TSAs) and other post-close commitments.

Deal evaluation and execution
  • Build and own financial models for potential acquisitions, including valuation, synergy analysis, and accretion/dilution.
  • Research and screen potential targets in support of our acquisition strategy.
  • Prepare investment materials and recommendations for the C-suite and Board.

Building the M&A function
  • Develop repeatable tools and templates, including diligence checklists, integration playbooks, and model templates, so that transactions of different sizes can be run efficiently.

Experience you bring
  • 2–4 years of experience in strategy or operations consulting, investment banking, or transaction advisory, with direct involvement in M&A transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience running workstreams or projects with multiple stakeholders, ideally including diligence or post-merger integration.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including the ability to build a transaction model from scratch.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including experience preparing materials for senior executives.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to drive work forward without direct authority over the people involved.
  • Willingness to travel as needed during active diligence and integration.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field.

Nice to have
  • Experience on the buy side or on integration projects, as opposed to only sell-side or strategy work.
  • Exposure to travel, travel technology, or B2B software.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks, or repeatable processes.
  • MBA or relevant professional certification (e.g., CFA, CPA), though not required.

Let’s talk compensation
Spotnana strives to offer fair, industry-competitive, and equitable compensation. Our total compensation package includes base salary, an annual performance bonus, company equity, and comprehensive benefits. We use trusted third-party market data to establish compensation ranges that are competitive for the role, industry, company size, and geographic market, while maintaining internal equity across our team.

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. The anticipated annual base salary hiring ranges for this role are:

  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability effective on your hire date. We cover 100% of your employee premiums and 85% of your eligible dependents

title: Admissions Representative
description:
Overview:

Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary is a multidenominational, evangelical graduate school committed to equipping Christian leaders to think theologically, engage globally, and live biblically. With nearly 1,400 students across campuses in Massachusetts, North Carolina, Florida, and online, Gordon-Conwell’s student body represents more than eighty-five denominations and fifty countries. The seminary offers master’s and doctoral programs—delivered in English, Spanish, and Portuguese—that combine academic excellence, spiritual formation, and a deep commitment to Scripture. Its 12,000 alumni serve Christ through ministry in the church, the academy, and the workplace. Gordon-Conwell is accredited by the Association of Theological Schools, the New England Commission of Higher Education, and the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs.


Position Summary:

The Admissions Representative serves as the primary point of contact for prospective students from initial inquiry through matriculation, guiding applicants through the admissions process by managing leads, qualifying prospective students, providing program and financial aid information, and ensuring the accurate and efficient processing of application materials and student records. This role is responsible for maintaining regular communication with prospective students, delivering exceptional customer service, and supporting students throughout their enrollment journey. This role also represents the institution at recruitment events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build awareness and generate prospective student interest. As a collaborative member of the Admissions team, this individual works closely with colleagues to troubleshoot issues, improve processes, and contribute to enrollment goals. Success in this role requires strong interpersonal skills, initiative, attention to detail, and the ability to build meaningful relationships while effectively managing a dynamic admissions pipeline.


Key Responsibilities:

Admissions Recruiting and Application Processing (60%)

• Manage and respond to prospective student inquiries through phone, email, text, virtual meetings, and other communication channels.

• Serve as the primary admissions counselor for assigned prospects throughout the enrollment journey.

• Provide accurate information regarding degree programs, certificate programs, admissions requirements, scholarships, tuition, and financial aid opportunities.

• Qualify prospective students by assessing academic background, prior educational experience, GPA, transfer credit eligibility, career goals, and program fit.

• Evaluate prospective students against institutional admissions requirements and recommend next steps.

• Guide students through the application process, ensuring completion of all required materials.

• Maintain regular communication with applicants to encourage progression through the admissions funnel and reduce application attrition.

• Track and manage admissions activities within the seminary’s CRM and student information systems.

• Monitor applicant status and proactively communicate needed actions and deadlines.

• Collaborate with the Director of Admissions, the Review Committee and other institutional stakeholders as necessary during the admissions process.

• Facilitate timely connections with Student Financial Services regarding payment options, financial aid, scholarships, and funding plans.

• Coordinate with Student Success, Registration, and other student support offices to ensure a smooth transition from admission to enrollment.

• Maintain accurate records of student interactions, enrollment outcomes, and admissions activity.


Recruitment Events and Travel (40%)

• Represent the institution at recruitment events, conferences, college fairs, church gatherings, community events, and other outreach opportunities.

• Effectively communicate the institution's mission, educational offerings, and student experience.

• Develop and maintain relationships with churches, organizations, educational institutions, and community partners within assigned territories.

• Assist with planning, coordinating, and executing recruitment and visitation events, including virtual and in-person Explore Seminary.

• Support recruitment initiatives on campus and at extension locations.

• Regular air and car travel to Admissions events throughout the United States


Key Competencies

· Travel Requirements: Regular domestic air and ground travel. Attendance at evening and weekend requirement events. Ability to travel regionally and nationally to represent GCTS at recruitment events. Valid driver’s license and ability to travel independently.

· Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities in short-term and long-term objectives.

· Knowledge and Discernment: Good character, flexibility, discretion, confidentiality, and theological awareness have meticulous attention to detail. Understanding of the academic, personal and spiritual capabilities required for theological training

· Cultural Intelligence: Commitment to collegiality, diversity, inclusion, and cultural awareness. Demonstrated ability to collaborate and serve in a team environment that requires collegiality and regular collaboration across matrixed, multi-campus environment.

· Communication and Interpersonal Effectiveness: Exceptional interpersonal abilities manifested in a confident, warm, outgoing manner. Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to collaborate and serve in a team environment that requires collegiality and regular collaboration across multiple locations and modalities.

· Technical Knowledge: Basic CRM database skills and the ability to leverage technology is required. Required competency with Microsoft Office. The ability to use web conferencing software (e.g., Zoom) preferred.

title: Director, AI Product Strategy & Growth
description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

About the Role

We're hiring an AI Product transformation leader, to own strategy, roadmap, and business impact across a portfolio of AI-enabled products for an enterprise AI program. This is a multi-product leadership role: you own the roadmap and experimentation agenda for each product in the portfolio, and you're accountable for whether it drives measurable adoption and value, while reporting outcomes directly to senior executives and client stakeholders on that impact. This role will lead “executive level” program governance, stakeholder engagement, and ROI oversight for active engagement.

Responsibilities

Product & Program Ownership

•Own strategy and roadmap across the AI product portfolio, prioritized against market opportunity and current penetration by product, channel, and segment.

•Partner with engineering and AI/ML teams to translate strategy into shipped capability across products, while retaining accountability for outcomes.

Executive Communication & Governance

•Own the (bi)weekly/monthly executive governance cadence across the portfolio: prepare and defend performance, roadmap decisions, and investment tradeoffs under direct questioning.

•Build and maintain the standing reporting structure senior leadership uses to evaluate the program and for C-Level Steer-Co meetings.

Growth Strategy & Business Impact

•Drive the product-led growth motion for each product: activation, adoption, expansion.

•Design and run experiments, A/B tests, controlled rollouts, to establish causal impact rather than usage correlation; quantify results in business terms (time saved, revenue generated, conversion lift).

Go-to-Market Alignment & Adoption

•Align product priorities with GTM and business leadership to drive adoption in real-world workflows.

•Own the adoption and value-realization framework: track usage-to-value conversion and course-correct where adoption lags.

Strategic Advisory

•Act as strategic advisor to client and business stakeholders on how to apply the portfolio to their specific workflows and goals.

•Translate ambiguous business problems into structured, dated plans with clear tradeoffs.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Partnership

•Direct team of Product Managers, UX/UI Leads and matrixed organization toward shared outcomes without directly owning technical delivery.

•Serve as the primary trusted point of contact for client and business stakeholders on program direction and results.

Qualifications

•12-15 years in product management, including 3+ years at the Director (or above) level owning an AI-enabled or data-driven product portfolio with direct accountability for a growth or revenue metric.

•Track record presenting to, and being questioned by, senior or C-level leadership and client stakeholders.

•Background in management consulting or professional/IT services (strategy consulting, SI, or similar), with experience running executive governance processes.

•Demonstrated product-led growth experience: ownership of activation, adoption, or retention/expansion metrics.

•3+ years of telecommunications industry experience

Tools & Skills

•Enterprise LLM platforms: Vertex AI, Claude (Anthropic), or comparable

•Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or equivalent cloud infrastructure

•AI/ML evaluation and observability tooling (evals, monitoring, drift and quality tracking)

•Analytics and BI tooling: SQL, dashboarding, experimentation platforms

•Executive-grade presentation and reporting: structured governance decks, board-level communication

Preferred Qualifications

•Masters, MBA or advanced degree

•Experience with telecom-specific technologies (e.g., OSS/BSS, 5G, AI/ML, cloud platforms)

•Familiarity with CRM, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing Enablement Systems

•Prior experience at a renowned or specialized consulting firm.

description:
Our Purpose

We are a leading provider of senior healthcare services, specializing in post-acute care. We offer services ranging from comprehensive short-term rehabilitation and transitional care to Alzheimer's and dementia care.

The Opportunity

The Admissions Coordinator supports timely, accurate admissions by coordinating referral intake, completing pre-admission screenings, and guiding residents and families through next steps. This role exists to protect a smooth transition into care while supporting census and service excellence.

Key responsibilities include managing and tracking referrals, confirming payer/coverage details, collaborating with clinical leaders on acceptance decisions, maintaining relationships with hospitals/physician offices and other referral partners, and keeping current with Medicare/Medicaid and commercial insurance requirements.

title: Director of Housing Services
description:
Description

MISSION:

Our mission, grounded in traditional Native culture, is to reduce health disparities by delivering high-quality comprehensive integrated healthcare and providing stable housing throughout the communities we serve.


POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director of Housing Services provides operational leadership and oversight for Native American Connections (NAC) housing and homeless service programs, including Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH), Supportive Housing, shelter, bridge and transitional programs. This position is responsible for ensuring that housing programs are effective, culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and aligned with organizational priorities. The Director of Housing Services oversees assigned program management, supports implementation of service delivery models and operational standards, and works collaboratively across departments to ensure coordinated, effective, and compliant operations. This role promotes housing stability, positive participant outcomes, operational consistency, strong staff accountability, community partnerships, and continuous improvement of NAC’s housing services.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Provide program oversight of all Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH), Supportive Housing, shelter and homeless programs, to include outreach and youth services, to ensure effective implementation and high-quality services to residents.

· Lead the implementation and ongoing improvement of housing service models, policies, procedures, and operational standards.

· Ensure all housing programs operate in alignment with HUD and PSH principles, trauma-informed care, and culturally responsive practices.

· Oversee program compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements at the local, state and federal levels.

· Provide leadership and supervision to assigned managers and supervisors, and subordinate staff, including hiring, training, and performance management.

· Collaborate with Finance, Compliance, Property Management, Data & Outcomes, and Clinical Services to ensure integrated, effective, and compliant program operations.

· Support implementation of new or expanded housing and shelter programs, operational changes, or departmental initiatives as assigned.

· Monitor housing system, funding, and regulatory updates relevant to assigned programs and ensure operational adaptation as needed.

· Ensure timely and accurate program reporting, audits, and monitoring activities in

coordination with internal departments.

· Develop staffing structures, workflows, and operational systems that support program effectiveness and organizational priorities

· Review and oversee auditing of case plans, HMIS data, grievances, and special incident reports to ensure compliance with NAC policy and procedures.

· Establish and enforce Housing Services operational policies and procedures to increase efficiency and effectiveness across the department.

· Promote a culture of high performance, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the Housing Services operational and program areas, fostering innovation and learning, while upholding NAC’s core values.

· Identify inefficiencies, assess workflows, allocate resources strategically, and streamline Housing Services operations to reduce costs, improve productivity, and enhance overall effectiveness.

· Lead the performance management and monitoring process for the Housing Service department, aligning operational performance with strategic goals.

· Collaborate with the Development and Finance/Accounting team to ensure financial sustainability and effective grant management.

· Monitor departmental budgets, expenditures, and resource utilization to support responsible fiscal management and operational effectiveness.

· Cultivate talent development by mentoring and empowering team members.

· Lead and foster a high-performing and collaborative organizational culture within the Housing Services department to maximize performance that upholds the NAC's core values.

· Create and nurture existing team members by identifying and developing top talent to reach their full potential.

· Foster a positive and inclusive department of organizational culture that supports the NAC mission and values.

· Promote cross-functional communication, transparency, and accountability to ensure compliance and alignment with NAC’s mission and strategic objectives.

· Maintain regular visibility within programs to support leadership presence, staff engagement, quality oversight, and operational consistency.


EDUCATIONAL/WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT:

· Must possess a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a business or social services discipline. Masters preferred.

· A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience as a senior social services leader. Preferably in a Director or Management role.

· At least 5 years of experience working with the homeless, low income or vulnerable populations


SKILLS REQUIREMENT:

· Experience partnering across departments to support effective program operations, compliance, service delivery and organizational goals.

· Experience leading and working effectively with property and social service staff to design and maintain a state-of-the-art homeless housing model.

· Experience overseeing grant funded programs and ensure quality delivery of services, appropriate and timely reporting.

· Experience in a non-profit setting, be driven to succeed, be able to handle multi-priorities; manage the stress of multiple, concurrent demands; possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills; be able to skillfully engage others; and a good steward of the organization’s culture and strong community history.

· Ability to provide competent leadership to employees, to support and develop the provision of services, to deliver high-value, culturally relevant and quality care that is financially feasible and sustainable.

· Ability to work and collaborate with community partners to enhance programing and housing options for individuals.

· Ability to work collaboratively with Property Management staff on resident/client issues or concerns.

· Ability to innovate with respect to service delivery including the use of alternative approaches.

· Ability to represent NAC at the local, tribal, and federal level by attending networking and educational opportunities and promoting the positive reputation of the organization.

· Ability to deploy resources efficiently and effectively toward organizational goals, working with staff to recruit and retain highly qualified staff, balance workload and effort, and provide ongoing feedback so that staff can continuously improve their supervision and mentoring skills.

· Ability to competently design workflows for all assigned services lines to ensure maximum efficiency with the goal of reducing homelessness.

· Knowledge of homelessness, mental health crisis management, and social determinants of health.

· Knowledge of the homeless housing system in Maricopa County (i.e. Maricopa Association of Governments, Maricopa Regional Continuum of Care, Coordinated Entry, HUD vouchers, LIHTC, etc.) required.

· Knowledge of Fair Housing regulations and Arizona Resident Landlord and Tenant Act.

· Experience working with Native American organizations or tribal governments is preferred.

· Awareness and keen appreciation of Indian traditions, customs and socioeconomic needs, or willingness to learn; an ability at times to meet and deal effectively with tribal governments and Indian health organizations consisting of numerous tribes with varied cultures. Tact, courtesy, discretion, resourcefulness, and good judgment in handling functions of a sensitive nature.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

· Able to sit, stand and walk with/without accommodation.

NATIVE AMERICAN PREFERENCE:

Preference may be given to qualified Native American Indians according to the Indian Preference Hiring Act, CFR 25 USC 472. Other than Indian Preference, Native American Connections, Inc. adheres to all provisions of the Equal Employment Opportunity Act.

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in Spain.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

      • Employment Type: Full-time.

      • Recruitment Process: The process includes a screening call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the VP of Product, a case study with the VP of Product and DPO, and reference checks. Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.
