title: Appian QA Tester and Automation Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

Miami Technology Solutions (MTS) provides high-quality technology services, including IT network maintenance, software development, and database management. We ensure secure and innovative technological solutions for public and private sectors.


MTS supports federal clients with tailored solutions, focusing on integrating new technologies while maintaining legacy systems.


MTS offers excellent benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, employer paid life insurance, long- and short-term disability coverage, a generous 401(k) match, and paid time off and holidays.


Miami Technology Solutions is seeking an Appian QA Tester with test automation experience who can also support database migration and data integration activities. This position will perform functional, regression, integration, and automated testing of Appian applications while helping ensure that migrated and integrated data is complete, accurate, and usable.

The successful candidate will work with Appian developers, database and integration engineers, business analysts, and project stakeholders supporting federal application modernization. The position requires hands-on Appian testing experience, the ability to maintain automated regression coverage, working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, and the judgment to investigate failures across application, data, automation, and environment layers.

Responsibilities

Appian Quality Assurance

• Develop and execute functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end tests for Appian applications.

• Validate Appian interfaces, records, process models, business rules, reports, integrations, plugins, and custom components.

• Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into detailed test cases and traceable test evidence.

• Create and manage test data across development, testing, staging, migration, and production-support environments.

• Document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution and retesting.

• Support formal testing, user acceptance testing, and release-readiness decisions.

Test Automation

• Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated regression and integration test suites for Appian applications.

• Analyze failed automated tests and distinguish application defects from test-script, data, pipeline, and environmental issues.

• Stabilize unreliable tests and improve the consistency and maintainability of automated execution.

• Integrate automated testing into Jenkins or comparable continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

• Maintain automation code through Git or GitHub source-control workflows.

• Support containerized test execution using Docker or comparable technologies.

• Connect automated test results with Jira, Xray, or comparable test-management tools.

Data Migration and Integration Support

• Review source-to-target mappings, data-transformation requirements, interface specifications, and business rules with technical and functional team members.

• Develop and execute SQL queries that validate source and target data.

• Compare record counts, field values, relationships, statuses, dates, and calculated values before and after migration or integration processing.

• Validate data completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, referential integrity, and compliance with business rules.

• Support mock migrations, cutover activities, rollback testing, and post-migration validation.

• Verify that Appian reports, interfaces, records, and integrations function correctly with migrated and integrated data.

Collaboration and Reporting

• Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, quality reviews, and retrospectives.

• Provide clear status updates on test execution, automation health, migration results, defects, dependencies, and risks.

• Help define quality gates and exit criteria for application releases and migration events.

• Produce test summaries, reconciliation reports, defect metrics, and release-readiness documentation.

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum two years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, or test engineering.

• Hands-on experience testing Appian applications or comparable low-code enterprise platforms.

• Experience executing functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing.

• Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks.

• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

• Experience testing system integrations, database conversions, data migrations, or data-intensive applications.

• Ability to interpret source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Experience managing defects and test execution through Jira, Xray, or comparable tools.

• Familiarity with continuous integration pipelines and Git or GitHub workflows.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Four or more years of experience in software quality assurance, automated testing, or test engineering.

• Appian testing experience involving records, process models, interfaces, integrations, plugins, and custom components.

• Experience with FitNesse for Appian or another Appian test-automation tool.

• Experience with Ruby, JRuby, Java, Python, or a comparable automation language.

• Experience creating automated SQL-based reconciliation or data-quality tests.

• Experience supporting migration rehearsals, production cutovers, rollback testing, and post-deployment validation.

• Experience with Jenkins, Docker, RubyMine, AWS-hosted environments, or similar technologies.

• Familiarity with federal system testing, documentation, security, and release-management requirements.

Additional Information

Successful candidates must be able to pass a government background investigation and satisfy public trust requirements. US Citizenship or US Green Card is required.


Miami Technology Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Shipping & Receiving Associate
description:
Shipping & Receiving Associate

N U A G E D E S I G N S · Chicago, IL · Reports to Chicago Inventory Lead · Full-Time - Non-Exempt


We elevate life’s most meaningful celebrations through inspired design, exceptional service, and genuine care.



T H E C O M P A N Y

About Nuage Designs


For over two decades, Nuage Designs has set the standard for couture linens and luxury event rentals — trusted by the world’s top event planners, Fortune 500 companies, and luxury hotels to make moments extraordinary.


Founded in Miami’s Wynwood district in 2004, we’ve grown into a team of over 140 across Miami, New York, and Chicago — and we’re just getting started. Now entering our most ambitious chapter yet, we’re doubling down on people who care deeply about quality, design, and the art of the unforgettable.


That growth is guided by how we work, not just what we make. We care deeply about our people, our partners, and our craft, and we elevate every experience by going beyond expectations at every touchpoint. We own the outcome, leading with integrity and holding ourselves accountable for the results we deliver — our products may be rented, but the results we deliver are ours. We win as one, building trusted partnerships and shared success through open collaboration, and we grow forward by staying curious, creative, and always learning.


We’re looking for exceptional people who are energized by growth, inspired by craft, and ready to help shape a company at an inflection point. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.


T H E R O L E

The Opportunity


The Shipping & Receiving Associate owns every UPS shipment of linen and chargers that moves between our Miami hub and our Chicago warehouse. This role ensures that inbound product arrives complete, correct, and staged for each event, and that returns to Miami are accurately counted, recorded, and shipped. The position works in close coordination with the Chicago Inventory Lead and the Shipping Manager to keep inventory accurate and resolve shipping issues before they reach an event.



W H A T Y O U ’ L L D O

Duties & Responsibilities


Inbound Receiving (from Miami)

  • Receive UPS deliveries of linen and chargers for Chicago orders that are bundled and delivered locally.

  • Count every item and verify it against the order to confirm it arrived complete and correct.

  • Document any damaged or missing items and report them the same day.

  • Partner with the Shipping Manager to resolve problems before they affect an event.

  • Stage linen and chargers for each order in its assigned location so the order is ready to load.


Outbound Returns (to Miami)

  • Count linen and chargers returned from events.

  • Report missing or damaged items.

  • Update inventory records with the Inventory Lead so counts stay accurate.

  • Pack, label, and prepare orders for UPS shipment back to Miami.


Shipment Tracking

  • Track all inbound and outbound UPS shipments for Chicago daily.

  • Identify late, stuck, or at-risk shipments early, before they become a problem for an event.

  • Escalate concerns to the Shipping Manager and help drive resolution.


Warehouse Standards and Safety

  • Keep the shipping and receiving area clean, organized, and safe.

  • Follow Nuage processes and safety standards.

  • Support other warehouse work as needed during the shift.


What Success Looks Like

  • Every Chicago order has the right linen and chargers staged on time.

  • Damaged or missing items are found and reported the day they arrive or return — not at the event.

  • Chicago inventory counts match what is physically on the shelf.

  • Return shipments to Miami go out complete and on schedule.

  • Shipping problems are raised early, with few surprises for the Inventory Lead or Shipping Manager.


This is a day-shift role, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Reliable, on-time attendance is essential.



W H O Y O U A R E

Qualifications & Experience

R e q u i r e d


  • High school diploma or GED.

  • 1+ year of experience in a warehouse, shipping and receiving, or inventory role.

  • Accuracy with counts and details — you catch mistakes before they leave the building.

  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet to look up tracking and update inventory records.

  • Clear communicator who speaks up early when something looks wrong.

  • Reliable attendance for a 7:00 AM start.


Preferred


  • Experience with UPS or other carrier shipping systems and tracking tools.

  • Experience in event rental, hospitality, linen, or tabletop products.

  • Forklift or pallet jack experience.

  • Bilingual English/Spanish.


Physical Requirements

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, bend, and reach throughout the shift.

Work Environment

  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety footwear, high visibility vests, and gloves is required in designated areas.

title: Valve Automation Technician - Genesis Systems
description:
Genesis Systems distributes valves, control valves, regulators and valve automation products in Texas and Oklahoma from the world’s leading manufacturers. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior ML Engineer

Be the ML force multiplier at a funded stealth startup solving hard on-device AI problems.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

A stealth startup in the identity space building privacy-preserving, on-device authentication via voice biometrics. Backed by $2.4M in pre-seed funding with large enterprise clients already in the pipeline. The core technical challenge: compressing 5GB ML models to under 5MB without sacrificing accuracy. Small team, real traction, massive upside.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We need someone who brings a different gear — modern tooling, fast experimentation, and a bias toward shipping. You won't be inheriting a broken system; you'll be raising the ceiling on what this team can do. This is the kind of role where the right person becomes indispensable within 90 days.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Drive high-velocity experimentation on voice embedding models — speaker verification, liveness detection, age estimation

Own model compression end-to-end — quantization, pruning, distillation — to hit aggressive on-device size and latency constraints

Build modern ML infrastructure — experiment tracking, fast eval loops, reproducible pipelines — so the team can iterate at a different pace

Deploy optimized models to iOS and Android via CoreML, TFLite, or ONNX Runtime and own their performance in production

Partner with the co-founder to define the ML roadmap and unblock enterprise client integrations

YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF

You've shipped production ML models and measure yourself by what's deployed, not what's in a notebook

You run 10 experiments where others run 2 — fast iteration is your default, not a mode you shift into

You live in modern tooling — Weights & Biases, HuggingFace, modal, or equivalent — and have strong opinions about what a good ML stack looks like

5+ years of applied ML engineering with deep PyTorch or JAX fluency across the full training loop

Hands-on experience with model compression — you've hit real size and latency walls and engineered your way through them

Startup-ready: you set your own direction, don't wait to be unblocked, and thrive when the brief is "figure it out"

NICE TO HAVE

Background in audio/speech ML — speaker verification, voice activity detection, or audio embeddings

Experience with on-device deployment via CoreML, TFLite, or ONNX

Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML — federated learning, on-device inference, differential privacy

Prior experience at an early-stage startup — you know the difference between building for scale and building to learn

title: Salesforce Administrator and Developer
description:
This position is available for remote work.

About Walter

For over 70 years, Walter Surface Technologies has been a world leader in surface treatment technologies, providing high-performance abrasives, tools, power tools, chemical solutions and welding process solutions specifically designed for the metalworking industry. Our core philosophy is focused on helping customers work better and providing “only the best”: the best technology, the best products, the best performance, the best in safety and the best in sustainability, all aimed at increasing their productivity and profitability.

Position summary

Walter Surface Technologies is looking for an experienced Salesforce professional who can understand our business processes and turn them into practical improvements. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and IT to configure Salesforce, improve automation and make code changes.

You will take changes from the initial business discussion through testing, deployment and follow-up. External partners will support larger projects and specialized needs. This role suits an administrator with development skills, or a developer who enjoys working closely with business users.

Key responsibilities

  • Understand the business goal behind requests, review the existing setup and recommend a practical solution.

  • Investigate issues with automation, data and integrations, working with IT or external partners when needed.
  • Test changes in a sandbox, coordinate user acceptance testing, deploy safely and verify the result with users.
  • Prioritize improvements with the business, document key changes and help users adopt them.
  • Review work delivered by external partners and maintain the knowledge needed to support it internally.

Qualifications

  • Four or more years of hands-on Salesforce experience, or a comparable track record of delivering changes independently.
  • Strong Sales Cloud administration and Flow skills, including data management and the Salesforce security model.
  • Practical experience writing and troubleshooting Apex and SOQL, maintaining existing code and creating meaningful tests.

Assets

  • Service Cloud: cases, queues, routing and email-to-case.
  • Experience Cloud and B2B Commerce: customer and distributor storefronts built on LWR sites.
  • MuleSoft: integrations between Salesforce and the ERP, or other Salesforce API integrations.
  • Lightning Web Components, source control and deployment tools.

Experience and education

  • Performance-based rewards. A performance-based compensation program that recognizes individual achievements.
  • Opportunities for growth. Leadership programs and professional development to help you grow and advance in your career.
  • Flexibility. Remote work from Canada will be considered; hybrid preferred.

Our hiring process

Shortlisted candidates complete a short written exercise based on realistic Salesforce situations, followed by an interview with the IT team. There is nothing to memorize about Walter; we want to see how you think, what you would check and how you would explain it.

How to apply

Apply through the Walter careers page at walter.com/ca/careers. Include your CV and a brief example of a business problem you solved in Salesforce. Explain what you personally configured or developed and how you checked the result.

Equal opportunity employer

title: Bell Captain
description:
Why We're Here

We believe heartfelt, human connections make people's lives better. Especially the people who work here.

Our founder, Bill Kimpton rebelled against impersonal, generic hospitality that makes people feel disconnected. He initiated a new boutique hotel standard and environment where people could connect, from the heart. That was the goal then, and it is still our purpose today.

Your work here has meaning. You're here to improve the lives of coworkers, guests, owners, communities, and together we make that happen. It's what drives all that we do. Every day you can improve lives in your own, unique way and you can expect the same in return. It all starts with you.

How We're Different

Our San Francisco-born entrepreneurial spirit and zest for life kick started this culture in 1981, and it shines through to this day.

It all flows from you. The lively, rebellious, genuine you - with your diverse background, talents, experiences, and plucky personality - is fully welcome, and celebrated here. Because we know that when people can be themselves at work, they shine.

That's what we seek out and celebrate. It's people of all kinds who share a knack for creativity and self-leadership. People who don't need to be told what to do to get things done. People who have an innate passion for making others' lives better.

It adds up to a work environment that's a bit quirky, irreverent, exciting, uncommon, empowering, and downright exceptional. Guests feel it; you'll feel it too.

What You'll Do

Provide a positive first and last impression to guests as they arrive and leave the hotel. When servicing guests, you're professional, and friendly. Assist with luggage and packages upon arrival and departure and arrange transportation when necessary.

Some of your responsibilities include:

  • Get assignments, keys, and special guest requests from your supervisor at the beginning of your shift.

  • Clean and set-up meeting room functions, direct guests to various meeting rooms.
  • Set-up and maintain complimentary hotel lobby functions including the morning coffee service and the nightly concierge events.
  • Turn in any keys to the proper department when your shift ends.

What You Bring

  • High School Diploma is preferred.
  • 1 year of experience in customer service or similar role.
  • You've got a flexible schedule, able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays when needed.
  • Basic writing skills, professional communication skills.

Differences make a difference. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our hotel and restaurant guests. With that goal in mind, we encourage each of our employees to understand, accept, and celebrate differences among people. That includes different personalities, lifestyles, work styles, education, and experience. We also welcome and embrace people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, physical abilities, sexual orientation, gender identities and genders. For our complete EEO policy click here.

title: Senior Performance Test Engineer
description:
About Agadia

We specialize in healthcare management technology and offer a suite of utilization management software solutions for our clients. Our mission is to improve the quality of care and expedite the delivery of health care services by advancing and automating utilization management processes. We are based in Parsippany, NJ, with clients across the United States. As we grow, we are looking for a detail-oriented, self-motivated, independent Software Engineer to help analyze, design, and refine business requirements.

Agadia is seeking a Senior Performance Test Engineer to perform performance testing for its healthcare SaaS applications. The role covers requirements analysis, workload modeling, test automation, execution, bottleneck investigation, and reporting. The engineer will work with Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, DBAs, and Production Support to validate performance, investigate regressions, and provide evidence for release and capacity decisions.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define measurable acceptance criteria for critical workflows, including response-time percentiles, throughput, error rates, and recovery behavior.
  • Assess application architecture, dependencies, deployment topology, and production usage to develop performance test strategies, estimates, schedules, and entry and exit criteria.
  • Design realistic workload models covering concurrent users, transaction arrival rates, customer mix, think time, pacing, peak periods, ramp-up and sustained load.
  • Plan and execute baseline, load, stress, spike, endurance, and scalability tests; coordinate controlled failover and recovery tests with the responsible teams.
  • Develop and maintain reusable JMeter or k6 scripts with authentication, session handling, dynamic value correlation, parameterization and assertions that verify successful business transactions.
  • Build modular suites for case creation, review, sign-off, queue management and document management, with configurable customer profiles, user credentials and datasets.
  • Prepare and manage approved synthetic or masked test data, including extraction, seeding, validation and cleanup; protect credentials and maintain customer data isolation.
  • Validate test environment readiness, data volumes, cache state, and load-generator capacity; document differences that affect comparison with production.
  • Monitor and correlate test results with Dynatrace or equivalent APM tooling, IIS and Windows metrics, application logs, and SQL Server activity.
  • Investigate bottlenecks across application, API, database, and infrastructure layers, including slow queries, blocking, thread or connection pool contention, memory growth, and resource saturation.
  • Compare releases against approved baselines, record reproducible performance defects, collaborate with engineering teams on remediation, and verify fixes through retesting.
  • Provide measured capacity and scalability findings, with documented assumptions, to support infrastructure planning and growth forecasts.
  • Integrate appropriate performance checks into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and scheduled test runs; continuously improve scripts, framework reliability and reporting.
  • Deliver technical reports and stakeholder summaries covering workload assumptions, results against targets, bottleneck evidence, business impact, limitations and release readiness recommendations.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in load and performance testing of web applications and APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in JMeter or k6, including independent script development, debugging, maintenance, and command-line test execution.
  • Sound understanding of performance testing concepts, workload modeling, and interpretation of latency percentiles, throughput, error rates, and resource utilization.
  • Experience testing multi-tier applications, with working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, session management, and dynamic data correlation.
  • SQL proficiency for test data preparation, validation, and investigation of database-related performance issues.
  • Experience using an application performance monitoring tool, server metrics, and logs to investigate bottlenecks and support findings with evidence.
  • Ability to develop supporting automation using JavaScript, YAML, Groovy, or a comparable scripting language.
  • Experience with Git, repeatable test execution, and performance regression analysis across software releases.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to manage testing priorities and explain findings to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Dynatrace Managed and performance analysis of Windows Server, IIS, .NET, and SQL Server environments.
  • Hands-on experience with both JMeter and k6, and integration of performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS or healthcare applications and handling sensitive test data.
  • Browser performance analysis using developer tools, Playwright, or k6 browser, alongside API and protocol-level load testing.
  • Understanding Azure or AWS architecture, scalability, and migration performance validation; Azure experience is preferred.
  • Exposure to background processing, caching, messaging, and failover or recovery validation.

Key Deliverables

  • A maintained performance test strategy, workload model, and reusable regression suite.
  • Release reports with clear pass or fail results, supporting evidence, test limitations, and unresolved performance risks.
  • Verified remediation outcomes and capacity recommendations based on measured results.

Please note: The Salary range is based on our market pay structure & includes benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, life Insurance, 401 & PTO, etc.), and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and evaluation.
 - Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and the company does not provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future

Key Competencies

Communicates effectively– Attentively listens to others, provides timely and helpful information and is effective in a range of professional settings. Gives and receives feedback in a productive, professional manner. Demonstrates excellent oral and written communication skills.

Manages Ambiguity -Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Is flexible in approach and is able to adapt their approach to meet changing business needs.

Manages complexity -Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Has strong organizational skills and is able to manage multiple activities at once. Has high attention to detail.

Ensures Accountability -Follows through on commitments and makes sure others do the same. Able to work independently as part of a small team.

title: Practice Site Coordinator

Position Summary

Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Practice Management, the Practice Site Coordinator (PSC) is responsible for supervising the daily operations for the assigned site, ensuring the practice runs smoothly and efficiently while following OHI policies and regulations. This hands-on position requires the full understanding and active participation in fulfilling the mission of OHI and including all non-clinical functions to enhance the patient's experience.

Responsibilities

  • Supervises the day- to- day functions of the multi-specialty practice, including support and coordination of patient care services and all staff.
  • Completes daily site and departmental walk throughs ensuring a safe and clean environment that aligns with infection control, escalates findings to appropriate manager(s) as necessary.
  • Ensures pre-EOC and Monthly rounds are performed at site with team participation. Follows- through on all EOC findings and ensures they are resolved timely. Discusses open or delayed items during CQI meetings.
  • Set daily priorities and organize workflows to achieve OHI goals.
  • Create daily assignments to ensure staff is aware of their individual role and responsibilities for the day and assign down-time tasks.
  • Supports all staff with achieving established goals, metrics, monitors performance and virtual productivity.
  • Completes and performs scorecard reviews, collaborating with RPD for any employee needing corrective action or a performance improvement plan.
  • Facilitates patient complaints by responding in a calm, empathic and professional manner; when applicable disseminates to appropriate department manager(s) and reports all findings to CQI committee.
  • Reviews and addresses all incoming patient complaints within 72 business hours. Escalates when needed to RPD or corresponding manager.
  • Facilitates ongoing quality initiatives, actively participates in committees, and contributes to continuous improvement efforts aligned with organizational goals to achieve higher standards.
  • Promotes and participates in the PDSA process.
  • Reports any building and/or maintenance needs for respective sites to the Facilities Department.
  • Monitors, addresses and reports, when necessary, any patient care concerns to the CMO and/or the DON.
  • Understands and adheres to all OHI purchasing policies and procedures and ensures inventory levels are maintained.
  • Reports any security and/or safety concerns at the health center to the VP of Operations.
  • Works with RPD to resolve departmental and organizational challenges expeditiously, economically, professionally and with minimum disruption to the practice.
  • Maintains an in-depth working knowledge of all technological operation systems including the EMR to ensure operational effectiveness.
  • Utilizes the “scorecard” data to evaluate and develop training with the goal of improving staff performance.
  • In collaboration with the RPD, develop and execute training programs for staff ensuring organizational goals and compliance standards. This includes creating training material and evaluating the effectiveness of the training to improve performance and overall productivity.
  • The PSC will work with the RPD to address the initial site onboarding process, taking part in handling staff introductions and creating a welcoming environment for all new hires.
  • Create an environment that promotes staff engagement and retention. Consistently acknowledges and appreciates each team member's contributions.
  • Track and enforce daily huddles with each department to plan daily workflow and identify potential issues. Ensures huddles are documented and electronically filed.
  • Communicate organizational and practice updates to the site staff.
  • Ensures all staff are following the OHI Employee Handbook and established guidelines.
  • In conjunction with the RPD and departmental supervisors participates in the development of the introductory and annual performance appraisals for all staff at each site.
  • Provides comprehensive monthly report to RPD for Board of Directors presentation, including, current site metrics, productivity, achievements and challenges.
  • Review and approve timecards for all staff at the respective site.
  • Reviews Athena and staff schedules and collaborates with the RPD and Scheduling Specialist to ensure sufficient staffing, while managing PTO, call outs, tardiness, opening/closing schedules.
  • Review daily productivity and collaborate with the CEC Director to ensure daily productivity goals are met.
  • Prepare bank deposits, completes bank transfer log, sends reconciliation package to the Finance Department, reports any discrepancies to RPD immediately.
  • Ensures cashbox are being utilized properly according to protocol and performs cash box audits on a regular and consistent basis.
  • In collaboration with marketing, improve and promote OHI services.
  • Collaborates with Lab-Corp supervisor to achieve optimal care for laboratory services.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships and communication with external organizations, such as NJCEED and Cologuard, and programs to support mutual goals.
  • Has efficient knowledge of the Monday.com platform, utilizes the software to meet project goals and deadlines.
  • Facilitates daily and weekly reports for the PARs and clinical support staff and ensure their timely completion.

title: Account Director
description:
Salary range: $100,000-120,000

tmp helps B2B marketing leaders create coherence in a chaotic world. We’re looking for obsessively curious people to join us.

You'll join 300 B2B experts across strategy, data, creative, media, client services, Sales activation, and shared services. Different skills brought together in integrated teams, centred around our clients: the world’s most impactful tech companies.

So, if you’re interested in what makes the world work, if you find solving complex problems fun, and you love making the answers as simple as possible, then we’d love to hear from you.

What we are looking for

We’re looking for an experienced Account Director who combines a passion for marketing with the confidence to lead. This role is pivotal to the success and health of our client partnerships. You’ll take ownership of one or more major accounts, driving excellence in client management, team leadership, and delivery.

Across your accounts, you’ll build strong relationships with your clients, providing advice on marketing strategy and recommending marketing solutions to specific business challenges. Whilst you will work on a variety of clients and integrated marketing programs, a thorough understanding and experience managing integrated media solutions for clients is needed to be successful in this role. Under your direction, tmp will deliver head-turning, results-driven campaigns for your accounts.

You’ll be accountable for an annual revenue target of $3M, ensuring your accounts are profitable, healthy, and positioned for growth. Client satisfaction, commercial success, and the development of your team will all sit within your remit. To deliver at this level, you’ll continually deepen your understanding of marketing best practice, your clients’ industries, and the broader landscape while always looking for opportunities where TMP can add more value.

This is a role for someone who thrives on responsibility, inspires confidence, and leads with TMP’s values. You’ll be entrepreneurial in growing opportunities, resilient when challenges arise, human in how you connect, bold in pushing ideas further, and always looking to bring the magic back to B2B marketing.

What you will do

Client leadership

  • Lead and inspire teams to manage client relationships with excellence, ensuring we not only meet but anticipate client needs.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with senior client stakeholders (Manager, Director, and beyond), positioning tmp as a trusted advisor.
  • Shape and challenge marketing strategy, helping clients to connect their business objectives to tmp’s integrated solutions.
  • Provide clear, confident recommendations on the level of investment required to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Translate results into meaningful impact, communicating outcomes in a way that secures long-term commitment and funding for future projects and campaigns.
  • Act as the strategic voice of your client’s business inside tmp, ensuring their brand, priorities, and ambitions are understood and championed.
  • Challenge and elevate briefs by pushing for clarity, ambition, and strategic alignment to ensure every project starts with a strong foundation.
  • Deliver compelling quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that provide inspiration, insight, and clear recommendations for future success, working together.

Account leadership

  • Represent your client’s business, brand, strategy, and objectives within our internal team, ensuring they have the context they need to succeed.
  • Partner closely with the delivery lead to oversee multiple complex programs, ensuring the right expertise and structure is in place across your account.
  • Keep strategy and execution connected to drive excellence by ensuring delivery always ladders up to client goals.
  • Maintain a focus on outcomes and campaign results to measure the success and outcomes of campaign activities.
  • Critically review and refine strategic, conceptual, and creative outputs, raising the bar on quality and ensuring alignment to the brief and overall strategy.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across global clients and teams, adapting to cultural nuances and ways of working to ensure tmp delivers with impact and consistency worldwide.

Commercial management

  • Take full ownership for converting opportunities that are right for the client and commercially healthy and profitable for tmp.
  • Be accountable for accurate and timely Scopes of Work across your accounts that balance ambition with realistic delivery and manage risks before they become blockers.
  • Lead forecasting across your accounts, remain accountable for ensuring revenue projections are accurate and programs remain on track.
  • Act decisively to resolve commercial issues that could impact profitability or growth.
  • Contribute to overall growth targets and commercial reviews, using your insight to shape the wider business picture.
  • Invest wisely in client development activity, balancing cost with opportunity and scale.

Marketing strategy

  • Develop a deep understanding of your client’s business, industry and the work, using this insight to inform all aspects of your oversight, perspective and direction.
  • Provide recommendations for marketing solutions that deliver measurable impact on the business objectives of your clients.
  • Use your deep expertise across tmp’s full service offering to add value to every client conversation.
  • Bring a challenger mindset by asking the questions that elevate thinking and push strategies further.
  • Capture success stories across your accounts and share them widely, helping your teams and peers see what “great” looks like.

Business development

  • Own and lead on the develop of account plans and growth strategies, turning plans into action and rallying your team around them.
  • Proactively spot and convert opportunities that expand tmp’s impact and create long-term value.
  • Expand and deepen client contact networks, nurturing advocates and alumni who help us open new doors.
  • Play a central role in pitches and RFPs, bringing your insight, experience, and leadership presence to the table.
  • Be entrepreneurial in your approach, resilient in the face of challenges, and human in the way you lead growth conversations.

Mentorship and management

  • Set the standard for best practice account management, acting as a role model for the wider team.
  • Coach and develop talent, providing ongoing feedback, guidance, and stretch opportunities that build confidence and capability.
  • Create a positive, high-performing team culture where people feel supported, motivated, and proud of the work they deliver.
  • Lead career development planning to help your team set ambitious goals, track progress, provide feedback and grow their careers within tmp.
  • Ensure new hires are onboarded with confidence, connected to our culture, and set up to thrive.
  • Manage, inspire, and motivate direct reports, ensuring they bring tmp’s values to life in their own leadership and delivery.

Success is measured by

  • Team feedback: the team on your accounts feel inspired to do their best work and have clear direction on what good looks like.
  • Client feedback we’re achieving 8.4+ in our client satisfaction survey across your accounts
  • Account performance: we’re meeting or exceeding expected outcomes across our marketing activity
  • Account profitability: we’re meeting client profitability targets and showing strong levels of revenue recovery across your accounts.
  • Accuracy and stability of delivery in line with project plans including accurate forecasting across your accounts.
  • Growth of account/s: Achieving client targets, developing new relationships and achieving growth goals across your accounts, as identified as part of Account Plans.

Requirements

Who you are

  • A confident and inclusive leader who inspires trust across clients and teams.
  • A strategic marketing thinker who can connect the bigger picture to the finer details.
  • Positive and resilient, always proactive in finding solutions and moving work forward.
  • Ready to challenge thinking constructively, pushing clients and teams to achieve the best possible outcomes.
  • Skilled at relationship management, demonstrated by being brilliant at influencing, building trust, and communicating with clarity at every level.
  • Curious and quick to learn, able to interrogate complex information and distill it into clear recommendations.
  • A collaborative problem solver who guides and supports your team while staying open to new ideas and perspectives.
  • Authentically human in approach and motivated by creating work that delivers real impact.

What you will need

  • Deep experience leading integrated marketing programs, with proven expertise in media strategy, media buys, and channel selection to drive business outcomes for your client.
  • Strong knowledge of brand and ABM programs, with the ability to connect strategy to measurable business impact.
  • 5+ years of previous agency experience, ideally in a B2B environment, with a proven track record of delivering value and growth for clients at the senior level.
  • Demonstrated experience managing senior client and partner relationships, confident communicating at a senior level both internally and externally.
  • Proven ability to direct marketing programs based on business objectives, and to recommend bold, effective solutions to client challenges.
  • Commercial acumen with experience in forecasting, financial management, and ensuring account profitability.
  • Familiarity with account management tools and processes that keep delivery clear and efficient.
  • Proficient with core business tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.

Benefits

What we offer in return

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance: Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability.
  • Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA) – healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team.
  • 4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well.
  • Plentiful paid time off: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout.
  • Sick leave (15 days annually): Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work.
  • Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th): As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones.
  • Parental leave:
    • Primary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay
    • Secondary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay
  • Access to Unmind: Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches
  • Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance: tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need.
  • Company getaways: Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team.

We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:

CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX.

A note on applying:

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you.

At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another.

Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

title: Machine Shop Associate
description:
Therm-x of California is the leading manufacturer for Advanced Temperature and Control Systems for Hi-Technology industries. We have been in business for over 30 years and have a diverse customer base. We offer competitive pay, medical, dental, 401 (K), and paid time off.

The Machine Shop Administrator & Scheduler is responsible for coordinating production schedules, tracking work orders, monitoring machine shop capacity, and maintaining accurate production records. This position works closely with the Production Planner, CNC Machinists, Setup Operators, Programming, and other departments to ensure production runs efficiently and customer orders are completed on time.


Key Responsibilities


Production Scheduling and Coordination

  • Prepare, update, and maintain daily and weekly machine shop production schedules.
  • Coordinate job priorities based on customer demand, due dates, material availability, and machine capacity.
  • Monitor production progress and adjust schedules as needed to minimize delays and downtime.
  • Communicate priority jobs, hot jobs, and schedule changes to machine shop personnel.
  • Coordinate with the Production Planner to ensure production targets and on-time delivery requirements are met.

Machine Capacity and Productivity

  • Monitor machine utilization and production capacity across CNC lathes, VTLs, mills, and other machining equipment.
  • Track machine availability, setup time, cycle time, and production output.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve machine utilization.
  • Help ensure machines have scheduled work and are utilized effectively.
  • Support continuous improvement activities to increase productivity and reduce downtime.

Work Order and Production Tracking

  • Create, review, and maintain production schedules and work order records in Epicor or other ERP systems.
  • Track work order status, production quantities, completed operations, and remaining work.
  • Monitor employee clock-in and clock-out transactions to help ensure labor and production records are accurate.
  • Follow up on delayed jobs, missing information, material shortages, and incomplete production transactions.
  • Maintain accurate production reports and communicate schedule risks to management.

Administrative Support

  • Maintain production spreadsheets, scheduling reports, and machine shop documentation.
  • Update NC program records, job notes, and related production information as required.
  • Assist with inventory tracking, material availability, tooling records, and work order documentation.
  • Ensure production information is organized, accurate, and accessible to the appropriate team members.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on production status, capacity, and performance.

Communication and Teamwork

  • Work closely with machinists, setup operators, CNC programmers, engineers, and production leads.
  • Communicate new jobs and programming or drawing requirements promptly to prevent production delays.
  • Follow up on new product introduction (NPI) jobs and ensure production readiness.
  • Escalate scheduling issues, machine downtime, quality concerns, and delivery risks to the appropriate personnel.
  • Support teamwork, accountability, 6S practices, and continuous improvement throughout the machine shop.


Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a machine shop, manufacturing, production scheduling, or administrative support preferred.
  • Familiarity with CNC machining processes, machine setups, and production workflows.
  • Experience using Epicor or another ERP/MRP system preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and production tracking spreadsheets.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple jobs and meet changing production deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate production records.

title: Technical Business Analyst I
description:
Job Title: Technical Business Analyst I

Company: Security Equipment Supply, Inc. (SES)

Location: Earth City, MO

Job Type: Full-Time | Exempt

About Security Equipment Supply (SES)

Security Equipment Supply (SES) is a second-generation, family-owned distributor of low-voltage electronics. Since 1982, we've grown to 15 locations across 12 states, delivering trusted solutions in access control, fire and life safety, surveillance, home entertainment, and more.

We’re in a transformative phase—modernizing operations, investing in technology, and enhancing customer and employee experiences. SES is committed to growing talent from within and creating meaningful career paths across the organization. Most roles are hybrid, providing flexibility while driving impact.

At SES, we don’t just work here — we care for what we’ve built and the people we work with.

Live the SES Way: Family • Respect • Celebration • Excellence • Integrity

Work the SES Way: Curiosity • Fun-Loving Spirit • Commitment to Growth


About the Role

Are you the person who notices what everyone else missed—and makes sure things get finished correctly?

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst who is analytical, highly detail-oriented, proactive, and technically capable. This role connects business needs with technology solutions and supports integrations, ERP enhancements, automation initiatives, and third-party applications.

We're looking for someone who can take ownership, figure things out, and run with them. You should be able to quickly understand what needs to happen, organize and prioritize your work, and move projects forward without constant oversight.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the liaison between internal departments, technology partners, and vendors.
  • Gather, analyze, document, and translate business requirements into clear technical requirements.
  • Develop and manage user stories throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support integrations using Power Platform and Boomi (iPaaS).
  • Build, test, and roll out business templates through Docentric.
  • Test ERP updates, integrations, and automations to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and security.
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and coordinate solutions.
  • Document business processes, workflows, system designs, and process improvements.
  • Identify business pain points and use technology to develop practical solutions.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Work proactively with stakeholders and vendors to keep projects moving and follow issues through to resolution.

Who You Are

The right person is:

  • Extremely detail-oriented — you catch things others miss and don't let details fall through the cracks.
  • A finisher — you follow work through to completion and take ownership of results.
  • Proactive — you don't wait to be told there is a problem; you identify and address it.
  • A quick learner — you can understand new systems, processes, and technology quickly.
  • Analytical — you enjoy investigating, testing, comparing results, and finding the root cause.
  • Organized and able to prioritize — you can manage multiple projects while maintaining accuracy.
  • Comfortable with repetitive/detail-heavy work — you understand that thorough testing and analysis are critical to getting things right.
  • A problem solver — when something doesn't work, you want to figure out why and fix it.
  • Self-directed — you can take a project or assignment and run with it without needing constant direction.
  • A clear communicator — you can translate business needs into information technical partners can understand.

Qualifications

  • Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred in Business, Finance, IT, Data Analytics, or related field.
  • Experience in business analysis, technical analysis, systems, ERP, or a related role.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities in an enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of API testing and authentication protocols.
  • Experience with technical documentation and data manipulation.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems and ecommerce platforms preferred.
  • Experience with Power Platform, Boomi, or Docentric is a plus.

Success Metrics

  • 100% of assigned user stories delivered within committed sprint/timeline.
  • Zero critical defects found in ERP updates, integrations, or automations within 30 days of deployment.
  • At least 90% of Power Platform and Boomi (iPaaS) integrations pass testing without post-deployment rework
  • At least 3 business processes, workflows, or systems design documents completed and kept current per quarter.
  • Requirement change requests after stakeholder sign-off reduced to fewer than 10% of scoped items per project.
  • Positive feedback from internal departments and external partners/vendors on clarity of translated requirements.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This position is primarily performed in a professional office environment and requires regular use of a computer, telephone, and other standard office technology. The employee must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, occasionally move throughout the workplace, and communicate effectively with colleagues, customers, and business partners. The employee may occasionally move office materials weighing up to 15 pounds.

Why Join SES?

Competitive compensation: market-aligned salary + performance incentives

Profit sharing & retirement: SEP IRA contributions and annual profit-sharing bonuses

Health benefits: affordable medical, dental, and vision plans

Career growth: ongoing development, advancement opportunities, and a promote- from-within culture

Next Steps

As part of our hiring process, we invite you to complete a brief personality survey to help us understand how you work best.

Be part of a growing company where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your success is celebrated.

title: Manager, Field Services
description:
Who We Are
Quality Work. Quality Results.

Bay West stands at the forefront of the environmental consulting and remediation sector. Our dedication to safety, innovation, and our skilled team has driven us for over fifty years, delivering top-tier environmental consulting, industrial, and emergency response services. At Bay West, you’ll be driven to innovate and make a real impact on environmental issues, all while advancing your career in a dynamic and supportive environment.

This Opportunity

We are seeking a Field Services Manager (FSM) with proven Industrial Services experience to provide field operations support to the Industrial Services group. You will support the preparedness and scheduling of personnel, supplies, and equipment to ensure the safe, efficient, and successful completion of Industrial Service and Emergency Response projects. You will also function as a trainer and mentor for field technicians, a resource manager in support of project managers, and serve as a Site Supervisor during project operations.

Your Key Responsibilities

Direct Project and Field Support

  • Work closely with Project Managers and Site Supervisors to coordinate staff, equipment, and / or sub-contractors with crew safety and project budget being top priorities.
  • Coordinate and attend project kick-off meetings and support the field team on projects as assigned by Project Managers.
  • Lead daily Emergency Response operations in accordance with current ERS services and staffing expectations.
  • Support field crew by coordinating the equipment and supplies needed to perform ER and Industrial Service projects.
  • Coordinate and assist with the decontamination, inventory, repair and restocking of equipment/supplies returned from projects.
  • Perform field work while functioning as Site Supervisor / Senior Field Technician with appropriate training for the needs of the project.
  • Prepare and review project documentation including Site Safety and Health Plans (SSHPs), project management plans, Incident Action Plans (IAPs), daily logs, field sketches, reports, and other correspondence using technical writing and analysis skills.
  • Actively participate as a Site Safety Officer / Lead On-Call for the after-hours Emergency Response Program (approximately one week every six to eight weeks).

Resource Management and Operational Preparedness – Scheduling, Maintenance & Inventory

  • Work with Project Managers and assist with logistics related to field equipment scheduling.
  • Develop and maintain an equipment / staff scheduling and training system to ensure resources are maintained, trained, and prepared to perform operations.
  • Perform regular checks on equipment, trucks, trailers, facilities, caches, and consumables.
  • Assist with inventory, stocking and ordering of equipment and supplies.
  • Provide support on and monitoring instrument calibrations and maintenance.
  • Coordinate assembly, maintenance, and inspections of equipment kits and bundles.
  • Work with Shop Manager with vehicle and equipment maintenance, delivery, and facility maintenance as necessary.
  • Lead facility development and organization projects.
  • Develop administrative and operational job aids and tools.

Team Leadership and Mentorship

  • Assist with staff selection and hiring alongside Human Resources and facilitate full orientation, onboarding, paperwork completion, and follow-up on training needs.
  • Provide effective leadership through example and sharing of knowledge and skills.
  • Develop and manage a program-specific training schedule for ERIS staff.
  • Create internal training curriculum in compliance with company policies, procedures, and Health & Safety goals.
  • Work with Health & Safety on training compliance goals.
  • Work with Health & Safety to identify training gaps.
  • Coordinate and conduct internal ERIS operational training.
  • Identify and facilitate external training opportunities through vendors.
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance to field staff.

title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:

title: Inventory Control Specialist-Spare Parts
description:
Company Background:

Del Conca USA is a leading manufacturer of residential and commercial porcelain tiles and outdoor pavers, proudly producing our products in the USA at our state-of-the-art factory. The Del Conca Group is one of the most significant industrial entities in the Italian ceramic tile industry, comprising four manufacturing companies – Ceramica Faetano, Ceramica del Conca, Pastorelli, and Del Conca USA Inc. – a business corporation – Produco – and the Cino Mularoni Foundation, which is dedicated to social and cultural initiatives. Today, the Del Conca Group is recognized internationally for the superior quality of its products, the excellence of its service, its innovative capabilities, and the distinguished design it offers. After years of substantial investments in production capacity and global sales growth, the Del Conca Group has established itself as one of the leading and most important ceramic tile groups in Europe.

The planning and design of each collection is conceived and carried out in Italy, in the Group’s own research facility. An across-the-board creative process, the fruit of intensive teamwork involving designers, laboratories, and quality technicians to ensure uniquely distinctive products; all made in the USA at the high-tech facility in Loudon, TN, the latest proud achievement of the Del Conca Group.

Position Summary

The Inventory Control Specialist – Spare Parts is responsible for controlling and maintaining spare parts inventory in support of manufacturing operations. This role ensures established inventory levels are maintained to achieve maximum operational effectiveness, accuracy, and availability of parts.

This position is for our day shift: 8am - 4:30pm M-F

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Maintain parts and supplies inventory by receiving, inspecting, verifying, identifying, storing, and recording inventory items.
  • Verify received orders against packing slips and original purchase orders.
  • Store received goods according to established inventory procedures.
  • Fill parts requests by reviewing requisitions, locating and retrieving inventory, and ordering special-request items as needed.
  • Maintain and update the parts database by entering additions, deletions, and corrections in designated inventory software.
  • Conduct physical inventory counts to verify accuracy.
  • Operate forklift trucks to store inventory and deliver goods to operating departments, offices, and work areas.
  • Interact with vendors regarding pricing, order status, delivery issues, and discrepancies.
  • Pick Up Parts from Vendors – Company Truck
  • Notify supervisor of any inventory shortages, discrepancies, or parts-related issues.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment in compliance with company standards and legal regulations.
  • Comply with OSHA and always company safety requirements.
  • Work with EHS monitoring safety equipment for compliance with OSHA standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned or required.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; equivalent experience considered.
  • I+ year of manufacturing experience preferred.
  • 2+ years of inventory control experience required.
  • SAP experience preferred
  • Familiarity with automated inventory systems and computer-based programs.
  • Experience with data entry and recordkeeping on PC-based systems.
  • Ability to utilize computers and inventory software to perform job duties.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed, and able to work independently.
  • Ability to consistently lift and move objects up to 50 pounds, with heavier weights as required at times
  • Clean driving records are a must.

Competency

  • Inventory Management: Strong understanding of inventory control principles, including receiving, storage, tracking, and cycle counting.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to accurately verify parts, quantities, documentation, and system entries to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Organization & Time Management: Effectively organizes inventory, prioritizes tasks, and manages time to meet operational needs.
  • Computer & System Proficiency: Comfortable using inventory management systems, databases, and standard computer applications.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to identify inventory discrepancies, shortages, or errors and take appropriate corrective action.
  • Safety Awareness: Follows OSHA and company safety procedures and maintains a clean, safe, and orderly work environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicates clearly with supervisors, maintenance teams, and vendors regarding parts needs and issues.
  • Vendor Interaction: Ability to work professionally with suppliers on pricing, delivery timelines, and order discrepancies.
  • Independence & Initiative: Works effectively with minimal supervision and takes initiative to maintain proper inventory levels.
  • Adaptability: Able to adjust priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment to support operational demands.

Physical Demands

Reasonable Accommodation Statement

The requirements listed in this job description are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA).

  • Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk, or hear.
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to hear and interpret alarms, equipment sounds, and verbal instructions in a manufacturing environment.
  • You must always wear required PPE, including safety glasses, cut resistant gloves, and safety shoes (steel or composite).

Work Environment

The work environment includes manufacturing, warehouse, and outdoor conditions. The employee may be exposed to weather conditions, moving equipment, forklifts, dust, and other industrial hazards. Noise levels are typically moderate to loud. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn as required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

title: Head of Audience & Subscriptions
description:
About LabX Media Group

LabX Media Group is a leading worldwide science publishing company that delivers meaningful industry content and integrated marketing solutions for the scientific community. LabX Media Group’s brands and product solutions deliver trusted, timely and deep information across print and digital products to empower our customers and advance their research.

We are looking for a Head of Audience & Subscriptions to join our team!

As part of the Marketing team, the Head of Audience & Subscriptions will lead and grow our print and digital circulation strategy for a large publication. The Head of Audience & Subscriptionswill oversee print circulation operations, subscriber retention, revenue optimization, and churn reduction while driving data informed audience growth initiatives across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage all aspects of print and digital circulation strategy for a large consumer-focused publication, with accountability for subscriber acquisition, retention, renewal performance, circulation growth, and audience engagement.
  • Develop and execute audience growth strategies that increase paid and qualified circulation, optimize subscriber lifetime value (LTV), reduce churn, and improve overall circulation profitability.
  • Utilize audience, subscription, and engagement data to make informed decisions that drive acquisition, retention, conversion, and revenue growth across multiple channels.
  • Plan and execute subscriber acquisition, renewal, win-back, and retention campaigns using segmentation, behavioral targeting, lifecycle marketing, and data-driven personalization strategies.
  • Build and optimize subscriber lifecycle programs from initial conversion through onboarding, engagement, renewal, gifts, reactivation, and long-term retention.
  • Develop test plans, trial offers, pricing strategies, promotional packages, and conversion optimization initiatives. Continuously measure performance and apply a disciplined test-and-learn approach to improve response rates, retention, and ROI.
  • Monitor and optimize key circulation and subscription metrics including subscriber growth, renewal rates, churn, engagement, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), conversion rates, and subscription revenue.
  • Own subscription revenue performance and circulation economics, including forecasting acquisition and retention results, monitoring profitability, and identifying opportunities to improve yield and operational efficiency.
  • Develop annual circulation forecasts, budgets, reporting, and performance analysis. Present recommendations and results to senior leadership based on measurable business outcomes.
  • Oversee all print circulation operations including fulfillment, production schedules, print order management, subscriber services, shipping, postal optimization, and newsstand distribution.
  • Manage relationships with fulfillment houses, printers, direct mail agencies, newsstand consultants, digital marketing partners, distribution vendors, and other third-party suppliers to ensure operational excellence and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with circulation reporting requirements, privacy regulations, subscription policies, and postal regulations. Manage relationships with audit organizations and maintain the integrity of subscriber data.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify audience trends, emerging technologies, subscription best practices, and growth opportunities that keep the publication ahead of the market.
  • Monitor email deliverability and optimize subscriber communications to improve inbox placement, open rates, click-through rates, engagement, retention, and conversion performance.
  • Develop and execute integrated audience development strategies that grow readership and drive traffic and engagement across print, digital, email, social media, events, newsletters, and advertiser-supported content programs.
  • Partner closely with editorial, sales, product, analytics, and marketing teams to align audience growth initiatives with broader business, content, and revenue goals.
  • Leverage advanced audience segmentation, cohort analysis, retention modeling, and performance reporting to identify opportunities for growth, improve subscriber experiences, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Continuously evaluate new channels, technologies, partnerships, and marketing opportunities to expand audience reach, improve subscription performance, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related
    field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in circulation management, audience development, or
    digital/print marketing, ideally within a media, publishing, B2B or B2C environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret audience data and translate insights
    into actionable strategies that drive measurable growth.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills; ability to manage multiple brands
    and campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Experience in/knowledge of the scientific industry is an asset.

Experience & Skills:

  • Expert working knowledge of subscription fulfillment software (Omeda, CDS).
  • Experience with e-mail marketing platforms and list segmentation best practices.
  • Experience with web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) and data
    visualization tools to monitor audience KPIs and campaign performance.
  • Hands-on experience with social media management; familiarity with emerging platforms
    and growth tactics.
  • Direct experience both executing and managing paid advertising efforts.
  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization; a disciplined, test-and-learn
    approach to campaign development capable of demonstrating clear ROI
  • Advanced knowledge of print fulfillment workflows, subscriber database management,
    subscription billing cycles, and postal regulations.

Compensation:

  • The expected salary range for this position is $85,000–$105,000 CAD per year, commensurate with
    experience. This range reflects benchmarked compensation for a Circulation Manager in the
    Canadian media and publishing sector. Benefits package includes health and dental coverage, paid
    vacation, and professional development support.

Application Procedure:

This position is remotely based and is open to all eligible candidates in Canada. Preference may be
given to candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone.

This job posting is for a current vacancy.

LabX Media Group is an enthusiastic equal opportunity employer that values diversity, equity, and
inclusion. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering a culture where
differences are valued and innovation thrives.

Reasonable accommodation is available for qualified individuals with disabilities, upon request
when contacted for an interview. We thank all candidates for applying. Only those candidates
selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please note: Our hiring process does not involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) for candidate
screening or decision-making. All evaluations are conducted by our human resources team and

hiring managers.
