title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in Romania.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

      • Employment Type: Full-time.

      • Recruitment Process: The process includes a screening call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the VP of Product, a case study with the VP of Product and DPO, and reference checks. Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.

title: Certification Specialist - Livestock Lead
company: Maine Organic Farmers and Gardeners Association
description:
MOFGA Certification Services, LLC (MCS) is hiring a full time Organic Certification Specialist (Livestock/Dairy focused) to join our team. MCS is a USDA-accredited organic certifier, certifying over 500 crop, livestock, and handling operations in Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts. The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. The ideal candidate will have education and experience in organic regulations, organic and/or sustainable farming methods and production, and familiarity with the various production scopes that MCS certifies. Experience in food processing is a plus. The Certification Specialist reports to the MCS Director and works collaboratively with MCS staff, specialists, and inspectors. This position requires some field work, including inspections, residue sampling, and investigations. Priority will be given to candidates who apply before November 13, 2026

Overview: The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. This position assesses compliance of an operation’s organic system plan, reviews inspection reports, and issues subsequent responses, primarily within the livestock and dairy scopes. This position works collaboratively with other certification specialists, inspection program manager, and inspectors, and conducts inspections and pesticide residue sampling as time allows. Certification Specialists also support the MCS quality management system, and may represent MCS at conferences or other MOFGA events. Contributing to MCS policy development, writing pieces for MCS’ newsletter, The Organic Sprout, is an expectation for this position.

Supervisor: Director of MOFGA Certification Services

Position: Salaried. Federal Fair Labor Standards Act exempt. The employee is not eligible for overtime payment. This position is part of the MOFGA Workers United Union bargaining unit.

Work Week: 40 hours - Monday through Friday. Additional evening and weekend hours as required.

Salary Range: This is a salaried position, with a starting salary range of $50,000-$55,000 annually, dependent upon experience. MOFGA has an excellent benefits package, including paid medical, dental and vision insurance, and parental leave. Employees receive a generous paid time off package, including vacation and sick time, three personal days, two week-long office closures, 14 paid holidays annually, and a sabbatical after seven years of employment.

Location: This position is remote, requiring travel within MCS’ service territory, and off-site visits to client’s farms and production facilities. The service territory includes the state of Maine, the state of New Hampshire, and the northeastern areas of Massachusetts. Our offices are located in Unity, Maine and staff are welcome to work from this office as much as they like. Will need to travel to Unity for occasional meetings and required participation in the Common Ground Country Fair. This position is required to be based within the MCS service territory.

Requirements:

  • Education or experience in organic certification or regulatory compliance, including inspections and auditing.
  • Knowledge of the USDA-National Organic Program standards, especially as it applies to crop, livestock/dairy, , and processing.
  • Working knowledge of organic or sustainable crop and livestock farms, dairies, and food processing.
  • A demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, especially in writing.
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Proficiency in computer software, including databases and collaborative platforms.
  • Strong interpersonal skills that welcome collaboration and constructive feedback.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle
  • A commitment to MOFGA’s mission and values.
  • IOIA training and prior organic inspection experience a plus
  • College degree in agriculture or related field a plus
  • Must be able to travel to attend meetings, training workshops and conferences.
  • Participate in MOFGA’s Common Ground Country Fair as needed.

Certification Specialist Responsibilities:

  • Performs certification activities for clients including these specific activities:
    • Perform technical reviews of organic system plans, primarily within the livestock and dairy scope. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Review inspection reports for these same clients. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Assists applicants by explaining the organic standards and the certification process, encouraging them to take advantage of the technical services offered by MOFGA.
    • Pursues adverse actions with clients in accordance with MCS policy and in coordination with colleagues/supervisors.
    • Keeps track of clients; assures that auditable files are in good order.
  • Conduct annual, investigative and/or unannounced inspections or residue sampling as time allows.
  • Performs material review of products as needed and in conjunction with other MCS staff and agency affiliates.
  • Investigates complaints to protect the integrity of the organic label. Pursues adverse actions, as necessary.
  • Participation in MCS internal audits and NOP accreditation audits.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as deemed necessary to carry out MOFGA’s certification program and maintain accreditation with USDA.

Physical Requirements: Ability to walk long distances over rough terrain; occasional light lifting; ability to drive and travel long distances by car. Able to work in outdoor conditions that include all types of seasonal weather, as well as, inside environments where there may be loud noises or strong odors. Ability to sit for long periods to complete computer-based work, participate in meetings, and conduct organic inspections, whether in person or over video conference platforms.

The Maine Organic Farmers and Gardeners Association (MOFGA) is a broad-based community that supports farmers, empowers people to feed their communities, and advocates for an organic future. Our vision is a future where local organic farming nourishes all people, and sustains thriving ecosystems, healthy communities, and fair economies. MOFGA is committed to creating an inclusive and sustainable workplace that reflects this mission. MOFGA is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, age, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, political orientation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We strongly encourage BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, and People of Color) and LGBTQ+ individuals, as well as veterans to apply.Salary: $50,000-$55,000 annual salary

title: Account Services Coordinator, Apparel
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Who We Are:

Steve Madden is a global fashion company known for its innovative, trend-driven footwear, accessories, and apparel. Founded in 1990 in Queens, New York, the company has grown from a footwear startup into a globally recognized fashion organization with a portfolio of leading brands, including Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger London, Dolce Vita, Betsey Johnson, Carvela, Blondo, and ATM.

General Summary

The responsibilities described below are considered essential functions of the role. This position is based in our NYC office and requires working on-site five days per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Steve Madden Apparel & ATM Collection: Acting as a liaison between account executives and boutique wholesale customers across all U.S. regions.
  • Facilitate D2C operations for Steve Madden Apparel, directly fulfilling all online U.S. customer orders in an accurate and timely manner
  • Use CRMs such as Infor M3, JOOR, and Qlik Sense to strategically manage allocation and fulfillment of all monthly and immediate POs to meet and exceed wholesale clients’ expectations
  • Accurately manage customer data by providing invoices, order tracking, order confirmations, and more upon request
  • Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines with support and resources as needed
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

Specific Job Skills:

title: Maintenance Planner

title: Senior Product Coordinator
description:
When you join Okanagan College, you’re joining a team that’s transforming lives and communities.
Every course you create, every student you support and every connection you build, it all matters.
Be a part of a vibrant campus community, where the work you do every day truly makes a difference.

Desired Start Date: November 16, 2026

Appointment End Date : July 16, 2027

Salary range: $35.07 to $40.07

Bargaining unit: Support

Special Instructions to Applicants:

8 month contract with possibility of extension

Shortlisted internal candidates must notify the current Support Staff Bargaining Chairperson and People Services if they want a Union Observer during interviews and final selection of candidates

Your Opportunity

  • The Senior Product Coordinator, Digital Experience drives the priorities and continuous evolution of key digital products that serve learners, employees, and the institution. This role identifies opportunities for improvement, builds the case for change, and takes ownership of product vision, roadmap development, backlog management, and prioritization. This isn't a support role — it's an ownership role, accountable for guiding initiatives from concept through to implementation and ensuring digital products deliver meaningful, measurable outcomes.
    Reporting to the Associate Director, Digital Experience, the Senior Product Coordinator sits at the intersection of business, technology, and user experience — translating complex organizational needs into clear roadmaps, aligning cross-functional teams around shared priorities, and ensuring every product decision connects back to institutional objectives and real value for the people the College serves.

Functions and Duties

•Lead and evolve the digital experience vision for learners and staff — ensuring it directly supports Okanagan College's digital strategy and delivers measurable outcomes.
•Champion user-centered thinking across every product decision, from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
•Leverage analytics, user feedback, and service insights to validate priorities, measure performance, and drive ongoing optimization.
• Ensure solutions are accessible, intuitive, and built around the real needs of the people who use
them every day.
• Lead the product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous
improvement, with accountability for user experience and business impact.
• Identify and prioritize initiatives across products and platforms, translating complex business and
user needs into a clear, outcome-driven roadmap.
• Develop forward-looking plans for how systems, integrations, and platforms need to evolve —
building a cohesive, scalable, and future-ready digital environment.
• Lead the full product lifecycle: discovery, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement —
with accountability for both user experience and business impact.
• Work closely with the AI & Automations Development Team Lead to ensure product priorities
and technical feasibility are always in sync.
• Lead backlog management, sprint planning, acceptance criteria, retrospectives, and release
coordination to keep delivery consistent and efficient.
• Coordinate across technical, design, and operational teams to ship high-quality, user-centered
solutions — balancing speed, quality, and value.
• Support change management and release readiness to ensure solutions land well, get adopted,
and deliver their intended impact.
• Identify opportunities to automate workflows, simplify processes, and reduce friction across
institutional digital services.
• Stay curious about emerging digital trends, tools, and capabilities — and bring relevant insights
back into product planning.
• Explore how AI-enabled services, automation, and modern platforms can meaningfully improve
learner and staff experiences.
• Contribute to the evaluation of new technologies, platforms, and approaches that could advance
the College's digital strategy.
• Build strong, collaborative relationships across academic, administrative, and technical teams —
creating shared understanding and alignment on priorities.
• Communicate product vision, priorities, decisions, and outcomes clearly and consistently to
stakeholders at all levels.
• Provide transparency into product direction and trade-offs, enabling informed decision-making
across the organization.

Education and Experience

  • A four-year degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a
    related discipline — plus at least 4 years of hands-on experience in digital product ownership,
    business transformation, business analysis, or technical project delivery in Agile environments.
    Or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Skills and Abilities

• Demonstrated experience configuring and supporting enterprise digital platforms, contributing to process improvement or automation initiatives, and leading discovery, user research, and UAT activities.
• Strong Agile fundamentals — sprint planning, backlog refinement, iterative delivery, and retrospectives.
• The ability to turn user feedback, analytics, and service insights into clear requirements, confident priorities, and well-communicated product decisions.
• Experience with wireframes, prototypes, and user flows; a solid grasp of UX principles and accessibility standards; and comfort with analytics tools like Power BI or Excel.
• A natural communicator who can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, and a sharp, organized thinker who stays calm when priorities compete.
• Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), or a similar designation is considered an asset.

Our Values

  • Students first: Creating meaningful life-long educational opportunities of the highest quality for alumni, current, and future students is at the heart of everything we do.
  • Community: We are one College. We enthusiastically embrace the opportunity to work with, learn from, and support everyone we encounter collaboratively and collegially.
  • Respect: We welcome, embrace, and celebrate that which make us unique in creating an environment in which every individual is valued, affirming our commitment to human dignity for all.
  • Courage: We are courageous in our actions in areas that contribute to positive change in our communities and beyond. We have the courage to be vulnerable. We are truthful, sincere, and act ethically with honesty and fairness.
  • Relationships: We steward meaningful relationships built on a foundation of reciprocity. We are compassionate, empathic, and care for the holistic well-being of students, employees, community members, and the land.
  • Distinction: We choose activities in which we can achieve excellence and positively impact society.
Okanagan College is committed to increasing the equitable and inclusive participation of marginalized people in all aspects of college life. title: Deployment Strategist  - Canada
description:
Why Ethicrithm?

Ethicrithm Inc. is a Palantir partner serving clients across North America. We specialize in integrating and structuring enterprise data, developing AI-driven solutions, and implementing intelligent operating systems with Palantir Foundry and AIP. We deliver secure, scalable, and impactful solutions that optimize business operations and drive measurable returns on investment, impact and results. We’re building a high-performance team of humble, helpful, and client-oriented teammates.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you own the successful delivery and real-world impact of Palantir Foundry for our clients. Your role is to deeply understand clients’ most critical operational problems and translate those needs into workflows and capabilities that drive meaningful outcomes.

You work closely with client teams across the organization—from frontline operators to executive leaders—to understand how decisions are made, what the data reveals, and how Foundry can be applied to improve those decisions in practice. You guide deployments from early problem framing through execution, ensuring solutions are adopted, trusted, and impactful.

You excel in ambiguous, fastmoving environments, creating clarity by forming hypotheses, testing assumptions, and iterating quickly to move clients toward their highest value outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Scoping: Engage with stakeholders through workshops and interviews across the client’s business to deeply understand their business processes, friction points, strategic goals, and data landscape.
  • Solution Design: Develop capabilities that deliver impact in the client’s business by determining how Foundry can be implemented against business problems.
  • Deployment Governance: Oversee the governance framework for deployments, ensuring shared understanding of objectives, scope, timelines, and execution approach. Track progress, surface risks, and communicate value delivered throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Driving User Adoption: Drive user adoption through training, friction removal, and sustained partnership with end users.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build relationships with executives, operators, and technical leads; align teams on shared goals; and navigate competing priorities to keep delivery focused on outcomes.
  • Value Realization: Define and measure the impact of deployments and demonstrate the value delivered to clients.
  • Services Feedback: Surface insights from the field to provide tangible recommendations on Ethicrithm’s practices.
  • Field Engagement: Go onsite to meet with client operators, understand the critical questions they need to answer, and locate their highest-impact problems firsthand.
  • Data Identification: Identify the relevant datasets that matter most by deeply engaging with client workflows and understanding how data connects to the decisions clients are trying to improve.
  • Growth and Expansion: Scope out potential engagements in new industries and expanding geographies, helping to shape where Ethicrithm goes next.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Technical Aptitude: A strong understanding of software and data concepts. You can write code that works, architect solutions, and solve technical problems alongside Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs).
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically about client challenges and develop innovative solutions
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of business principles and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Project Management: Proven project management skills, including experience developing and executing project plans
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify and address potential roadblocks
  • Client-Facing Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with clients. Empathy and a desire to understand client needs
  • Ability to travel in Canada and the US (approx 5% travel) without the need for Visas or other documents requiring processing time

Preferred with flexibility for the exceptional candidates

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
  • Experience designing and delivering technical solutions
  • Deep experience working with data (analysis, modeling, data engineering)
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP
  • Experience with Python and/or TypeScript

Research shows candidates from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed criteria. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Total Rewards

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and career growth. This includes a competitive salary, equity participation to share in our success, a retirement contribution program, and health benefits. Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with four weeks of vacation, five personal days, and the flexibility of working from home. We also provide ample opportunities for career advancement within our dynamic and growing organization.

Ethicrithm Inc. is committed to employment equity and building an inclusive workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those from equity-deserving groups. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and applicable human rights legislation, accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process. Please contact us if you require accommodation at any stage.

Ethicrithm uses artificial intelligence to assist in analyzing applications as part of our recruitment process.

title: Bilingual Logistics Coordinator
description:
General Summary of Job Duties

The Bilingual Logistics Coordinator is responsible for delivering a high level of customer service through effective communication, attention to detail, and strong organizational skills. This role coordinates all aspects of logistics operations in support of customers, including booking shipments, coordinating dispatch and intermodal logistics, and managing equipment control. The coordinator serves as the primary liaison between customers, trucking partners, terminals, and other vendors to ensure seamless cargo movement. Additional responsibilities include managing accessorial billing, processing vendor and customer invoices, resolving service issues, ensuring regulatory compliance, and contributing to process improvement initiatives.

Specific Essential Job Duties

  • Coordinate end-to-end customer shipments, including booking creation, pickup and delivery arrangements, dispatching, and communication with truckers and terminals.
  • Collaborate with terminal operators to manage load lists, perform reconciliations, and ensure accuracy of cargo loaded versus expected load plans.
  • Monitor and manage intermodal shipments, ensuring smooth handoffs between modes of transport and resolving any logistical disruptions.
  • Maintain accurate cargo tracking and tracing records, providing timely updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate cargo release processes within the San Juan terminal system, ensuring compliance with port requirements and timely delivery.
  • Serve as a key liaison between customers, truckers, terminals, railroads, and other vendors to coordinate logistics and resolve issues.
  • Manage customer inquiries and service requests received via phone or shared email inbox with professionalism and urgency.
  • Handle accounts receivable functions, including generating and issuing standalone invoices for assessorial charges not covered under standard freight or bill of lading rates (e.g., labor, equipment misuse); ensure accuracy and timely processing of customer charges.
  • Manage equipment control functions, including usage tracking, billing for accessorial charges, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Review and process accounts payable invoices from trucking vendors and other service providers.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable government and regulatory requirements, including U.S. Customs procedures, Puerto Rico Hacienda tax filings, wharfage fees, and SED (Shipper’s Export Declaration) filings. Promote safe and secure cargo transport practices in accordance with local and federal laws.
  • Maintain updated customer profiles in the back-office system to ensure accuracy in documentation and billing.
  • Identify service exceptions, troubleshoot escalated issues, and implement timely resolutions.
  • Provide input to management on process improvement initiatives and support departmental projects as needed.
  • Abide by company HSEQ policies and procedures.
  • This job description is not exhaustive; additional duties may be assigned as needed. This role may evolve in response to changes in industry practices and technological advancements.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish required.
  • Prior experience with logistics or shipping software; familiarity with CargoWise is a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel; experience working with databases preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand and follow logical processes.
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills, with a courteous and professional demeanor.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong accuracy in data entry and time management.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision or collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Demonstrated discretion and ability to handle confidential information with professionalism.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • General administrative or clerical experience preferred, including mail, filing, and document handling.
  • Must be flexible and adaptable to evolving responsibilities and technology, with a willingness to perform additional duties as assigned to support departmental needs.

Working Conditions

  • This position is based in a professional office environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • Work is typically performed in a climate-controlled setting with standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
  • Occasional lifting of office supplies or documents weighing up to 25 pounds may be required.
  • Minimal exposure to physical risk; however, employees must follow all company safety protocols, including proper ergonomic practices and general workplace safety procedures.
  • May be required to attend safety briefings or training relevant to the maritime industry to support understanding of company operations.
  • Must adhere to all workplace policies and contribute to a safe, organized, and professional office environment.

title: Data & Raiser's Edge Specialist
description:
Overview:

Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary is a multidenominational, evangelical graduate school committed to equipping Christian leaders to think theologically, engage globally, and live biblically. With nearly 1,400 students across campuses in Massachusetts, North Carolina, Florida, and online, Gordon-Conwell’s student body represents more than eighty-five denominations and fifty countries. The seminary offers master’s and doctoral programs—delivered in English, Spanish, and Portuguese—that combine academic excellence, spiritual formation, and a deep commitment to Scripture. Its 12,000 alumni serve Christ through ministry in the church, the academy, and the workplace. Gordon-Conwell is accredited by the Association of Theological Schools, the New England Commission of Higher Education, and the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs.


Position Summary

Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary is seeking a Data & Raiser’s Edge Specialist to strengthen the systems, data, reporting, and operational processes that support the Seminary’s Advancement efforts. This position will serve as the primary internal resource for Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and effective use of donor and prospect information.


Key Responsibilities

1. Advancement Services & Team Management

• Supervise and provide direction to the Advancement Services Coordinator, who is responsible for gift processing and related Advancement services.

• Recruit, train, schedule, and supervise Advancement student workers as appropriate.

• Establish clear workflows, priorities, and expectations for Advancement Services activities.

• Ensure that gift processing, data entry, reporting, acknowledgments, and other Advancement support functions are completed accurately and on schedule.

• Review work processes regularly and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service to the Advancement team.

• Provide training and ongoing support to Advancement staff and student workers regarding database procedures, data standards, and appropriate use of Raiser’s Edge.

• Serve as a resource and problem-solver for day-to-day Advancement Services questions and issues.

2. Raiser’s Edge Management & Data Integrity

• Serve as the primary administrator and internal resource for Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and consistent donor, prospect, gift, pledge, and contact records.

• Establish and maintain standards for data entry, documentation, coding, and record maintenance.

• Regularly review the database for duplicate records, incomplete information, inconsistencies, and other data-quality issues.

• Develop and maintain processes that ensure timely and accurate recording of donor activity.

• Identify opportunities to improve Raiser’s Edge workflows, functionality, and reporting capabilities.

• Ensure appropriate confidentiality and security of donor information.

• Coordinate with Blackbaud and other vendors or technical resources when needed to resolve system issues or improve functionality.

3. Gift Processing & Reconciliation

• Oversee the gift processing function and provide direction to the Advancement Services Coordinator.

• Ensure timely and accurate recording of gifts, pledges, recurring gifts, tribute gifts, soft credits, and other transactions.

• Establish appropriate procedures for gift entry, coding, documentation, acknowledgment, and reconciliation.

• Work closely with Finance to reconcile Advancement records with financial records.

• Identify and resolve gift-processing discrepancies or delays.

• Ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails are maintained.

• Monitor gift-processing workflows to ensure that donors receive timely and accurate acknowledgment.

4. Reporting & Analytics

• Develop and maintain reliable reports for Advancement staff, Seminary leadership, and the Board of Trustees.

• Produce regular reports on fundraising activity, donor engagement, giving trends, and portfolio performance.

• Develop dashboards and other tools that provide a clear picture of Advancement performance.

• Track key fundraising indicators, including donor retention, acquisition, LYBUNT/SYBUNT, giving trends, major gift activity, and pipeline health.

• Provide accurate data for annual giving, major gifts, campaigns, stewardship, and other fundraising initiatives.

• Support revenue forecasting and goal setting through accurate and timely data analysis.

• Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities within the donor database and communicate them to Advancement leadership.

• Translate complex data into clear and useful information for non-technical staff and leadership.

5. Prospect Research & Donor Information

• Support the Advancement team with prospect research and donor intelligence.

• Maintain accurate prospect information, including giving history, relationships, philanthropic interests, and capacity information.

• Conduct research and wealth screening as needed using available research tools.

• Prepare research profiles and briefing materials for donor visits, solicitations, campaign activity, and leadership meetings.

• Identify potential upgrade and major gift opportunities based on donor data and giving patterns.

• Ensure relevant prospect and donor information is appropriately recorded in Raiser’s Edge.

6. Portfolio & Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate records of donor and prospect portfolios.

• Track movement of prospects and donors through the fundraising pipeline.

• Monitor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship activity.

• Provide gift officers and Advancement leadership with data needed to manage their portfolios effectively.

• Develop reports that identify gaps, opportunities, overdue activity, and prospects requiring follow-up.

• Support the Advancement team in establishing and monitoring measurable fundraising goals and KPIs.

7. Advancement Strategy & Collaboration

• Partner with Major Gifts, Annual Giving, Marketing and Communications, Finance, and other departments to ensure accurate and consistent Advancement information.

• Provide data-driven recommendations to inform fundraising strategy and resource allocation.

• Support campaign planning, annual giving, major gift initiatives, stewardship, and Board reporting.

• Participate in Advancement meetings and provide relevant data and analysis to support decision-making.

• Help develop and implement policies and procedures for Advancement data management, gift processing, and reporting.

• Continually evaluate systems and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, staff productivity, and donor service.


Key Competencies

• Data Management & Accuracy: Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.

• Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of CRM systems, with demonstrated expertise in Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and reporting skills are strongly preferred.

• Analytical Ability: Ability to analyze fundraising data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into clear recommendations and actionable information.

• Supervision & Team Leadership: Ability to provide clear direction, training, feedback, and accountability to the Advancement Services Coordinator and student workers.

• Organization: Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet recurring reporting deadlines.

• Confidentiality & Discretion: High ethical standards and demonstrated ability to handle confidential donor, financial, and personal information appropriately.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information and data insights clearly to non-technical colleagues.

• Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively across Advancement, Finance, Marketing, and Seminary leadership while maintaining a service-oriented approach.

• Commitment to the mission, vision, and values of Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary and willingness to abide by the Seminary’s Statement of Faith and Community Life Statement.


Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree required, relevant graduate degree preferred.

• 3–5 years of experience in advancement services, development operations, CRM/database management, fundraising analytics, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience working with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge or a comparable fundraising CRM.

• Experience with gift processing, donor data management, reporting, and reconciliation preferred.

• Experience supervising staff or student workers preferred.

• Experience with prospect research and wealth screening tools preferred.

• Experience in nonprofit, higher education, or Christian higher education preferred.


Application Process

Please apply through Gordon-Conwell’s Career Center available here:


Please include these documents in either Microsoft Word or PDF formats:

• A cover letter explaining your interest in the position preferred.

• A formal CV that includes the names of at least three references required.

No hard copy materials, please. Opportunities to interview will be made available at the search committee’s initiative. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

title: Surgical Tech (Per Diem)
description:
Job Summary:

The Surgical Technologist is an integral member of the perioperative surgical team responsible for assisting in the preparation and performance of surgical procedures while maintaining a safe, sterile, and efficient operating room environment. Working under the direction of the Registered Nurse and in collaboration with surgeons, anesthesia personnel, Surgical Assistants, and other members of the perioperative team, the Surgical Technologist prepares the operating room, surgical instruments, supplies, equipment, and sterile field for operative procedures. The Surgical Technologist functions primarily in the scrub role, anticipates the needs of the surgeon, passes instruments and supplies during procedures, maintains sterile technique, assists with surgical counts, and supports patient safety throughout the perioperative process.

Position Qualifications/Requirements:

Education/Experience:

  • Successful completion of a formal Surgical Technology program or an equivalent education/training pathway recognized by an accepted national surgical technology certifying organization.
  • Graduate of a Surgical Technology program accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP) or Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES) preferred.
  • Associate degree in Surgical Technology or a related healthcare discipline preferred.
  • Previous Surgical Technologist experience in an acute-care hospital operating room preferred.
  • Previous experience scrubbing surgical procedures in multiple specialties referred.

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association or other hospital-approved provider required.
  • Current nationally recognized Surgical Technologist certification, including one of the following:
    • Certified Surgical Technologist (CST®) through the National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting (NBSTSA); or
    • Tech in Surgery – Certified, TS-C (NCCT) through the National Center for Competency Testing.
    • Certified Surgical Technologist (CST®) through NBSTSA preferred.

Skills/Requirements:

  • Knowledge of surgical asepsis and sterile technique.
  • Knowledge of operating room policies, practices, and procedures.
  • Knowledge of surgical anatomy, physiology, terminology, and procedural sequence.
  • Knowledge of surgical instrumentation, equipment, supplies, sutures, medications, and implants commonly used in operative procedures.
  • Ability to identify surgical instruments and their appropriate uses.
  • Ability to anticipate surgeon and surgical team needs during operative procedures.
  • Ability to organize and maintain an efficient sterile field.
  • Understanding of surgical counts and prevention of retained surgical items.
  • Knowledge of infection prevention and Standard Precautions.
  • Knowledge of appropriate handling of surgical specimens.
  • Knowledge of appropriate handling and preparation of reusable surgical instruments.
  • Understanding of manufacturer's instructions for use as applicable to surgical equipment and instrumentation.
  • Strong manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination.
  • Ability to maintain concentration and attention to detail during lengthy surgical procedures.
  • Ability to function effectively in stressful, urgent, and emergency situations.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced perioperative environment.
  • Ability to recognize breaks in sterile technique and respond appropriately.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with physicians, nurses, anesthesia personnel, and other members of the healthcare team.
  • Ability to accept direction and work collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary surgical team.
  • Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and demonstrate professional conduct at all times.

location: 2  A Fulton Count, Atlanta, GA, US
description:
Position: Cat Pathways Coordinator

Department: Client Services/Placement

Reports To: Pathway Programs Manager

Location: 1251 Fulton Industrial Blvd SW Atlanta, GA 30336

Summary:

LifeLine Animal Project is committed to the care and welfare of pets and the people who love them. The values we exhibit as an organization show the strength of our staff, our leadership and our community. We expect all employees to exhibit LifeLine’s core values as we complete daily tasks, provide services to clients and care for our animals.

The Cat Pathways Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the shelter foster cat program, including the behavioral assessment and placement planning for cats and kittens within the shelter. This role supports the general coordination and counseling of fosters caring for shelter cats and kittens.

Essential Job Functions:

This represents a list of essential job duties. Other duties or special projects may be assigned as needed.

Uphold the standards and values of LifeLine Animal Project:

Save Lives -- Build Community -- Be Exceptional Stewards -- Be Courageous --

Be Compassionate -- Take Responsibility -- Respect, Embrace and Celebrate Diversity

Customer Service and Administrative Responsibilities:

  • Provide excellent customer service and communications to clients, coworkers, fosters, and volunteers. Welcome visitors with a friendly, compassionate, and professional demeanor.
  • Respect, embrace and celebrate diversity by always operating with a judgement-free mindset when greeting and working with visitors.
  • Coordinate with Rescue Coordinator on rescue placement of cats and kittens.
  • Conduct a daily inventory to determine placement options.
  • Work with Pathway Coordinators and other departments to make sure that all foster needs are met in a timely manner.
  • Manage the Foster Coach Team.
  • Courageously collaborate with relevant staff and departments to address specific behavior needs and support cats in foster and to address any issues or concerns that arise.
  • Exhibit exceptional stewardship by maintaining the foster module in the shelter database to keep track of foster pets housed outside of the shelter.
  • Work with Veterinary staff to schedule vaccines, surgery, appointments as needed. Provide appointment information to foster and follow-up if appointments are missed. Reschedule as needed.
  • Take responsibility to Identify and create efficiencies throughout the program.
  • Handle customer service issues and more serious situations like lost cats, cat bites, and fading kittens.
  • Assist Pathway Programs Manager in developing strategic placement plans for cats.

Animal Behavior and Care Responsibilities:

  • Train fosters, volunteers and employees on the proper care of cats and kittens of all ages and proper enrichment techniques.
  • Counsel fosters. Answer questions, provide additional training and support as needed. Stay connected to short- and long-term fosters with follow-up phone calls, emails and visits. Maintain connection even when fosters are not housing an animal.
  • Be willing to work flexible hours and be on call if needed for foster emergencies.
  • Work with Veterinary staff on medical treatment of cats and kittens in foster care in order to advance LifeLine’s mission to save lives.
  • Implement programs to enhance cat and kitten adoptions and foster placement.

General Responsibilities:

  • Provide back up as needed to other foster roles within the department.
  • Have a shelter presence to handle onsite foster customer service experiences and assist in tasks relating to cat foster placements such as matchmaking, introductions, behavior and medical consults, and handoffs.
  • Maintain a general understanding of all shelter operations, including animal care, adoption policies, volunteer opportunities, foster programs and any other operational processes.
  • Stay informed about current animals in the shelter, including their needs, personalities, and status.
  • Help build a community of animal welfare advocates by supporting and engaging the volunteers who aid the placement teams.
  • Continue education by participating in LifeLine’s 40-hour annual training requirement.
  • Maintain a clean and tidy work area.
  • Other tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

  • Compassion for animals and the people who love and care for them.
  • Passion for animal welfare and a strong understanding of animal care.
  • Ability to serve the public and fellow employees with honesty and integrity.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse groups.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Proficiency in basic computer applications and experience with database systems is a plus.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and to bend and reach to perform assigned work activities.
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Comfortable working with dogs and cats of all sizes, breeds, and temperaments.
  • Ability to follow safety protocols and handle challenging situations with calmness and professionalism.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple departments to ensure efficient shelter operations.
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and remain composed under pressure.
  • Ability to handle seeing and dealing with animals that have been abused, neglected or treated cruelly.
  • Must be able to work weekends, holidays, and varying shifts based on shelter needs.
  • Must have a means of travel that ensures prompt arrival for work shifts.
  • Must pass a background check.

Education and/or Experience:

High school diploma or equivalent; college degree or relevant coursework preferred.

18 years or older required, 23 years or older preferred for the purposes of being added to group vehicle insurance policy.

One or more years’ experience in animal related field or animal sheltering preferred.

Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, or a similar role is highly desirable.

Fear Free Sheltering preferred.

While performing the duties of this job, employee may be exposed to unpleasant kennel smells. May have to handle dogs and cats that are stray, injured, diseased or vicious.

description:
Come join UMH Properties, Inc. and make a difference!


UMH Properties, Inc. is a publicly traded Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE:UMH) with over 50 years in the manufactured housing industry. As a company that provides high-quality affordable homes and well-cared for communities in eleven states, we know that our company is only as strong as our people. We are looking for a Full-time Maintenance person for our Forest Park Village Community. The purpose of a Maintenance position is to provide overall community groundskeeping and maintenance as well as perform repairs as needed to all community owned homes and lots. Maintenance employees must uphold the UMH standards for professionalism, quality and safety in all work performed.


Maintenance Staff Job Description

Job Purpose


The purpose of a Maintenance position is to provide overall community groundskeeping and maintenance as well as perform repairs as needed to all community owned homes and lots. Maintenance employees must uphold the UMH standards for professionalism, quality and safety in all work performed.

Job Duties

  • Drive UMH vehicles through the community on a daily basis to inspect all common areas.
  • Record violations observed during daily inspections
  • Repair and maintain community-owned homes and lots.
  • Maintain community grounds including but not limited to mowing lawns, weed eating, removing leaves and debris, plowing snow, shoveling sidewalks.
  • Keep work areas clean and safe. Cleanup should occur several times throughout the day, with trash and waste disposed of in approved containers, drips and spills wiped up immediately, and equipment and tools put away as work is completed. The following areas must remain clear of obstructions: aisles/exits, fire extinguishers and emergency equipment, all electrical breakers, controls and switches.
  • Ensure that a ll company vehicles and equipment are maintained and serviced regularly.
  • In communities where this is required: Take daily readings from the water plant and inspect the pump stations, well-houses and treatment plants.

  • Complete periodic training to safely work with hazardous chemicals. Be familiar with and comply with the Company’s Hazard Communication Program ● Use and move heavy equipment.
  • Safely operate a variety of power tools and hand tools
  • Follow lockout procedures of energy isolating devices whenever maintenance or servicing is done on machines or equipment.
  • Communicate professionally and respectfully with coworkers, managers and community residents.

Physical requirements of the job

  • Stand for the majority of the workday.
  • Frequently lift objects over 20 pounds during the work day.
  • Occasionally kneel and crawl as required to perform certain maintenance duties such as working under homes.
  • Use of power tools and hand tools
  • Use of heavy equipment and moving heavy equipment

Work Environment

  • Working both indoors and outdoors
  • Exposure to elements of nature such as varying climates and weather conditions, uneven terrain, insects, animals, etc.

Work Schedule

  • Full-time schedule, Monday through Friday. Base hours are approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Overtime work is required and may be assigned on a regular basis or on a rotating schedule dependent upon community staffing and community needs.
  • Overtime work may be required on weekends and holidays.
  • Overtime responsibilities include answering incoming calls from residents or coworkers on a company-provided cell phone, assessing and responding to emergencies in the community including, but not limited to, emergency repairs, water leaks and snow plowing.
  • In-person attendance is an essential function of this position.

Job classification

This is a non-exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act. Non-exempt employees will be eligible for overtime pay in weeks where total hours worked exceed forty hours.

Required qualifications

  • Valid driver’s license and a safe driving record
  • A broad range of experience in home repairs, general plumbing, grounds maintenance and the operation of heavy equipment.
  • Snow plow experience
  • Ability to prioritize safety in all job duties and attend periodic safety trainings assigned by UMH Properties
  • Time management skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently to complete job duties
  • Compensation is negotiable based on experience and skill level

UMH offers employees a range of benefits:

  • Competitive wages with options for annual bonuses and pay increases
  • Sales positions include the option to earn commission

  • Generous paid time off
  • Company-paid life insurance for full-time employees
  • Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision insurance

title: Bilingual Clinician - Substance Use & Co-Occurring Disorders
description:
Overview

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit human services organization that has strengthened communities and changed lives since 1943. As the largest provider of licensed outpatient behavioral health services and one of the largest human services agencies in Westchester County, WJCS serves more than 20,000 individuals each year through over 80 innovative programs. Our services support people of all ages, backgrounds, and abilities, providing compassionate, high-quality care and resources.


WJCS is seeking a Bilingual (English/Spanish) Clinician to join our Substance Use & Co-Occurring Disorders Treatment Programs team in Peekskill. In this role, you will provide integrated, evidence-based assessment and treatment services for individuals with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders within a New York State OASAS outpatient clinic operating under the Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) model.


Salary Range: $65,000–$90,000 annually, based on licensure.



Responsibilities

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide person-centered individual, family, and group counseling services.
  • Deliver integrated substance use and co-occurring disorder treatment using evidence-based practices.
  • Provide Encompass services, including support for Concerned Significant Others (CSOs) utilizing Community Reinforcement and Family Training (CRAFT) and Invitation to Change (ITC) approaches.
  • Complete comprehensive assessments, treatment plans, safety plans, and ongoing clinical documentation in accordance with agency, OASAS, and CCBHC standards.
  • Maintain timely, accurate, and compliant clinical documentation within the electronic health record.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary team members to coordinate integrated, whole-person care.
  • Coordinate care with community providers and referral sources to support continuity of care.
  • Meet established productivity and performance expectations.
  • Provide evening clinic coverage, as needed, generally up to two evenings per week until 7:00 p.m.



Requirements

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

  • Masters Degree in Social Work or Mental Health Counseling from an accredited school.
  • CASAC-T/CASAC credentialing stronly preferred, or willing to obtain within the first year of employment.
  • New York State licensure as an LMSW, LMHC, or LCSW, strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of evidence-based practices for the treatment of substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders.
  • Experience working in substance use treatment.
  • Familiarity with Motivational Interviewing (MI), trauma-informed care, harm reduction, and person-centered approaches to treatment.
  • Experience delivering integrated care within an outpatient behavioral health or Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) setting preferred.
  • Interest or experience in working with Concerned Significant Others (CSOs) utilizing Community Reinforcement and Family Training (CRAFT) and Invitation to Change (ITC) approaches preferred.
  • Strong assessment, communication, documentation, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.
  • Proficiency with computer skills and electronic health records.



What WJCS has to offer you

In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:


  • Generous paid time off
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
  • 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
  • Ongoing Professional Development and Training
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
  • Disability and life insurance
  • Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives




WJCS INC. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (LatAm)
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.

  • You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.

  • You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.

  • You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • You are highly proficient in Figma, with extensive experience in wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, and scalable design systems.

  • You have a strong understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, interaction design, and responsive design, paired with a keen eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and detail.

  • You have a solid understanding of web development principles, including HTML5, CSS3, front-end capabilities and limitations, and web accessibility standards (WCAG AA).

  • You are a strategic and creative problem solver who can balance user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements to develop thoughtful design solutions.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy giving and receiving constructive feedback, and are comfortable guiding fellow designers while remaining adaptable to other creative disciplines, including graphic and editorial design.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of the UX/UI design process for assigned website and digital projects, from initial discovery and concept development through final execution and developer handoff.

  • Collaborate with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, designers, and developers to translate client objectives, project scopes, brand guidelines, and technical requirements into effective design solutions.

  • Conduct design research and develop information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate design concepts.

  • Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.

  • Develop, maintain, and improve UI design systems, component libraries, and design patterns to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across digital experiences.

  • Work closely with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications, supporting handoffs, and resolving UX/UI challenges to ensure design quality and feasibility.

  • Participate in and help guide internal design reviews and client presentations, communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.

  • Guide fellow designers through specific projects or design challenges, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high standards of design quality and consistency.

  • Proactively coordinate with project leads to manage timelines, communicate progress, identify potential challenges, and ensure deliverables meet project requirements and client expectations.

  • Stay current with emerging UX/UI trends, tools, and technologies, sharing inspiration, best practices, and opportunities to improve design processes and workflows.

  • Remote work
  • Dedicated team budget for professional development
  • The opportunity to join a dynamic, close-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day
About Terra
Terra is a digital marketing and creative agency built by an integrated and international team of content creators, strategists, designers, and developers. We help organizations reimagine and deliver their most ambitious digital projects and initiatives by acting as an extension of our clients’ teams and delivering exceptional online experiences, content, and marketing strategies.
Our team is innovative, tech-forward, and creative by nature. We are dedicated to pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve in today’s ever-evolving digital landscape. We believe in the power of collaboration and foster a work environment that encourages creativity and growth. And with a strong focus on work-life balance, we prioritize the well-being and career development of our team members. Finally, we are committed to promoting from within and offering meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Terra is also an equal opportunity employer.
We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote team members regardless of their race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status (as required by applicable law).
Our top goal as an employer is to bring together a diverse mix of talented people who are excited to join our company, stay with Terra for a long time, and do their best work while they’re here. We take pride in the quality of the services and work we provide to our clients, and we know none of it is possible without the hard work and commitment of our passionate and creative employees.

title: Material and Logistics Coordinator - Unplanned Materials
description:
• Material & Logistics Coordinator (Unplanned Materials)

    FBi Buildings | Remington, IN Full-Time | On-Site | $75-80K Base + Full Benefits

    Keep Materials Moving. Solve Problems. Make an Impact.

    Are you someone who enjoys solving problems, keeping operations organized, and making sure the right materials get to the right place at the right time?

    FBi Buildings is looking for a Material & Logistics Coordinator to help keep our construction projects moving by resolving unexpected material needs, coordinating replacements, and identifying ways to prevent recurring problems.

    This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in material planning, logistics, purchasing, inventory control, production coordination, or operations who enjoys working across departments and taking ownership of problems from start to finish.

    You don’t need a background in construction to succeed. We’re looking for someone who understands how materials move through an operation, knows how to find answers, and takes pride in getting things done.

    About the Role:

    As our Material & Logistics Coordinator, you’ll be the central point of coordination when construction crews encounter missing, damaged, incorrect, or unexpectedly needed materials.

    You’ll work closely with field crews, project managers, purchasing, material planning, yard operations, and logistics to understand what’s needed, investigate available inventory, coordinate material releases, and arrange timely delivery to jobsites.

    But this role goes beyond processing requests. We want someone who thinks critically, asks good questions, and looks for the most efficient solution before ordering or shipping additional material. Sometimes the answer is locating material already available. Other times, it’s coordinating a replacement, expediting a shipment, or identifying where a breakdown occurred.

    You’ll also help uncover the root causes behind recurring material issues, working with other departments to improve processes, reduce waste, and prevent costly delays.


    Your responsibilities will include:

    • Coordinate material requests: Review and prioritize incoming material needs, verify quantities and specifications, and ensure requests move quickly through the appropriate departments.
    • Investigate and solve problems: Research missing, damaged, or incorrect materials using inventory records, order histories, shipment information, and communication with field and operations teams.
    • Keep projects moving: Coordinate with purchasing, material planning, yard operations, and dispatch to secure materials and arrange efficient, timely delivery to jobsites.
    • Manage priorities and follow-through: Track open requests, monitor deadlines, communicate status updates, and escalate urgent issues to prevent construction delays.
    • Reduce unnecessary costs: Identify materials already available in inventory, existing orders, or jobsites before initiating replacements or additional shipments.
    • Identify root causes and improve processes: Investigate recurring shortages, damage, and material discrepancies. Work with the team to implement practical improvements that reduce waste and prevent future problems.
    • Maintain accurate records: Track request status, material releases, delivery arrangements, and resolution details to support accountability and continuous improvement.
    • Success in this role means fewer material-related delays, less waste, more efficient use of resources, and construction crews who can count on getting what they need.


    What We’re Looking For

    We’re interested in candidates who have developed strong coordination, problem-solving, and organizational skills in manufacturing, distribution, construction, transportation, or other material-intensive operations.

    • Relevant experience might include:
    • Material Coordinator, Material Planner, or Production Planner
    • Logistics Coordinator, Shipping Coordinator, or Dispatcher
    • Inventory Control, Purchasing, or Supply Chain Coordinator
    • Production Coordinator or Manufacturing Operations Coordinator
    • Construction Materials Coordinator or Project Coordinator

    The strongest candidates will bring:

    • Experience coordinating materials, inventory, purchasing, logistics, production, or operational workflows.
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines, and changing priorities.
    • A proactive, resourceful approach to troubleshooting problems and following through until they’re resolved.
    • Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across departments and in the field.
    • Attention to detail when reviewing material specifications, quantities, orders, and shipping information.
    • Comfort working with computer-based systems, spreadsheets, and operational tracking tools.
    • A practical, improvement-minded approach that looks beyond the immediate problem to understand why it happened.

    Experience with ERP, MRP, inventory management, purchasing, or logistics software is helpful. Familiarity with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, or root cause analysis is also a plus.

    Above all, we value reliability, ownership, sound judgment, and a strong work ethic. We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, stays organized under pressure, and genuinely enjoys helping a team succeed.

    Why Join FBi Buildings?

    FBi Buildings has been building quality post-frame structures throughout the Midwest since 1958. We’re a company that values integrity, teamwork, innovation, and finding better ways to serve our customers.

    This position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across our construction operations while developing valuable experience in material planning, supply chain coordination, logistics, and process improvement.

    Our benefits include:

    • Competitive compensation based on experience
    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) with employer match
    • Paid time off and paid holidays
    • Health savings account benefits
    • Employee development and advancement opportunities

    A collaborative, team-oriented work environment

You will lead project meetings, workshops and planning sessions, ensuring that actions are agreed, recorded and followed up. You will manage communication with stakeholders, provide regular reporting to project sponsors and escalate risks or decisions where appropriate.

You will monitor project performance against schedule, budget, scope and quality requirements. Where challenges arise, you will identify practical solutions, manage dependencies and work with colleagues to keep delivery on track. You will also support change management, implementation and transition activities to help ensure that project outcomes are successfully adopted and embedded.

Who are you?
