title: Data Analytics & Data Science Intern — Spring & Summer 2027
description:
Simbe is building the AI-powered operating system for physical retail. Our autonomous robots and multimodal data collection systems turn complex, constantly changing stores into accurate, actionable intelligence for leading retailers around the world. Simbe combines robotics, computer vision, machine learning, data infrastructure, and analytics to help retailers improve shelf availability, inventory accuracy, store execution, and operational decision-making.

Simbe is looking for a Data Analytics & Data Science Intern to join our Data Science & Analytics team and help turn large-scale retail and robot data into reliable insights, analytical products, and internal tools.

This internship is designed for students who want hands-on experience working with production data systems and solving real analytical problems at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, AI, and robotics.

Why This Internship Is High Impact

  • Work with real production data. Analyze data generated across Simbe’s robot fleet, retail environments, and operational systems.

  • Learn modern analytics engineering. Gain experience with SQL, Python, BigQuery, dbt, dimensional modeling, data quality, and BI workflows.

  • Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

  • Own a defined project. You’ll have clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

  • Connect data to real-world outcomes. Help translate robot, store, inventory, service, and operational signals into useful insights and tools.

  • Learn from experienced data practitioners. You’ll work directly with Simbe’s Data Science & Analytics team and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Data Science & Analytics team’s priorities during your internship.

  • Write and maintain SQL and Python used for data analysis, transformation, validation, or automation.

  • Work with data in BigQuery and help transform raw information into trustworthy analytical datasets.

  • Contribute to dbt models, tests, documentation, and other analytics engineering workflows.

  • Support dimensional modeling and development of organized data marts for analytical and reporting use cases.

  • Build or improve dashboards and reporting in tools such as Looker.

  • Investigate data-quality issues, validate results, and help ensure metrics are accurate and reliable.

  • Analyze fleet, service, store, or retail data and communicate useful findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Depending on team priorities, contribute to AI-assisted analytics prototypes or tools that make data easier to explore and understand.

  • Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, Operations, and other teams to understand data requirements and business context.

  • Communicate progress, technical decisions, challenges, and results throughout the internship.

  • Present your project, approach, results, and key learnings at the end of the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • We primarily target students in their final year of study and will also consider strong juniors.

  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with structured datasets.

  • Experience using Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation.

  • Coursework or hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics, data science, databases, or a related area.

  • Familiarity with Git or another source-control system.

  • Ability to investigate data carefully, recognize when results do not make sense, and validate conclusions.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills and willingness to work through ambiguous or unfamiliar problems.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, or another cloud data warehouse/platform.

  • Familiarity with dbt or another SQL-based data transformation framework.

  • Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas or Kimball-style modeling.

  • Experience building dashboards or reports in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a similar BI tool.

  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, workflow orchestration, or tools such as Airflow.

  • Experience with pandas, Jupyter notebooks, or other Python data tooling.

  • Experience writing automated data tests, monitoring data quality, or documenting analytical models and metrics.

  • Personal data, software, analytics, or AI projects outside of coursework.

  • Previous internship, research, or project experience involving data engineering, analytics engineering, BI, or data science.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding, LLMs, or automation tools to accelerate analysis or software development, with good judgment around validating generated output.

  • Interest in building conversational or natural-language interfaces over structured data.

Internship Program Structure

Interns join Simbe as part of a structured cohort and work full time from our Burlingame, California headquarters.

Each intern will have:

  • A defined technical project aligned with current team priorities

  • A hiring manager responsible for project scope, performance, and feedback

  • A dedicated mentor separate from the hiring manager

  • Structured midpoint feedback

  • Regular opportunities to collaborate with and learn from Simbe engineers and data practitioners

  • A final project presentation at the end of the internship

We do not believe in creating busywork for interns. Your project will be selected closer to your start date based on active team priorities so that you can contribute to meaningful work alongside our full-time team.

Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. L.

Result Driven — We are customer-centric and results-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors.

Empathetic — We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally.

Transparent — We value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.

Agile — We are eager to learn and adapt quickly to changes and customer needs.

Innovative — We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design, user experience, and customer value.

Leaders — We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

title: Senior Legal Industry Reporter - California
description:
Law360, a LexisNexis company, is an online newswire for business lawyers that covers major litigation, transactions, and regulatory issues. Founded in 2004 and acquired by LexisNexis in 2012, Law360 is a cutting-edge organization and one of the fastest-growing subscription news services in the U.S. Our subscribers include the largest law firms in the U.S. and around the world, in-house counsel at major corporations, and key decision-makers in the government sector.

Are you excited to break news on the technologies transforming the legal industry?

Do you enjoy uncovering stories, identifying emerging trends, and delivering insightful journalism on artificial intelligence and legal innovation?

About our Team

Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.

About the Role

This role can be performed in San Francisco or Los Angeles.

Law360 is seeking a senior reporter to cover the legal industry in California and the wider adoption of legal technology and artificial intelligence across law firms, courts and regulators.

We are looking for an ambitious journalist who thrives on breaking news, spotting emerging trends, and delivering insightful coverage that explains how the technology is reshaping the business and practice of law. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable filing quick-turn stories on major developments in the legal industry and producing deeply reported features and enterprise pieces that put those developments into context.

This reporter will cover one of the most consequential shifts facing the legal industry: the rise of generative AI and the broader transformation of legal services through technology. They should be curious about how AI tools are being adopted, how the technology works, the successes and failures, and what these changes mean for lawyers, clients, courts, regulators, and the economics of the legal profession.

The reporter is expected to cultivate a network of sources across the legal tech ecosystem, including law firm leaders, startup founders, investors, consultants, academics, and regulators. Candidates should have strong news judgment, a proven ability to generate scoops, familiarity with technology and the confidence to chase exclusive reporting in a competitive environment.

The successful candidate will also be able to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling journalism for a sophisticated legal audience. They should have strong writing skills and a demonstrated ability to move seamlessly between breaking news, analysis, and longer-form feature stories.

Requirements

  • Possess at least five years of full-time, paid reporting experience

  • Demonstrated reporting and writing skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the tech landscape, AI, SaaS and related topics

  • Ability to generate own story ideas that are relevant and timely

  • Experience working a beat

  • Collaborative approach and desire to follow the news

  • Ability to juggle daily news and longer-term features and enterprise reporting

Preferences

  • Experience covering the legal industry, including in-house legal departments, law firms, legal associations and regulators, legal technology and artificial intelligence.

  • Experience reporting for a professional audience.

  • Ability to generate scoops, write breaking news stories and deeper analytic pieces

  • Ability and openness to regularly meeting with tech, law firm and other sources

Work in a way that works for you

title: Digital Program Manager, Customer Success
location: Remote United States , Nashville, TN, US
description:
Digital Program Manager, Customer Success

Role Overview

Uniguest is seeking a Digital Program Manager - Customer Success, to build and operate a scalable, data-driven Customer Success program focused on customer retention, adoption, renewal readiness, customer health scoring, AI-driven risk identification, and digital customer engagement.

This is not a traditional Customer Success Manager role focused primarily on managing individual customer relationships, conducting QBRs, or carrying a personal book of business. The primary objective is to design the systems, workflows, automation, reporting, and customer programs that allow Uniguest to proactively identify customer risk, support a large customer base efficiently, and direct limited Customer Success resources to the highest-impact accounts and situations.

The ideal candidate will have strong Salesforce.com skills, an analytical mindset, experience working with business data and dashboards, and the ability to translate customer, product, support, renewal, and usage data into practical operating workflows. Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, Tableau, or similar CRM, data warehouse, and business intelligence tools is highly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

Uniguest serves a broad and diverse customer base across multiple verticals, products, and routes to market. The business needs to move from reactive churn and renewal management to a more proactive, programmatic Customer Success model.

This role will help Uniguest answer four critical questions:

  1. Which customers are at risk?
  1. Why are they at risk?
  1. What action should be taken next?
  1. Which customers require human outreach versus digital or automated engagement?

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and operate scalable Customer Success program across customer segments, verticals, products, and routes to market.
  • Develop customer segmentation rules based on ARR, product type, renewal timing, usage, support activity, risk profile, and strategic importance.
  • Create and maintain customer health scoring logic using Salesforce.com data, renewal information, product usage, support signals, and other available customer data sources.
  • Partner with Sales, Business Systems, Support, Product, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to define data requirements, risk signals, workflows, dashboards, and action plans.
  • Use Salesforce.com as a core operating system for customer risk visibility, task generation, renewal readiness, account prioritization, and workflow adoption.
  • Work with Tableau and Salesforce reports, or similar data and BI environments to analyze account trends, churn patterns, renewal risk, adoption gaps, and engagement performance.
  • Build AI-enabled and rules-based processes that help identify at-risk accounts, recommend next best actions, and prioritize outreach for limited human resources.
  • Design digital customer success programs for onboarding, adoption, renewal reminders, product education, risk intervention, and value reinforcement.
  • Create long-tail customer coverage programs that allow Uniguest to engage smaller customers efficiently without assigning every account to a dedicated CSM.
  • Build work queues and action lists for Customer Success, Sales, Support, and leadership based on renewal timing, usage trends, risk factors, product migrations, and expansion opportunities.
  • Maintain executive dashboards for customer health, at-risk ARR, retention risk, renewal readiness, program performance, and customer engagement.
  • Establish clear operating cadence for at-risk account reviews, renewal readiness, digital program performance, customer health reviews, and executive escalation.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Lifecycle Operations, Digital Customer Success, SaaS program management, or a related operating role.
  • Strong Salesforce.com skills, including comfort with account, opportunity, order, renewal, task, activity, reporting, dashboard, and workflow concepts.
  • Highly analytical mindset with the ability to turn customer data into insights, priorities, workflows, and executive reporting.
  • Experience building or improving customer health scores, risk frameworks, renewal readiness processes, segmentation models, or customer lifecycle programs.
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or analytics teams. Tableau and Snowflake experience are strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, Finance, Business Systems, and Customer Success stakeholders.
  • Strong program management skills, including the ability to define ownership, timelines, operating cadence, success metrics, and adoption plans.
  • Practical understanding of AI, automation, rules-based prioritization, or workflow automation in a business operations environment.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain data, process, and program recommendations to senior commercial leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agent force, or customer-facing Salesforce automation.
  • Experience with Tableau, Snowflake, Power BI, or similar data and reporting environments.
  • Experience with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, ChurnZero, Avoma, Totango, Planhat, Vitally, Catalyst, or similar tools.
  • Experience building scaled or digital Customer Success motions for a large customer base.
  • Experience in a multi-product, multi-vertical, or channel-supported business.
  • Experience creating renewal, onboarding, adoption, product education, risk intervention, or customer value programs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customer health scoring framework is designed, implemented, and actively used by the business.
  • Renewal risk is visible earlier and tied to clear actions, owners, and reason codes.
  • Long-tail customers receive structured digital engagement rather than being unmanaged.
  • Customer outreach is prioritized by risk, ARR, renewal timing, product adoption, and opportunity impact.
  • Sales, Support, Product, and Customer Success teams have better visibility into customer risk and next best actions.
  • Executive leadership has consistent reporting on customer health, at-risk ARR, churn/down sell themes, and program performance.
  • Uniguest improves retention visibility and begins reducing preventable churn and downsell through earlier, more focused intervention.


About Uniguest

Uniguest is the global leader in providing highly secure, fully managed customer-facing technology solutions on an outsourced basis to the hospitality, senior living, specialty retail, education, and corporate sectors. Our turnkey consumer-facing technology solutions include hardware and Digital Engagement software packages (IPTV, CMS, kiosks), system implementation, and 24/7/365 multi-lingual support for public space kiosks, digital signage, interactive TV, tablets, remote printing, and more. Designed to deliver consistent and safe experiences, Uniguest empowers clients like NCAA stadiums, QSR chains, and corporate enterprises to engage customers effectively.

- Build AI-Ready Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation: Author, maintain, and structure comprehensive knowledge articles and process guides for learning technologies, optimizing content specifically for integration with Zendesk AI tools to drive self-service resolution and streamline user support.

- Adult Learning Focus: Deep understanding of the unique motivations, self-directed nature, and practical needs of adult learners in digital spaces.

- Agility & Continuous Curiosity: A proactive drive to stay ahead of EdTech and AI developments, continuously testing, evaluating, and adapting emerging technologies.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to build trusting relationships across instructional design teams, IT departments, and academic leadership.

- Project Management & Operational Agility: Demonstrates the ability to independently organize, drive, and execute complex learning technology initiatives from inception through completion within a fast-paced higher education environment. Adept at managing multiple competing priorities, navigating academic governance, and consistently meeting tight, fixed deadlines (e.g., term starts, platform rollouts, staff training cycles) without compromising quality or user experience.

Experience: Three years professional experience in a field that is directly related to the functions of the position to be filled or equivalency as determined by the appointing authority

title: Maintenance - Entry Level
description:
Our Company

J.T. Russell & Sons is a family owned highway construction company that offers a variety of asphalt products and services. The services we provide range from grading, paving, hot mix asphalt and liquid asphalt to recycling and much more. J.T. Russell & Sons’ mission is to provide our customers with quality asphalt products and services at a competitive price. We train our employees with up-to-date technology to make and distribute the finest asphalt products on the market.

What You’ll Do

Maintenance – Entry Level supports uptime and safe operation of our plants, terminals, and equipment by completing hands-on maintenance and repairs. This role exists to keep production and field operations moving, with a strong focus on safety and quality.

Key responsibilities:
- Perform maintenance on asphalt plants/terminals, rock crushing equipment, and other fixed locations
- Maintain the shop/warehouse with organized, clean housekeeping
- Assist with fabrication and welding work, including blades, buckets, and dump truck beds
- Follow all company safety procedures and applicable local/state/federal regulations

title: Confirmed Backend Engineer - Train
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Train Supply team. The mission is to scale the current BlaBlaCar train distribution in Europe supporting the expansion of the train supply to new markets and countries.

As a backend developer you will work on technical challenges and product feature development from early-stage conception, to development, testing strategy, deployment, and monitoring of new releases.

BlaBlaCar’s Train GDS stack is a scalable micro service architecture in spring boot 3 started in 2022. It uses REST API to communicate with other backends services in BlaBlaCar and with the suppliers.

You will be reporting to Solene, the Engineering Manager of the team, and working with a team of 3 other backend engineers. You will collaborate closely with several engineering teams, data, QA product managers and business developers to build robust and scalable features.

Your responsibilities

  • Defining scalable solutions to overcome the technical challenges of Train Distribution
  • Enhancing, maintaining and monitoring the current BlaBlaCar train ecosystem.
  • Participating in the whole application lifecycle, meaning : initial discovery, design, development, tests strategy, deployment to production, monitoring, alerting and support
  • Interacting with people with different roles, backgrounds and culture, and share your technical expertise with a mix of technical, product and business experts.
  • Take the lead on complex projects involving multiple teams from BlaBlaCar in different pillars and external actors.
  • Cultivate a continuous learning mindset, testing and experimenting new patterns, contributing to elevate the train team engineering standards.
  • Actively leverage AI tools in your daily workflows, explore innovative AI-driven engineering practices, to improve productivity and code quality.

Your qualifications

  • You have 3+ years of experience from companies with a strong engineering culture.
  • You are fluent in Java and knowledge of frameworks such as Spring Boot, JUnit and Mockito.
  • You have hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions.
  • You know what a service oriented architecture looks like, and you can determine when to apply a given architectural pattern.
  • You understand when and how to do a tradeoff between fast iterations and delivery quality.
  • You have excellent communication skills, you’re humble, and you are a team player.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Nice to have : you have strong knowledge of train distribution or of a similar environment with the same technical challenges.

What we have to offer

• Hybrid position
• 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
• 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
• Financial support for home office equipment
• Minimum 25 days holiday per year
• Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
• 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
• Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
• Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
• Employee Stock ownership plan
• Regular team building events
• 1 day off per year to test our product

Interested in joining the ride?

• a 45-min video-call with a Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions
• a 60-min video-call with Solène, Engineering Manager, to discuss your experience and share more details about the squad
• a 90-min live coding session with Software Engineers
• a 60-min design interview with Software Engineers
• a 30-min video-call for vision fit and rounding off the process

Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

title: Systems Engineering Specialist
description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.

The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit


Telesat's System Modeling team architects, develops, and maintains the Lightspeed System Model, an advanced engineering software platform that supports resource allocation modeling for Lightspeed operations and end-to-end performance evaluation of the Telesat Lightspeed satellite constellation.

As a Systems Engineering Specialist, you will help lead the technical direction of the Lightspeed System Model. You will design, implement, and validate algorithms and optimization methods, contribute to performance assessments, and guide architectural decisions that support the constellation's success. You will develop engineering software in C++, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams to align the model with system requirements and integrate it into the overall Lightspeed system.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the design, development, and validation of algorithms and optimization methods in C++ to improve system performance and reliability while meeting system requirements.
  • Translate system requirements into mathematical models, resource allocation strategies, and implementable algorithms.
  • Evaluate algorithm correctness, computational efficiency, and solution quality through testing, simulation, and performance analysis.
  • Oversee performance analysis of the Lightspeed constellation, including throughput, latency, satellite handover, availability, capacity, and regulatory compliance metrics.
  • Collaborate with System Modeling, Software Development, Quality Assurance, and System Engineering teams to support integration and testing.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and support continuous improvement in engineering practices.
  • Work with other Telesat teams on satellite payload and ground segment characteristics, performance metric definitions, performance evaluations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead assessments of design alternatives and system architectures to inform long-term planning and guide future system improvements.
  • Prepare and review clear, accurate technical documentation that explains models, algorithms, design assumptions, validation methods, and results.
  • Apply Agile software development methods to plan, deliver, and refine engineering software through iterative development and team collaboration.
  • Maintain code quality and reliability through unit testing, code reviews, refactoring, and consistent application of coding standards.

Education

  • A master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, with relevant professional experience in system design, modeling, algorithm development, or optimization.
  • A PhD in one of these fields, with research relevant to system modeling, algorithm development, or optimization.

Required knowledge and experience

  • Strong working knowledge of C++, with demonstrated ability to design, implement, test, and maintain engineering software.
  • Strong knowledge of algorithm design and analysis, including appropriate data structures, computational complexity, and performance trade-offs.
  • Strong knowledge of mathematical optimization, including formulating objectives and constraints, selecting suitable solution approaches, and evaluating results.
  • Ability to translate complex engineering problems into mathematical models and software implementations, and validate results against system requirements.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and code quality practices.

Assets

  • Knowledge of MATLAB for engineering analysis, modeling, simulation, or algorithm prototyping.
  • Knowledge of Python for analysis, automation, modeling, or testing.
  • Proficiency with software development tools and workflows, including Git for version control, GitLab and GitHub for collaboration and code review, and integrated development environments (IDEs).
  • Familiarity with agentic AI, including AI agents and their use in engineering, software development, or analysis workflows.
  • Knowledge of radio communication systems and/or satellite communications.
  • Experience applying optimization techniques, such as linear programming, mixed-integer programming, or heuristic methods, to engineering problems.
  • Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools.

Specialized knowledge and abilities

  • Creative problem-solving skills and close attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams, communicate technical ideas clearly, and collaborate to solve complex engineering problems.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
  • Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work, balance competing needs, and use resources effectively.
  • Aptitude for and interest in complex technology.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
The successful candidate must be able to work in Canada and obtain clearance under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

title: Senior Hazard Mitigation Planner
location: San Juan, Puerto Rico, San Juan, PR, PR
description:
About Company:

Kundlas Consulting Group LLC is a professional consulting firm specializing in construction inspection and compliance services for public infrastructure projects. Our core services include on-site inspection of roadway, bridge, and utility construction to ensure adherence to engineering specifications, safety standards, and contract requirements. We support clients with daily reporting, materials testing coordination, schedule tracking, and quality assurance oversight. Additional services include project management, grants management for federally funded infrastructure and disaster recovery programs.

About the Role:

The Senior Hazard Mitigation Planner plays a critical role in enhancing community resilience by identifying risks and developing strategies to reduce the impact of natural hazards. This position involves comprehensive analysis of hazard data, collaboration with local, state, and federal agencies, and the creation of actionable mitigation plans that align with regulatory requirements. The planner will lead efforts to engage stakeholders and the public to ensure inclusive and effective hazard mitigation strategies. By integrating scientific research, policy considerations, and community needs, the role aims to minimize potential damage and promote sustainable development. Ultimately, the Hazard Mitigation Planner contributes to safeguarding lives, property, and infrastructure through proactive planning and risk reduction initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Environmental Science, Emergency Management, Geography, Engineering or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of professional experience in hazard mitigation planning, emergency management, or a closely related discipline.
  • Familiarity with federal and state hazard mitigation policies, including the Disaster Mitigation Act and FEMA’s mitigation planning requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in risk assessment and data interpretation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively prepare plans, reports, and conduct stakeholder engagement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Urban Planning, Environmental Management, or Public Administration.
  • Certification in Emergency Management (CEM) or Professional Planner (AICP) credentials.
  • Experience working with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for hazard mapping and spatial analysis.
  • Proven track record of successful grant writing and project management related to hazard mitigation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with diverse communities and facilitate multi-agency collaboration.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed risk assessments and vulnerability analyses for various hazards including floods, earthquakes, hurricanes, and technological incidents.
  • Develop, update, and maintain hazard mitigation plans in compliance with federal and state guidelines, such as FEMA requirements.
  • Coordinate with emergency management agencies, local governments, and community organizations to gather data and foster collaborative mitigation efforts.
  • Facilitate public meetings and workshops to educate stakeholders and incorporate community input into mitigation planning.
  • Prepare grant applications and reports to secure funding for mitigation projects and ensure proper documentation and tracking of project progress.

Skills:

The required skills enable the Hazard Mitigation Planner to analyze complex hazard data and translate it into practical mitigation strategies that reduce risk. Strong communication skills are essential for engaging with stakeholders, conducting public outreach, and preparing clear, comprehensive planning documents. Analytical and technical skills, including familiarity with GIS and risk assessment tools, support the accurate identification of vulnerabilities and the development of targeted solutions. Preferred skills such as grant writing and project management enhance the planner’s ability to secure funding and oversee mitigation initiatives from conception through implementation. Together, these skills ensure the planner can effectively contribute to building safer, more resilient communities.

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in Netherlands.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

      • Employment Type: Full-time.

      • Recruitment Process: The process includes a screening call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the VP of Product, a case study with the VP of Product and DPO, and reference checks. Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.

title: Quality and Sanitation Manager
description:
About Us:

Finlays Solutions is a leading partner to the B2B beverage manufacturing industry, recognized for its deep expertise, strong industry relationships, and commitment to innovation. The company plays a central role in supporting beverage brands, flavor houses, private label partners, and manufacturers through high-quality products, technical capabilities, and collaborative problem-solving. With a strong presence in the ready-to-drink beverage market, Finlays Solutions focuses on identifying emerging opportunities, expanding into new market spaces, and delivering solutions that meet evolving customer and consumer needs. Finlays Solutions operates with a strong commitment to its mission, values, ethics, and long‑term goals, ensuring that every initiative reflects the company’s dedication to integrity, partnership, and sustainable success.


Job Summary:

The Quality & Sanitation Manager is a senior leadership position, reporting to the Director of Quality Control, and part of the Senior Leadership Team on site. The position is accountable to deliver the Quality Management and Food Safety System for the site, through a GFSI-aligned certification. This includes a robust program comprised of quality assurance, quality control, quality improvement, customer and complaints management, non-conformance management and supplier non-conformance management. The Quality Assurance Manager also provides support and governance of ethical certifications on site (Organic, Kosher, Halal, Rainforest Alliance and Fairtrade) on site. The position leads implementation of and ongoing validation of a hygiene / sanitation program through management of the sanitation team and collaboration with external sanitation service providers. All this is achieved with strong people management and leadership skills and the ability to manage a budget.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Accountability on site for the Quality & Food Safety Management System, including:

  • The development, implementation, execution, and improvement of quality systems, focusing on consistent quality, food safety, allergen management, food defense and fraud (authenticity), and aligned to a GFSI certification.
  • The maintenance of external certifications for said Quality System and including other certifications such as consumer-focused qualifications (for example Organic, Fairtrade, RA) and religious qualifications (Kosher, Halal).
  • The HACCP, and all prerequisite programs, (or equivalent food safety) system that extends from raw materials and packaging materials, through to final packaged product.
  • Acting as a member of the Food safety Team (or as the Food Safety Team Leader in cases where the Quality Specialist is in the process of acquiring this capability).
  • Managing all internal management systems between the Quality and functional teams required to achieve this, such as documentation and record keeping, non-conformance management, including cost of non-conformance, customer complaints management, audit programs, incident management, and validation and verification programs.
  • The management of customer quality and technical requirements, working collaboratively with Commercial to drive enduring partnerships with key, strategic customers, through well-defined and structured engagements.
  • The execution of proper problem solving aligned with documented protocols that drive and support root cause investigations.
  • Supporting the management of suppliers, third party co-packers and co-manufacturer partnerships.
  • Supporting the regulatory and legal compliance program for all aspects of food manufacture and food safety, through execution of the Quality Legal Registers and the Agrochemical and Contaminants Policy.

Accountability for the development and implementation of the site hygiene / sanitation program

  • The development, implementation, and monitoring of the Master Cleaning Schedule, which includes verification of associated records. This defines daily, weekly, monthly, bi-annual, and annual cleaning activities.
  • Establishing a site Sanitation Plan supported by processes, procedures, and SSOP’s that are documented and maintained.
  • Develop and document effective cleaning and sanitation procedures for all new plant equipment and/or when plant modifications are executed.
  • Lead root cause problem solving to drive corrective and preventative measures in plant hygiene thus leading to continuous improvement.

Accountability for the Quality Control program, that assures:

  • The management of laboratory analysis, providing repeatable, reproducible, and reliable results that guide the business in decisions pertaining to production and final product quality.
  • The implementation of analytical and sensory methods, and the adoption of validation and verification programs (reference control, calibration, ring testing and equipment maintenance).
  • The use of monitoring and measuring programs, with visual management to drive process control support, and quality improvement.
  • Support to Commercial, R&D and Innovation (NPD) where applicable.
  • Budget and capex proficiency with all operational budgets within target and all Capex projects planned and managed appropriately, specifically for laboratory requirements.
  • Data storage and record keeping for all laboratory generated information ensuring retrieval and traceability.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in laboratory strategy and execution to ensure the lab is capable, and customer focused.
  • Implementing and managing quality activities conducted at-source by operations.

Responsibility for the Quality Improvement program, including:

  • Working with operations to lead and support quality improvement projects using science-based problem solving and focused improvement.
  • Supporting and where appropriate leading product development and innovation projects.
  • Participating in commissioning of new products and processes, assuring quality and food safety, and regulatory compliance.
  • Supporting the operationalization and training of Quality programs.
  • Leading the transition to online/inline monitoring where appropriate.

Responsibility for the People and Team Development program, including:

  • Developing the team through inspiring leadership and strategy.
  • Developing the team through a structured framework based on capability requirements and competency.
  • Ensuring a culture of performance management, recognizing good performance, and addressing poor performance.
  • Developing a strong succession plan and people-cover program for all positions.
  • Developing the site Quality and Food Safety culture in support of the Finlays values, driving our belief that Quality is at the core of all that we do.
  • Engaging with external stakeholders and leaders in the field of Quality and Food Safety, bringing in external ideas and driving broader exposure to industry leaders.

Responsibility for managing and leading the site Quality Team:

  • Setting objectives and deliverables in conjunction with direct reports, conducting one on ones, Performance reviews, and PDPs (personal development plans) as required.
  • Provide challenging tasks and assignments for the team and hold each member accountable for delivery.
  • Resolve conflicts by being vigilant, good at listening, mediating disagreement, and being willing to make tough decisions.
  • Work collaboratively with the Plant Manager and site Leadership/Management teams to deliver site objectives. This includes (but not limited to):
  • Site Gemba walks.
  • Participating in Site leadership meetings.
  • Leading/Driving and supporting site initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a science-based field, with at least 5 years’ experience in Quality Management.
  • Quality-related certifications of SQF, HACCP, PCQI, and Lead Auditor required with additional certification related to Food Defense and Food Fraud as an advantage.
  • Ability to objectively evaluate circumstances and make decisions based on fact.
  • Ability to lead, motivate, and manage a team effectively.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to interact with customers and team members.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with customers and staff.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills and the ability to handle escalated issues.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and customer feedback to drive improvements.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to manage various tasks and priorities in a complex environment.
  • A strong commitment to providing excellent customer service and enhancing customer satisfaction.
  • Experience in training and developing team members to improve their skills and performance.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, if necessary.

Physical Demands

  • The role is equally office and plant-based with a strong floor presence being essential.
  • Frequent interaction with team members and other departments, requiring effective communication and collaboration.
  • Willingness to work additional hours, and tailor schedule appropriately, to support team goals and meet deadlines.
  • Must possess adequate vision, hearing, and verbal communication skills to meet essential job performance and safety standards.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and regularly perform physical tasks such as pushing, pulling, lifting, climbing, bending, stooping, squatting, and using hands for detailed tasks.
  • Work environment sometimes involves exposure to inclement weather.
  • Physically capable of performing tasks such as lifting, climbing, and using hand and power tools, including pallet jacks, scales, ladders, and standard material handling and cleaning equipment
  • Capable of safely lifting up to 50 pounds frequently throughout the day; ability to handle heavier items with proper lifting equipment or team-assisted techniques to ensure safety.

Work Environment

  • Employees must be able to work in a dynamic manufacturing environment that may include exposure to odors, dust, moderate noise levels, and fluctuations in temperature and ventilation
  • Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn at all times, which may include but is not limited to: safety glasses, steel-toed shoes, gloves, hairnets, uniforms, and face shields, as required by specific job duties and safety protocols.

Quality Statement:

  • Our Quality and Food Safety Management strategy is anchored by our food safety and quality culture and a two-pronged approach to “be the best” as we produce “only the best”. Every employee has a role to play in this strategy as outlined by the following:
  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s), allergen control, food defense, HACCP, SQF, and regulatory requirements so that we make consistently safe, quality products.
  • Ensure the presence of visitors, contractors, and customers are documented on each visit in and out of the facility to maintain good manufacturing practices, allergen controls, food defense/food security and HACCP controls.
  • Report all food safety and quality issues to management immediately.
  • Partner with colleagues across all functions to share knowledge, skills, and information regarding quality and food safety.
  • Adhere to all health and safety work practices.
  • Exhibit an understanding of quality and food safety standards and be able to speak about the Finlays quality and food safety system and your role in it.
  • Handle customer complaints in a timely and professional manner so that the customer is put first, always.
  • Participate fully in Finlays programs that drive continuous improvement methodologies.

Any employee in doubt as to the role they play in the Finlays quality and food safety management system must reach out to the site Quality Manager or VP of Quality.


Equal Opportunity Statement:

Finlays Solutions is an equal employment opportunity employer seeking diversity in qualified applicants for employment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, gender, gender identity, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, perceived disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status, as defined by applicable law. Finlays employs individuals that are 18 years of age or older.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship

title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering, DeepMind
description:

This role focuses on rapidly developing new features, and working across partner teams to deliver solutions, and maximize impact for Google and Google customers. You will be instrumental in translating AI research into real-world products, and demonstrating the capabilities of latest generation models.   • Lead a team in the design, development, and deployment of scalable generative AI applications and advocating industry best practices.

title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays.

You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your scope within Spotify Connect, turning the broader Seamless direction into clear priorities.
  • Work with research and data colleagues to understand cross-device behavior, identify friction, and define measures of success.
  • Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive and reliable experiences for discovering devices, controlling playback, and moving between them.
  • Balance improvements to everyday usability and reliability with experiments that uncover new value.
  • Work across teams and partner-facing functions to manage dependencies and deliver a coherent end-to-end experience.
  • Explore opportunities created by richer device understanding and emerging ways of interacting with Spotify, keeping privacy, permissions, and user control central.
  • Clearly communicate product choices, progress, and results, and use what you learn to improve the roadmap.

title: NetSuite Developer / Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced NetSuite Developer / Engineer to provide ongoing technical support and development for our Oracle NetSuite ERP system.

This person will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining and improving custom scripts and configurations, resolving bugs, supporting third-party integrations, and helping ensure that our NetSuite environment remains stable, reliable, and efficient.

The ideal candidate is an experienced NetSuite developer who enjoys debugging, problem-solving, and getting to the root cause of technical issues. This role is highly technical, but a basic understanding of accounting and financial workflows is preferred.

This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities

NetSuite Development and Script Maintenance

  • Develop, maintain, and modify SuiteScript customizations using SuiteScript 2.x.
  • Maintain existing custom records, forms, workflows, and scripts.
  • Write clean, efficient, scalable, and well-documented code.
  • Follow NetSuite development best practices.
  • Ensure customizations remain stable and compatible with future NetSuite updates.

Technical Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve technical issues affecting NetSuite functionality.
  • Diagnose SuiteScript errors, workflow failures, custom form issues, and system performance problems.
  • Perform root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and implement long-term solutions.
  • Troubleshoot issues reported by internal users and provide timely resolutions.
  • Support technical issues affecting financial workflows, billing, and reporting.

Bug Fixes and System Maintenance

  • Identify, prioritize, and resolve bugs affecting custom NetSuite functionality.
  • Test and validate bug fixes before deployment.
  • Monitor custom scripts for errors, failures, and governance issues.
  • Help maintain the overall stability and reliability of the NetSuite environment.

Script Deployment and Change Management

  • Deploy scripts and customizations across Development, Sandbox, UAT, and Production environments.
  • Follow established testing and change management procedures.
  • Maintain version control of custom code.
  • Monitor deployments to ensure successful implementation with minimal disruption to business operations.

Integration Support

  • Troubleshoot issues involving third-party integrations connected to NetSuite.
  • Assist with maintaining API connections and resolving synchronization errors.
  • Support testing following integration updates or vendor changes.
  • Work with external NetSuite partners when additional technical support is needed.

Documentation

  • Maintain technical documentation for scripts, customizations, integrations, and deployments.
  • Document code changes, bug fixes, troubleshooting procedures, and system configurations.
  • Create documentation that supports future maintenance, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.

Collaboration and Technical Support

  • Work closely with Finance and other internal stakeholders to understand technical requirements and resolve system issues.
  • Clearly explain technical issues and solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with external NetSuite partners on complex technical issues and system improvements.
  • Provide technical guidance regarding NetSuite functionality, limitations, and potential solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong experience developing and maintaining Oracle NetSuite using SuiteScript 2.x.

• Proficiency in JavaScript.

  • Strong understanding of NetSuite development best practices.
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to quickly diagnose complex technical issues and identify root causes.

• Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple support requests, development tasks, and deployments at the same time.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Finance teams, internal stakeholders, management, and external technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of accounting and financial workflows, including Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, billing, and financial transactions.
  • Experience troubleshooting third-party integrations and API connections.
  • Experience working with NetSuite across Sandbox, UAT, and Production environments.
  • Experience with version control and structured software development processes.

Typical Tasks

The role may include:

  • Reviewing and responding to internal NetSuite technical support requests.
  • Investigating and resolving reported bugs and system issues.
  • Maintaining and updating existing SuiteScripts.
  • Monitoring production scripts and resolving execution errors.
  • Testing script changes and bug fixes in Sandbox or other non-production environments.
  • Deploying approved scripts and customizations to Production.
  • Troubleshooting third-party integrations and synchronization issues.

• Maintaining technical documentation.

The workload will vary depending on active support requests, development needs, deployments, and system issues.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Timely resolution of technical issues and support requests.
  • Accurate diagnosis and resolution of bugs with minimal recurrence.
  • Successful script and customization deployments with minimal production issues.
  • Stability and reliability of the NetSuite environment.
  • Quality, accuracy, and completeness of technical documentation.
  • Responsiveness to Finance and internal stakeholder technical requests.
  • High-quality, readable, and maintainable code that follows NetSuite best practices.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (F# / ASP.NET Core / ReactJS)

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, automation, maintenance, and operational support of enterprise-scale cloud data platforms leveraging Databricks, AWS cloud services, and modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Lead the design, development, optimization, and operational management of enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines within Databricks.
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows.
  • Configure, optimize, and manage Databricks clusters for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work closely with software development and systems teams to build Data Integration solutions.
  • Design and build Data models using tools such as Lucid, Talend, Erwin, MySQL workbench.
  • Define and enhance enterprise data model to reflect relationships and dependencies.
  • Review application data systems to ensure adherence to data governance policies.
  • Design and build ETL (Python), ELT(Python) infrastructure, automation, and solutions to transform data as required.
  • Design and Implement BI dashboards to visualize Trends and Forecasts.
  • Design and implement data infrastructure components, ensuring high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Design, train and deploy ML models
  • Implement monitoring solutions to proactively identify and address potential issues.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure the data platform meets industry standards and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and business partners to ensure robust and reliable systems.

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role is remote and based within the United States.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field or equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience as DataOps Engineer in a manufacturing or automotive environment.
  • Experience with streaming and event-based architecture.
  • Experience implementing data lakehouse solutions using Databricks.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Proficient in building data pipelines using languages such as Python and SQL.
  • Experience with AWS based data services such as Glue, Kinesis, Firehose or other comparable services.
  • Experience with Structured, unstructured and time series databases.
  • Solid understanding of cloud data storage solutions such as RDS, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Mongo, Cassandra, Influx.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Embed with the platform and engineering teams who adopt Earthly Lunar, get them live in production, and turn their hardest standards into enforced guardrails — writing real code the whole way.

About Earthly Lunar

Earthly Lunar is a guardrails engine for the AI era. As engineering organizations scale — and AI accelerates how much code they ship — leaders lose the ability to hold every team to their standards for quality, security, and compliance. Lunar turns those standards into automated guardrails enforced across the whole software development lifecycle — as code is written, on every pull request, and at deploy — consistently across every repo and team. Engineering leaders get back control and real-time visibility, and compliance evidence becomes a byproduct of enforcement. Whether code comes from a developer or an AI agent, Lunar makes sure it ships right.

We're an AI-native team backed by Innovation Endeavors and Work-Bench — with angels including Jeff Dean (Google's Chief Scientist), the CEOs of Datadog and Cockroach Labs, the founder of Sentry, and the creators of Elixir, Pandas, and Ruff/uv. We're trusted by enterprise teams across defense and large-scale SaaS, and growing fast.

The role

You're a hard-core engineer who happens to love working with customers. You'll work with the platform and engineering teams evaluating and adopting Lunar — before and after the sale — and own their success end to end: prove the fit, guide the deployment into their environment, then build alongside them to turn their real-world standards into automated, enforced guardrails. You own technical delivery for each account, from first call to guardrails running in production.

Lunar is a deeply technical product. Getting it deployed means Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, and a GitHub App; getting value from it means writing collectors and policies — small programs (Bash/Python) that gather signals from across a customer's SDLC (Dockerfiles, K8s manifests, Terraform, SBOMs, CI runs, VCS and vendor APIs) and evaluate them against the customer's standards. That's the same work our library, lunar-lib, is built from — and you'll own and extend it. The patterns you build in the field flow back into the product, so every customer benefits from the last.

This is a hands-on engineering role: you write and own production code, and success looks like a customer's custom guardrails live and enforcing across thousands of engineers within ~90 days.

What you'll do

  • Own each account's technical track end to end. From the technical evaluation before the deal closes, through install and first guardrails live, to expansion and long-term success — the whole arc is yours.

  • Be the technical partner in the sale. Be the credible engineer in the room before the deal closes — scope the fit, prove the value on the customer's real stack, and field the hardest technical questions.

  • Guide the install, hands-on. Stand up the self-hosted Lunar Hub with the customer's team — Helm chart on Kubernetes, Postgres, S3, the GitHub App, the CI agent, and Grafana dashboards — and debug it live when their environment throws you a curveball.

  • Turn standards into guardrails. Sit with a platform team, understand a real requirement — a post-incident action item, a compliance rule, an org convention — and write the collector and policy that enforces it across all their repos and pipelines.

  • Write production code daily. Bash, Python, SQL — parsing Dockerfiles and K8s manifests, wiring up GitHub/GitLab and vendor APIs, normalizing messy signals into clean posture data.

  • Feed the product. Generalize what you build with customers into lunar-lib so it ships to everyone.

  • Own the fix. When a deployment breaks, you diagnose and resolve it yourself rather than filing a ticket — often with the customer's team watching.

  • Own the relationship for the long haul. Earn the trust of platform and engineering leaders and the ICs on their teams, keep them successful and expanding long after go-live, and translate between their world and ours.

  • Build with AI, and build the AI story. Use Claude Code, Codex or any other AI tools extensively. Unlimited tokens available.

What we're looking for

These are the must-haves. The first three are non-negotiable.

  • MUST: AI-native to the core. The majority of your work is AI-assisted. You build with Claude Code / agents every day, you build your own AI workflows, and you're pushing the frontier of how one engineer does the work of a team. If you're not already living this way, this isn't the role for you.

  • MUST: You genuinely love customers. You'd rather be in the room untangling a customer's gnarliest deployment than heads-down in isolation. You're calm and credible in front of platform and engineering leaders, and you get energy from making them successful.

  • MUST: Both a builder AND an ops person. You write real production code and you're at home in the platform/infra world. Ops alone isn't enough — we need you fluent writing code. Dev alone isn't enough — we need real ops instincts. You have to be both.

  • Real platform / SRE / DevOps chops. Expert with Dockerfiles. Comfortable enough with Kubernetes to guide a live Helm-chart install and debug it. Fluent across multiple CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI, Jenkins, and friends).

  • Mid-level, with a strong aptitude for growth. We weight the ability to learn quickly and take initiative over a complete match against every requirement listed here. A solid platform background that's less developed in some areas is fine, provided you are deeply curious to learn fast.

  • High ownership. You navigate ambiguity, set your own path, and own outcomes without waiting to be told how.

  • Backgrounds we love: ex-founders (a failed startup is a plus, not a red flag), technical ex-consultants, and early stage engineers who've shipped B2B products hand-in-hand with customers.

Nice to have

Bring any of these and we'll be glad. Nobody has all of them.

  • Languages: Bash, Python, Go, SQL, TypeScript/Node, Earthfiles.

  • Kubernetes & delivery: authoring Helm charts (not just installing them), ArgoCD, k8s RBAC / NetworkPolicies / ingress.

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi (and comfort reading HCL).

  • Observability: Grafana, OpenTelemetry / OTLP, Prometheus, Datadog.

  • APIs everywhere: GitHub / GitLab APIs, and wiring up the APIs of dev-infra and production-infra tools in general (PagerDuty, Jira/Linear, container registries, cloud providers).

  • Supply chain & code analysis: SBOMs (Syft, Trivy, cdxgen), SCA/SAST (Snyk, Semgrep, Gitleaks), signing & provenance (cosign, SLSA), OPA/Rego, ast-grep / tree-sitter.

  • AI-native building: MCP servers, agent skills and sub-agents, editor/agent hooks (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex).

  • Config wrangling: parsing YAML, HCL, JSON, Dockerfiles, CODEOWNERS into clean structured data.

  • Startup DNA: startup experience; a failed-founder background is a big bonus; a desire to start your own thing one day is very welcome.

  • Product sense: B2B product-building experience, working directly with the customer.

  • Regulated / defense context: familiarity with SOC 2, NIST SSDF, FedRAMP, CMMC, or PCI DSS (some of our customers are in defense and finance).

  • The adjacent space: developer portals / internal platforms (Backstage, Cortex, OpsLevel).

You might not be a fit if

  • You'd rather stay heads-down and away from customers.

  • You want a pure sales-engineering or solutions-architect role and don't really want to write production code — there's plenty of customer-facing work here, but the core bar is that you can build.

  • You're an infra operator who doesn't want to write code — or a developer who doesn't want to touch infra.

  • You need every requirement fully spec'd before you start; this role is high-ambiguity by design.

How we work

  • Small, senior, AI-native team. Heavy AI leverage, high autonomy, fast loops.

  • Your field work becomes the product. What you build with customers lands in lunar-lib and ships to everyone.

  • Top-down go-to-market. We win platform and engineering leaders; you help win them over technically, then make them wildly successful.

  • Direct line to the founder/CEO and outsized ownership of how Lunar lands in the real world.

Compensation & logistics

  • Base salary: $160,000–$210,000 (US base), depending on experience — plus equity.

  • Location: Remote (US & Canada).

  • Travel: Occasional — customer onsites and team gatherings, at most one trip per quarter.

  • Type: Full-time.

Benefits

  • Healthcare, dental, and vision — including dependents (US & Canada)

  • Incentive stock plan

  • 401(k) / RRSP with employer matching (US & Canada)

  • Life insurance (US & Canada)

  • Credits for gym or activity equipment (US & Canada)

  • Fully remote, with everyone within ±3 hours of each other — no late-night meetings

  • An early-stage environment where your work has outsized impact and you operate with real freedom — excellent preparation if you want to take the founder path someday

The salary range above is the US base salary for this full-time position. It does not include equity, bonuses, or other benefits. Ranges are determined by role, level, and location; within the range, individual pay reflects job-related skills, experience, and training. We expect to hire near the middle of the range, and would pay near the top only in rare cases where a candidate's experience far exceeds what the role requires. Your hiring contact can share specifics for your location during the process.

Salary: 160K - 210K USD a year

description:
