City: Remote

State: Texas

JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION: Development Services Coordinator
REPORTS TO: Director of Development Services

JOB SUMMARY:

The Development Services Coordinator provides administrative, project management, contract, client, and operational support across Bureau Veritas's Development Services Division. The position supports Short-Range Services, Long-Range Services, and Private Development, including Planning, Engineering, Public Works, Compliance and Resource Development, GIS, and Asset Management.

Reporting directly to the Division Director, the Coordinator serves as the primary operational support resource responsible for maintaining organized project records, tracking deadlines, facilitating communications, coordinating deliverables, supporting financial administration, and ensuring the efficient movement of projects from initiation through completion.

The position plays an important role in supporting municipal contracts and private development projects while facilitating coordination with Bureau Veritas's Commercial and Residential Building teams for plan review, permitting, and inspection services.

The Coordinator works closely with division leadership, branch managers, technical personnel, business development representatives, and corporate support departments to maintain consistent procedures, improve operational efficiency, and ensure a responsive client experience.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Project Management and Administrative Coordination
• Establish, organize, maintain, and close projects within Bureau Veritas project management and document management systems.
• Maintain accurate project records, including assigned personnel, scopes of work, schedules, milestones, deliverables, budgets, and client deadlines.
• Coordinate project intake, internal assignments, staff schedules, project meetings, and client communication.
• Develop and maintain project tracking reports, status summaries, action-item logs, meeting agendas, and meeting minutes.
• Monitor active project schedules and communicate approaching deadlines, incomplete assignments, and outstanding deliverables to appropriate personnel.
• Track development applications, subdivision and zoning reviews, public hearings, permit milestones, infrastructure inspections, regulatory compliance deadlines, and project closeout requirements.
• Assist technical staff and project managers with document preparation, distribution, and follow-up coordination.
• Support multiple municipal and private development projects simultaneously while maintaining consistent organization and accountability.

2. Client Relations and Communication

  • Serve as a central point of contact for routine client communications, scheduling, project status requests, and administrative inquiries.
    • Coordinate communication between municipal clients, private developers, consultants, technical staff, and division leadership.
    • Schedule and organize client meetings, project coordination calls, public meetings, and internal operational discussions.
    • Prepare routine correspondence, meeting summaries, project updates, and follow-up communications.
    • Maintain current municipal client contact information, organizational records, and contract assignments.
    • Assist with tracking client requests, service issues, and outstanding action items to ensure timely resolution.
    • Support consistent communication standards and professional client service across all division branches.
    3. Contract Administration, Proposals, and Financial Support
    • Maintain organized contract records, including executed agreements, scopes of services, amendments, task orders, purchase orders, authorizations, insurance requirements, and renewal dates.
    • Track contract milestones, expiration dates, renewal opportunities, and required administrative actions.
    • Assist with preparation of proposals, qualifications packages, fee schedules, scope documents, staffing plans, and supporting exhibits.
    • Coordinate proposal deadlines, required documentation, internal approvals, and final submissions.
    • Maintain records of project budgets, authorized contract amounts, billing milestones, and changes in project scope.
    • Coordinate with project managers and billing personnel to prepare invoice support documentation, including project activity summaries, time records, reimbursable expenses, and client billing information.
    • Assist with reconciliation of project tracking information against billing records and authorized scopes.
    • Monitor outstanding billing documentation and coordinate invoice-related follow-up with appropriate personnel.
    • Maintain dashboards identifying active contracts, pending proposals, prospective opportunities, project workload, and revenue-related activities.
    • Provide administrative support for monthly, quarterly, and annual operational reporting.
    4. Technical Project Delivery and Document Control
    • Coordinate the routing of applications, plans, reports, technical reviews, inspection documentation, and project correspondence among assigned professionals.
    • Maintain standardized electronic project files for Planning, Engineering, Public Works, Compliance, GIS, and Asset Management assignments.
    • Track review cycles, resubmittals, outstanding comments, approval milestones, and deliverable completion.
    • Support the preparation and distribution of technical review letters, staff reports, project summaries, meeting packets, and client deliverables.
    • Perform administrative quality-control checks to verify project names, dates, document versions, attachments, formatting, and distribution information.
    • Assist with coordination of required public notice and hearing procedures, including notification schedules, publication deadlines, mailing lists, agenda materials, and confirmation records.
    • Organize project documentation to support municipal recordkeeping, regulatory compliance, and contractual requirements.
    • Coordinate project closeout activities, including final documentation, outstanding deliverables, billing support, and file archiving.
    5. Building Division Coordination and Project Handoffs
    • Coordinate transitions from Development Services to Bureau Veritas's Commercial and Residential Building teams.
    • Maintain standardized project handoff procedures and documentation requirements.
    • Assemble project handoff packages containing approved scopes, client contacts, project descriptions, regulatory approvals, infrastructure status, and outstanding project conditions.
    • Coordinate communications between planning, engineering, inspection, public works, and building review personnel.
    • Track projects requiring subsequent commercial or residential plan review, building permitting, or inspection services.
    • Assist in identifying opportunities for additional Bureau Veritas services during project transitions.
    • Maintain records of completed handoffs and monitor outstanding coordination items to support uninterrupted client service.
    6. Division Operations and Process Improvement
    • Maintain standardized folder structures, file naming conventions, document templates, project tracking systems, and administrative procedures.
    • Assist in developing, documenting, and implementing standard operating procedures across Development Services branches.
    • Support implementation and maintenance of SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, project management platforms, CRM systems, and other operational tools.
    • Maintain division-wide dashboards for staffing assignments, project status, client activity, deadlines, and operational performance.
    • Identify administrative inefficiencies, missing information, workflow delays, and opportunities for process improvement.
    • Coordinate shared administrative resources and information among branch managers and technical teams.
    • Assist division leadership with operational planning, reporting, scheduling, and special projects.
    • Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of client records, contractual documents, and internal business information.
    7. Business Development and Marketing Support
    • Maintain municipal and private-sector client databases, contact lists, prospect records, and business development tracking information.
    • Assist with development of capability statements, marketing materials, qualifications packages, and proposal presentations.
    • Coordinate administrative aspects of conferences, professional events, client meetings, and business development activities.
    • Track prospective contracts, follow-up actions, proposal submissions, and client engagement activities.
    • Assist with compiling supporting information for service expansion, staffing plans, and division growth initiatives.
    • Coordinate with Bureau Veritas business development and marketing personnel to ensure consistent communication and presentation of Development Services capabilities.
    KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
    • Knowledge of administrative and project coordination practices within professional services, municipal government, engineering, planning, construction, or related environments.
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and overlapping deadlines.
    • Ability to maintain accurate project records, contract information, billing documentation, and operational reports.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
    • Working knowledge of SharePoint, electronic records management, and project tracking systems.
    • Ability to develop and maintain spreadsheets, project dashboards, status reports, and document control systems.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with municipal clients, developers, technical personnel, and corporate departments.
    • Knowledge of basic contract administration, proposal coordination, and project billing procedures.
    • Ability to identify discrepancies, missing documentation, overdue assignments, and potential coordination issues.
    • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation, project tracking, and administrative quality control.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting a geographically distributed team.
    • Ability to handle confidential business, contractual, financial, and client information appropriately.
    • Ability to adapt to new systems, procedures, and changing operational priorities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate degree or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Project Management, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
    • Equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and professional experience may be considered.
    • Three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in project coordination, administrative support, business operations, client relations, team coordination, or organizational management.

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Possesses valid Texas Class “C" license when hired.

PREFERENCES:

  • Experience working with municipal governments, engineering consulting firms, planning departments, construction firms, or development services organizations.
    • Familiarity with zoning, subdivision review, development permitting, municipal public meetings, infrastructure inspection, or related development processes.
    • Experience supporting contract administration, proposal development, professional services billing, or project financial tracking.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft SharePoint, project management platforms, CRM systems, electronic permitting systems, or GIS-related applications.
    • Experience supporting multiple clients or contracts in a consulting or professional services environment.
    • Project management credentials such as CAPM or PMP, or other relevant professional certifications.
    • Experience implementing administrative procedures, document control standards, and workflow improvement initiatives.

title: Computer Vision / Applied AI Intern — Summer 2027
description:
Simbe is building the AI-powered operating system for physical retail. Our autonomous robots and multimodal computer vision platform turn complex, constantly changing stores into accurate, actionable intelligence for leading retailers around the world. Simbe combines robotics, computer vision, machine learning, data infrastructure, and customer-focused product design to help retailers improve shelf availability, price and promo execution, inventory accuracy, and store team productivity.

Simbe is looking for a Computer Vision / Applied AI Intern to join the team building and improving the computer vision systems that transform imagery collected by Tally into actionable retail intelligence.

This internship is designed for students who want hands-on experience applying computer vision and machine learning to real-world data and production systems at meaningful scale.

Why This Internship Is High Impact

  • Work with real-world visual data. Help improve systems that interpret imagery collected by autonomous robots operating in live retail environments.

  • Learn production computer vision. Gain exposure to the full lifecycle of CV/ML systems, from datasets and experimentation through evaluation and production deployment.

  • Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

  • Own a defined project. You’ll be given clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

  • Learn from experienced CV and ML engineers. You’ll work directly with Simbe engineers and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.

  • See how models perform in the real world. Work with the challenges that come from noisy imagery, changing retail environments, data quality, edge cases, and production requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Computer Vision / Applied AI team’s priorities during your internship.

  • Develop, test, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning solutions using Python and modern ML frameworks.

  • Work with production image datasets and help identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Contribute to areas such as object detection, OCR, barcode decoding, segmentation, dataset curation, annotation quality, model evaluation, or error mining depending on current team needs.

  • Build or improve tools that support dataset analysis, model evaluation, experimentation, or production workflows.

  • Write maintainable, well-structured code and contribute tests where appropriate.

  • Use quantitative analysis to evaluate model performance and communicate findings clearly.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Computer Vision, Applied AI, Data, Robot Software, and other technical teams.

  • Communicate progress, technical decisions, challenges, and results throughout the internship.

  • Present your project, approach, results, and key learnings at the end of the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field.

  • We primarily target students in their final year of study and will also consider strong juniors.

  • Strong Python programming skills, including familiarity with common data structures, algorithms, and software development practices.

  • Coursework or hands-on experience in computer vision, machine learning, or deep learning.

  • Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or a comparable machine learning framework.

  • Experience working with structured Python projects beyond notebooks alone.

  • Familiarity with Git or another source-control system.

  • Comfortable working with data to evaluate results, investigate failures, and support technical decisions.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills and willingness to work through ambiguous or unfamiliar problems.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Personal computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or software projects outside of coursework.

  • Previous internship, research, or project experience involving computer vision or machine learning.

  • Experience with object detection, image segmentation, OCR, barcode recognition, image classification, or related vision problems.

  • Experience creating, cleaning, curating, or evaluating image datasets.

  • Familiarity with model evaluation techniques, error analysis, experiment tracking, or data-quality workflows.

  • Experience with pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, Jupyter, SQL, or related data and ML tooling.

  • Familiarity with Linux, shell scripting, Docker, or cloud-based development environments.

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding and engineering tools and the ability to thoughtfully validate generated output.

Internship Program Structure

Interns join Simbe as part of a structured cohort and work full time from our Burlingame, California headquarters.

Each intern will have:

  • A defined technical project aligned with current team priorities

  • A hiring manager responsible for project scope, performance, and feedback

  • A dedicated mentor separate from the hiring manager

  • Structured midpoint feedback

  • Regular opportunities to collaborate with and learn from Simbe engineers

  • A final project presentation at the end of the internship

We do not believe in creating busywork for interns. Your project will be selected closer to your start date based on active team priorities so that you can contribute to meaningful work alongside our full-time engineering team.

Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. L.

Result Driven — We are customer-centric and results-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors.

Empathetic — We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally.

Transparent — We value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.

Agile — We are eager to learn and adapt quickly to changes and customer needs.

Innovative — We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design, user experience, and customer value.

Leaders — We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in Portugal.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

      • Employment Type: Full-time.

      • Recruitment Process: The process includes a screening call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the VP of Product, a case study with the VP of Product and DPO, and reference checks. Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.

We’re seeking compassionate professionals to join our Children First Residential Care Program, where you’ll provide trauma-informed, culturally responsive care in a safe and supportive environment. If you are passionate about serving vulnerable populations and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join our mission-focused team.


Many roles require fluency in English and Spanish. Explore opportunities in our Career Center and make a difference where it matters most.


Case Manager Job Summary


The Case Manager is responsible for the submission of service plans and other assessments required for the compiling of a comprehensive case file with supporting documentation maintained in physical files. Responsible for coordinating case management, safe and timely release services, and ensuring timely completion of ORR case management requirements. The Case Manager will facilitate coordination between all disciplines within the program to ensure timely reunification and safety of youths. The Case Manager demonstrates knowledge of and familiarity with the Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) policy and procedures relating to the care and supervision of unaccompanied children (UC). This includes knowledge of legal background and authority governing the practice as related to working with unaccompanied children.


Essential Functions:

title: SRE Splunk Enterprise Administrator – (w/ active Secret)
description:
SRE Splunk Enterprise Administrator – (w/ active Secret)

Location: Norfolk, VA
Clearance: Secret

JOB DESCRIPTION

Critical Solutions is seeking a SRE Splunk Enterprise Administrator to support our federal customer.

The Splunk Enterprise Administrator will be part of the Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) supporting mission-critical cybersecurity operations by administering and maintaining distributed Splunk Enterprise platforms across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.   • Administer, maintain, and perform daily Operations and Maintenance (O&M) for distributed Splunk Enterprise environments, including Search Heads, Indexers, Heavy Forwarders, Intermediate Forwarders, Universal Forwarders, and Deployment Servers across hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Monitor platform health, data ingestion, indexing throughput, search performance, and retention utilization; troubleshoot data onboarding, parsing, field extraction, forwarding, indexing, and ingestion issues.
  • Support Splunk Cloud integrations and associated hybrid operational activities.
  • Maintain Splunk applications, dashboards, alerts, saved searches, and knowledge objects.
  • Support patching, vulnerability remediation, Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) compliance, and system hardening activities.
  • Support platform upgrades, migrations, infrastructure modernization, technology refresh, and automation initiatives using scripting and configuration-management tools.
  • Participate in incident response, outage troubleshooting, problem resolution, and root cause analysis.

  • Minimum of DoD 8570.01 IAT Level II Certification required.
  • Must have a Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin or Splunk Cloud Certified Admin Certification.
  • Minimum three years of experience administering Splunk Enterprise v9 and supporting distributed Splunk architectures in hybrid cloud and on-premises production environments.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 8 and/or RHEL 9 servers.
  • Experience with STIGs, the Risk Management Framework (RMF), vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining operational dashboards, visualizations, and executive reporting in Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud.
  • Strong working knowledge of Splunk data ingestion pipelines, indexing, parsing, forwarding, search optimization, and retention management.
  • Experience using at least one scripting or automation language: Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, collaborate across technical teams, and maintain a customer-focused approach in a high-tempo production environment.
  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to work onsite at Norfolk Station Monday through Friday day shift.
  • Must be able to participate in after-hours support and an on-call rotation as required.

  • Minimum of DoD 8570.01 IAT Level II Certification AND must have a Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin or Splunk Cloud Certified Admin Certification.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with automated script design, coding, debugging, and maintenance skills (using bash, python, etc.) preferred.
  • •Experience working in classified government or Department of Defense environments.
  • •Familiarity with RHEL 10

LOCATION:

  • On-site 100%. Norfolk, VA
  • Ability to work onsite at Norfolk Monday through Friday day shift.
  • Participate in after-hours support and an on-call rotation as required.

Key Metrics of Success for the Team:

  • Comprehensive and regularly updated automated test coverage for all critical systems and infrastructure components.
  • Timely identification and resolution of performance bottlenecks and failure points.
  • Integration of automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline, ensuring continuous reliability validation.
  • Increased scalability and performance of systems under high load due to effective performance testing.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT: Must possess an active DoD Secret Clearance. In addition, selected candidate must undergo background investigation (BI) and finger printing by the federal agency and successfully pass the preceding to qualify for the position. US CITIZENSHIP IS REQUIRED.

As an intern, you’ll work alongside our Hardware Engineering team and contribute to a meaningful project tied to the team’s active priorities. Your specific project will be selected by your hiring manager closer to your start date so that your work directly supports what the team is building at that time.

Depending on current priorities, your work may involve areas such as mechanical component design or redesign, DFM/DFA improvements, prototyping, bench testing, reliability improvements, manufacturing support, or early concepts for future generations of the Tally platform.

This internship is designed for students who want hands-on experience building physical robotic systems and solving real-world mechanical engineering problems.

Why This Internship Is High Impact

  • Work on real robots. Contribute to the mechanical systems behind Tally robots operating every day in live retail environments.

  • Learn production hardware engineering. Gain exposure to design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, reliability, and field-driven iteration.

  • Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

  • Own a defined project. You’ll be given clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

  • Learn from experienced hardware engineers. You’ll work directly with Simbe engineers and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.

  • See the full product lifecycle. Gain exposure to how design decisions move from concept and CAD through prototypes, testing, manufacturing, and field deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Hardware team’s priorities during your internship.

  • Support mechanical design and redesign work for components and assemblies on the Tally robot platform.

  • Create and update CAD models, drawings, and related design documentation.

  • Build and evaluate prototypes using appropriate fabrication and prototyping methods.

  • Conduct bench testing, collect data, document results, and help identify design improvements.

  • Support design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly efforts based on field, reliability, or manufacturing feedback.

  • Assist with root-cause analysis of mechanical issues and evaluate potential design changes.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Hardware, Robot Software, Manufacturing, Operations, and other technical teams.

  • Communicate progress, technical decisions, tradeoffs, challenges, and results throughout the internship.

  • Present your project, approach, results, and key learnings at the end of the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Product Design, or a related technical field.

  • We primarily target students in their final year of study and will also consider strong juniors.

  • Experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, Fusion 360, Onshape, or similar.

  • Understanding of core mechanical design principles, including materials, tolerances, fasteners, fits, and basic manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on experience building, prototyping, assembling, or testing physical systems.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and communicate design intent clearly.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills and willingness to work through ambiguous or unfamiliar problems.

  • Ability to work effectively in a hands-on engineering environment.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Personal robotics, mechanical, mechatronics, or product-design projects outside of coursework.

  • Previous hardware, mechanical engineering, robotics, manufacturing, or product development internship experience.

  • Experience designing components for CNC machining, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing, or other manufacturing processes.

  • Familiarity with DFM/DFA principles and tolerance analysis.

  • Experience with mechanical testing, fixture design, reliability testing, or failure analysis.

  • Experience working with motors, sensors, actuators, electromechanical assemblies, or mobile robots.

  • Familiarity with basic electronics, wiring, or hardware/software integration.

  • Experience with FEA or other mechanical simulation tools.

  • Experience working on a robotics team, Formula SAE, Baja SAE, research lab, competition team, or similar hands-on engineering organization.

  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering or design tools and the ability to thoughtfully validate generated output.

Internship Program Structure

Interns join Simbe as part of a structured cohort and work full time from our Burlingame, California headquarters.

Each intern will have:

  • A defined technical project aligned with current team priorities

  • A hiring manager responsible for project scope, performance, and feedback

  • A dedicated mentor separate from the hiring manager

  • Structured midpoint feedback

  • Regular opportunities to collaborate with and learn from Simbe engineers

  • A final project presentation at the end of the internship

We do not believe in creating busywork for interns. Your project will be selected closer to your start date based on active team priorities so that you can contribute to meaningful work alongside our full-time engineering team.

Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. L.

Result Driven — We are customer-centric and results-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors.

Empathetic — We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally.

Transparent — We value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.

Agile — We are eager to learn and adapt quickly to changes and customer needs.

Innovative — We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design, user experience, and customer value.

Leaders — We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

title: Bilingual Logistics Coordinator
description:
General Summary of Job Duties

The Bilingual Logistics Coordinator is responsible for delivering a high level of customer service through effective communication, attention to detail, and strong organizational skills. This role coordinates all aspects of logistics operations in support of customers, including booking shipments, coordinating dispatch and intermodal logistics, and managing equipment control. The coordinator serves as the primary liaison between customers, trucking partners, terminals, and other vendors to ensure seamless cargo movement. Additional responsibilities include managing accessorial billing, processing vendor and customer invoices, resolving service issues, ensuring regulatory compliance, and contributing to process improvement initiatives.

Specific Essential Job Duties

  • Coordinate end-to-end customer shipments, including booking creation, pickup and delivery arrangements, dispatching, and communication with truckers and terminals.
  • Collaborate with terminal operators to manage load lists, perform reconciliations, and ensure accuracy of cargo loaded versus expected load plans.
  • Monitor and manage intermodal shipments, ensuring smooth handoffs between modes of transport and resolving any logistical disruptions.
  • Maintain accurate cargo tracking and tracing records, providing timely updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate cargo release processes within the San Juan terminal system, ensuring compliance with port requirements and timely delivery.
  • Serve as a key liaison between customers, truckers, terminals, railroads, and other vendors to coordinate logistics and resolve issues.
  • Manage customer inquiries and service requests received via phone or shared email inbox with professionalism and urgency.
  • Handle accounts receivable functions, including generating and issuing standalone invoices for assessorial charges not covered under standard freight or bill of lading rates (e.g., labor, equipment misuse); ensure accuracy and timely processing of customer charges.
  • Manage equipment control functions, including usage tracking, billing for accessorial charges, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Review and process accounts payable invoices from trucking vendors and other service providers.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable government and regulatory requirements, including U.S. Customs procedures, Puerto Rico Hacienda tax filings, wharfage fees, and SED (Shipper’s Export Declaration) filings. Promote safe and secure cargo transport practices in accordance with local and federal laws.
  • Maintain updated customer profiles in the back-office system to ensure accuracy in documentation and billing.
  • Identify service exceptions, troubleshoot escalated issues, and implement timely resolutions.
  • Provide input to management on process improvement initiatives and support departmental projects as needed.
  • Abide by company HSEQ policies and procedures.
  • This job description is not exhaustive; additional duties may be assigned as needed. This role may evolve in response to changes in industry practices and technological advancements.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish required.
  • Prior experience with logistics or shipping software; familiarity with CargoWise is a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel; experience working with databases preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand and follow logical processes.
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills, with a courteous and professional demeanor.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong accuracy in data entry and time management.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision or collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Demonstrated discretion and ability to handle confidential information with professionalism.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • General administrative or clerical experience preferred, including mail, filing, and document handling.
  • Must be flexible and adaptable to evolving responsibilities and technology, with a willingness to perform additional duties as assigned to support departmental needs.

Working Conditions

  • This position is based in a professional office environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • Work is typically performed in a climate-controlled setting with standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
  • Occasional lifting of office supplies or documents weighing up to 25 pounds may be required.
  • Minimal exposure to physical risk; however, employees must follow all company safety protocols, including proper ergonomic practices and general workplace safety procedures.
  • May be required to attend safety briefings or training relevant to the maritime industry to support understanding of company operations.
  • Must adhere to all workplace policies and contribute to a safe, organized, and professional office environment.

title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Romania.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

Accountabilities

  • IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications.
  • Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations.
  • Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary.
  • IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in France.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

title: Visual/Dimensional Inspector (1st Shift Weekend, Fri-Mon)
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The intermediate level Visual/Dimensional Inspector will inspect aerospace and marine gas turbine engine components for airworthiness and conformance to original equipment manufacturer (OEM) standards during receiving, in-process, and final inspections. This position will verify and validate work performed by CRT and subcontractors to meet specifications in accordance with FAA and other world regulatory bodies.
The Inspector position will perform these important tasks from an all-new state-of-the-art building (completed in June of 2023) with ultra-modern technology and equipment throughout.
Through our extensive in-house training program, the successful applicant will be instructed via a series of computer based and hands-on training, the necessary skills of the position.
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector. Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufactures. Component Repair Technologies is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community.
In 2025, CRT became a Safran Aircraft Engines company as a Center of Excellence for the repair of large jet engine parts in the Americas.
For over 120 years, Safran, through its Aircraft Engines subsidiary, designs, produces, markets and supports, alone or in partnership, aircraft engines offering world-class performance and reliability. Its core purpose is to contribute to a safer, more sustainable world, where air transport is more environmentally friendly, comfortable and accessible.
Operating through CFM International, its 50/50 joint venture with GE Aerospace, Safran Aircraft Engines is the world’s leading supplier of single-aisle commercial jet engines, the CFM56 and LEAP. Safran Aircraft Engines is fully committed to sustainable aviation through the RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) technology development program. Safran Aircraft Engines also deploys a global network providing a full range of support, maintenance & repair services.
Visit and for more information.
Take-off in your career, learn new skills and become part of a world-class workforce.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Through our extensive in-house training program, the successful applicant will be instructed via a series of computer based and hands-on training, the necessary skills of the position.
1. Visually inspect components for wear, corrosion, fretting, gouges, bent or worn features, elongated holes, and any other damage of the turbine engine.
2. Measure parts using various measuring devices, such as micrometers, calipers, surface gages, dial-indicator gages, and other inspection tools to measure sizes.
3. Determine whether part features meet standards for serviceability, reparability, and overhauled condition.
4. Interpret standards provided by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) manuals and instructions for continued airworthiness and industry standards. Thoroughly document visual and dimensional inspection findings in reporting forms.
5. Documentation Inspection – Check customer purchase orders and other customer documentation, check vendor documentation, and CRT documentation.
6. Reporting – Clearly report all findings. Record location, size, acceptability parameters, and other information relevant to the evaluation, acceptance, and corrections.
7. Work closely with the engineering team on new component procedures and repairs to ensure continuous improvement in the department.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
1. Two years of experience in aircraft maintenance, (or similar experience) in the civilian or military fields, or an applicable technical accreditation in a machine shop, manufacturing environment, mechanical engineering, or journeyman certificate.
2. Exposure to visual inspection methods, techniques, practices, and aids that are appropriate for the article being inspected.
3. Proficiency in the use of various gages to include calipers, borescopes, micrometers, optical or electronic comparators.
4. General knowledge of turbine engine components, functions, repairs and shop processes.
OTHER QUALIFICATIONS
1. High school or technical school graduate or equivalent.
2. Demonstrated ability to perform basic mathematical operations, including working with decimals, fractions, and basic shop math.
3. Previous experience, familiarity, or exposure with measuring gages such as calipers and micrometers.
4. The ability to interpret and follow written and verbal instructions accurately.
5. Careful attention to detail.
6. Motivated, enthusiastic, and willing to learn.
7. Ability to communicate effectively and work in a team environment.
8. Basic knowledge of computers and standard software programs.
9. Read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
WORK ENVIRONMENT
1. This position has pre-employment testing requirements that may require fitness for duty testing and a vision exam.
2. Follow general shop safety procedures including the occasional use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection.
3. Work in difficult positions from time to time. Stand and/or sit for portions of the shift. Move parts (>50 pounds) using hoists, slings, carts, or other handling methods. Move less heavy parts (<50 pounds) with or without hoists, slings, or carts.
4. Occasionally use powered and non-powered hand tools.
COMPANY BENEFITS
Our employees and families are the number one asset at CRT. A progressive and innovative benefits package is in place, such as:
1. CRT currently offers two excellent health care options, one being a fully funded program (no premiums for employee and family) and the other being a traditional employee premium contribution. Programs include health, vision, and dental coverages. Additional programs include short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
2. The company offers a 401k program with company match.
3. Continuing education is offered via multiple sources and opportunities with tuition reimbursement based on eligibility requirements.
4. Traditional paid time off (PTO) is offered via vacation days and personal days.
5. Multiple shift opportunities with hourly premiums for off-shifts are offered.
To review other benefits, visit our website at or Facebook page to see, “what we are up to.”

title: Technology Architect (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The API Technology Architect is a customer-facing technical specialist within Lumen’s Solutions With Advanced Technology (SWAT) Team. This role helps customers and Technical Sellers successfully use Lumen APIs to automate service ordering, provisioning, modification, management, and integration with customer and partner systems.

The API Technology Architect combines hands-on API architecture and integration expertise with technical seller enablement, documentation, training, field support, and product advocacy. The successful candidate will lead API-focused discovery and technical consultations, guide integration designs, help troubleshoot complex customer scenarios, and translate business requirements into secure, supportable, and reusable API-driven solutions.

The Main Responsibilities

API Architecture and Customer Integration

  • Lead technical discovery with customers and account teams to understand business objectives, automation goals, systems, workflows, security requirements, operational constraints, and measures of success.

Cross-Portfolio Technology Expertise

Customer and Technical Seller Engagement

  • Lead or participate in customer workshops, architecture discussions, technical demonstrations, integration reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and onboarding calls.
  • Serve as an escalation and consultation resource for Technical Sellers who need specialized API knowledge for complex or multi-product opportunities.

Documentation, Training, and Knowledge Transfer

  • Create and maintain practical API enablement resources, including design guides, reference architectures, integration patterns, quick-reference materials, example workflows, and FAQs.
  • Partner with Product Management, API Platforms, development teams, and documentation owners to improve the usability, consistency, technical accuracy, and discoverability of API resources.
  • Develop and deliver engaging API education for Technical Sellers and other internal stakeholders through live sessions, recorded demonstrations, short-form instructional videos, technical discussions, office hours, and deeper architecture workshops.

Success Measures:

  • Customers and Technical Sellers being better equipped to evaluate, design, and implement supportable API-driven solutions.
  • High-quality, reusable API architecture and enablement assets that reduce repeated discovery and make field engagements more consistent.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and professional experience.
  • 10 or more years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: technical pre-sales, solution architecture, API or integration architecture, software or platform consulting, network automation, or telecommunications engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical discovery and translating customer business and technical requirements into clear, supportable solution designs.
  • Working knowledge of API authentication and authorization concepts, including OAuth 2.0, tokens, credentials, scopes, and secure handling of secrets.
  • Strong written, verbal, listening, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with developers, engineers, architects, sales teams, product teams, operations teams, and business leaders.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer engagements, enablement deliverables, and competing priorities.

title: Robotics Software Intern
description:
Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing!
Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more.

Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them.

As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable.
We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them.
Why This Matters
We don’t just build robots; we build the infrastructure for the next generation of biologics manufacturing. Our technology allows biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, drastically lowering regulatory hurdles and bringing costs down to a level where these treatments can actually reach patients.
The Stack & The Scale
The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all.
The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning.
The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
The Backing: Supported by premier investors, including Casdin Capital, Lux Capital, and Y Combinator.
About the Role
We are looking for Robotics Software Engineering Interns to join a highly collaborative team to deliver production ready software that will shape the future of personalized medicine and cell therapy manufacturing systems. This role is for you if you are a strong problem solver, motivated and hard-working student, and excited to experience what it’s like being an engineer at an early-stage startup.

Responsibilities include:

  • Contribute to production-ready code for robotic platforms, helping to implement specific modules for hardware communication and system behaviors under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Design, build and deploy algorithms for motion control, trajectory planning, or sensor data processing; and perform data analysis to evaluate algorithm performance.
  • Help build and maintain simulation environments for robot validation, writing unit and integration tests to improve the robustness of the codebase and support our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with mechanical and systems teams to help troubleshoot real-world issues on physical robots, assisting in data collection and bug reproduction during system-level testing.
  • Participate in code reviews, document system architectures, and work closely with senior mentors to learn and apply industry-standard clean architecture and testing patterns.

Qualifications

  • Currently working towards a Bachelor, Masters, or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast paced, technically challenging startup environment.
  • Strong background in: linear algebra, Python, data science, and robotics principles
  • Strong communication skills that clearly express ideas and design details in meetings, team presentations, white board brainstorming sessions and in various technical documentation.
  • Prioritize organization and detail orientation, with ability to handle multiple project and task assignments simultaneously.
  • Passionate, curious, and eager to learn.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with robotic systems and robotics principles, including kinematics, dynamics, motion planning, and control theory.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS.
  • Industry experience with Python.

Total Rewards & Life at Multiply Labs

  • Competitive Compensation: $5,000-$7,000/month.

  • Real Ownership: Own meaningful design projects on robots that go into production, not side tasks.

  • Mentorship: Work side by side with experienced mechanical, robotics, and software engineers.

  • Office Perks: An energetic SF office culture featuring catered team lunches, stocked kitchen, and frequent team events.

  • Great people, meaningful work, and a team that genuinely believes in what we’re building.

  • No Set Hours: Set your own schedule in alignment with your manager and team. We hold a high bar, measuring success by impact and outcomes—not hours logged.

Come build the world’s best robots—and help make life-saving therapies accessible to all.

We actively seek candidates with diverse perspectives and lived experiences. We’re committed to building a team where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work.

Multiply Labs encourages candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every qualification. If you’re excited about our mission and think you can contribute, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

What You'll Do

  • Shape a compelling product vision and strategy for TV and Desktop, grounded in how people use each surface and the opportunities to improve their experience.
  • Identify where to invest, what to experiment with, and how to measure success, combining user research, data, and thoughtful product judgment.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional product initiatives from exploration through launch and iteration, aligning priorities and navigating dependencies along the way.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, and insights to create intuitive, high-quality experiences that balance usability, performance, and reliability.
  • Connect product decisions across Spotify and with external partners where relevant, recognizing the different opportunities and constraints of each platform.
  • Communicate a clear and compelling product narrative that brings teams and senior stakeholders together around shared priorities.
  • Elevate product thinking across teams by encouraging curiosity, constructive debate, and a focus on meaningful outcomes.

Who You Are

  • You have a strong track record of shaping product strategy and delivering high-quality digital consumer experiences across multiple teams.
  • You know how to turn ambiguous opportunities into clear priorities, actionable decisions, and measurable value for users.
  • You combine a deep understanding of user needs with product intuition, data, experimentation, and an openness to changing your perspective.
  • You understand technical trade-offs and can collaborate effectively with engineering teams working on complex platforms.
  • You build alignment and influence decisions across disciplines, teams, and organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and can bring diverse stakeholders together around a shared product direction.
  • You're comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on execution, adapting your approach to different product challenges.
  • You value collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and creating an environment where different perspectives help shape better products.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! This role leads the development and execution of corporate brand strategy, internal and external communications, executive communications, media relations, and reputation management.   • Establish corporate brand standards, governance processes, and guidelines, ensuring consistent expression of the brand across functions, locations, and stakeholder groups.

  • Ensures the corporate brand reflects the organization's purpose, strategy, values, culture, and desired reputation.

  • Partner with Marketing to maintain clear alignment between the corporate brand and product/customer brands while establishing appropriate ownership and decision rights.

  • Evaluate opportunities to strengthen corporate brand awareness, differentiation, and stake

  • Monitor external perceptions, media coverage, stakeholder sentiment, and issues that could affect the organization.

  • Collaborate with leadership to develop and execute an integrated enterprise communications platform aligned with the organization’s strategy.

  • Lead corporate communications across internal and external stakeholder audiences with a balanced framework that ensures consistency.

  • Oversee corporate announcements, press releases, organizational communications, leadership messages, presentations, talking points, FAQs, and other internal and external communications.

  • Oversee enterprise-level content across corporate websites, social channels, presentations, reports, videos, publications, and leadership platforms.

title: Spring 2027 Cyber and Technology Innovation  Internship
description:
Internship Opportunities

The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD) is a Washington, DC-based nonpartisan 501(c)(3) research institute focusing on national security and foreign policy. FDD conducts in-depth research, produces accurate and timely analyses, identifies illicit activities, and provides policy options – all with the aim of strengthening U.S. national security and reducing or eliminating threats posed by adversaries and enemies of the United States and other free nations. FDD does not accept donations from any foreign governments.

About FDD's Internship Program


The Foundation for Defense of Democracies offers a variety of internship opportunities designed to provide meaningful professional development. Interns participate in a twice-monthly speaker series featuring senior staff members in a small-group setting and are encouraged to strengthen their academic and analytical skills through close collaboration with FDD scholars and experts. The organization offers stipends and can assist students seeking academic credit; however, stipend eligibility requirements must be met. FDD provides both hybrid and remote internship options.


Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. It is recommended that interested candidates submit applications early. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

The Center on Cyber and Technology Innovation

FDD's Center on Cyber and Technology Innovation (CCTI) is seeking part-time or full-time interns. CCTI promotes a greater understanding within the U.S. government, private sector, and allied countries of the threats and opportunities to national security and economic prosperity posed by the rapidly expanding technological environment. Interns will work closely with CCTI director Annie Fixler, senior policy analyst Jiwon Ma, and CCTI Senior Director RADM (ret) Mark Montgomery to conduct research on cyber capabilities and intentions of U.S. adversaries and on policy and technological solutions to these challenges.

Qualified interns will have coursework in international relations, national security policy, computer science, and/or a relevant STEM field of study. Qualified interns will have an interest in the intersection between cyber, national security, and economic power, as well as the ability to work alone and as a member of a team. An understanding of computer networking, cybersecurity best practices, writing for government audiences, and previous research on cyber-related topics is a plus. Experience on Capitol Hill is helpful, but certainly not required. Standout candidates are responsive, self-motivated, and able to learn and work quickly. In-person interns are preferred, but virtual participants will be considered equally. For additional information about CCTI, please visit fdd.org/ccti

Please apply by midnight on Thursday, November 5, 2026 for your application to be considered. Applications submitted prior to November 5 will be reviewed on a rolling basis.


Eligibility
