title: Instructional Designer and AI Learning Specialist
description:
Instructional Designer and AI Learning Specialist
U24: $76,486.40 - $122,359.00 (Salaries for internal candidates are determined by a promotional formula. Salaries for external candidates are determined up to step 4: $87,954.55, or dependent on qualifications)

Learning Technology, Innovation, and Services
102 West State Street Trenton, NJ 08608


Thomas Edison State University was founded in 1972 to break down barriers to degree completion. Fifty years later, it proudly serves a diverse body of adult students with innovative and professionally relevant academic programming in a predominantly online delivery. Our team of high-energy student-focused professionals is welcoming new members who are making their mark in education and are ready to help change the lives of thousands of adult students across New Jersey and around the world.

Candidates who are excited by changing lives, committed to the success of all and want to be challenged by new and innovative opportunities, should submit an application.

Summary:


The Instructional Designer & AI Learning Specialist designs, develops, and revises online courses in the Canvas learning management system using Thomas Edison State University's ADDIE-based course development model. Working closely with subject matter experts, assessment developers, learning technologists, and academic leadership, the Instructional Designer & AI Learning Specialist translates disciplinary expertise into pedagogically sound learning experiences that align objectives, activities, and assessments and meet institutional standards for accessibility, course mapping, and credit hour alignment. This role also leads the responsible integration of artificial intelligence into course design and development — building prompts, templates, and AI-supported workflows that accelerate production, embedding AI-enhanced learning activities tied to workforce-relevant skills, and guiding teams in applying institutional AI policies and academic integrity expectations. In addition, the Instructional Designer & AI Learning Specialist manages course revision projects from intake through completion, balancing multiple competing priorities against fixed academic deadlines such as term starts and program rollouts, and brings a deep understanding of the self-directed, practical needs of adult learners in digital environments.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Instructional Design

- Design, build, revise, and implement online courses in Canvas consistent with TESU's ADDIE-based course development model, ensuring alignment among learning objectives, activities, and assessments.

- Evaluate and select instructional materials — including OER, multimedia, and online resources — that support effective and sustainable course design.

- Guide subject matter experts in developing content and integrating it into sound learning experiences, applying instructional design theory, UX principles, learning technologies (e.g., LTI integrations), and emerging tools.

- Review and edit course content for clarity, quality, and adherence to instructional design standards and c copyright guidelines.

- Ensure courses meet institutional quality standards, including ADA accessibility, course mapping, credit hour alignment, and student success and engagement priorities.

- Collaborate with staff, faculty, SMEs, and other stakeholders using Canvas, Google Docs, MS Teams, and Slack

- Observe cybersecurity best practices.

AI-Assisted Course Design and Development

- Guide course design and development teams in applying institutional AI policies, promoting ethical AI use, and supporting academic integrity through clear expectations and responsible practices.

- Lead the incorporation of AI-infused course learning activities (case studies, projects, written assignments, etc.) that are aligned with workforce-relevant skills and program outcomes.

- Collaborate with the Learning Technologist and Artificial Intelligence Coordinator to apply AI coding assistants, lightweight scripting, and automation tools to streamline repetitive instructional design workflows and accelerate creation of syllabi, learning objectives, evaluation rubrics, and accessible course assets.

- Continuously upskill the instructional design team’s AI integration skills by developing prompts, templates, AI agents, and generative AI materials that accelerate creation of syllabi, learning objectives, active learning scenarios, case studies, and accessible course assets.

- Support AI tool integration in alignment with TESU strategic priorities, data governance, privacy, security, compliance, and bias mitigation, and monitor emerging AI trends and research to inform course design and institutional adoption.

Project Management

- Partner with the Senior Director on the course project intake process and with Associate and Assistant Deans on prioritizing and coordinating course revision projects.

- Manage multiple competing course project priorities, navigating academic governance, and consistently meeting tight, fixed deadlines (e.g., term starts) without compromising course quality or student experience.

- Independently organize, drive, and execute complex instructional design initiatives from inception through completion in a fast-paced higher education environment.

- Participate in university initiatives, committees, and assigned projects.

Additional Competencies

- Deep understanding of the unique motivations, self-directed nature, and practical needs of adult learners in an online learning environment.

- Strong interpersonal skills to build trusting relationships across instructional design, assessment development, learning technology, and academic leadership teams.

Requirements:


Education: Graduation from an accredited college with a Bachelor's degree supplemented by a Master's degree in a field related to the position to be filled or an equivalency as determined by the appointing authority.

Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of professional instructional design or related experience in a higher education institution directly related to the functions of the position to be filled (e.g., Instructional Designer), or equivalency as determined by the appointing authority.


- Applicants who do not possess the required education may substitute required experience on a year-for-year basis (30 credit hours is considered one year of college).

- A Ph.D. or an Ed.D. degree may be substituted for two years of the required experience.

*TESU strives to offer a flexible work environment while balancing the operational needs of the University. As such, we have several options for hybrid-work schedules. Positions determine what type of hybrid-work schedule is available and, if necessary, adjustments are made to support University operations.

Thomas Edison State University is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

title: CT Technologist I - Full Time Nights
description:
JOB LOCATION – Wilkes-Barre General Hospital

JOB SHIFT – Nightshift (10:30 pm - 7:00 am)

** This position is eligible for a $20K Sign On Bonus **

POSITION PURPOSE

The computed tomography (CT) technologist performs computed tomography procedures producing sectional and three dimensional images for interpretation by and at the request of a licensed healthcare practitioner. The CT technologist acquires data and reformats it into images needed for diagnosis and for the performance of interventional and therapeutic procedures. The CT technologist integrates scientific knowledge about patient conditions, technical skills, and information obtained through patient interaction to result in diagnostic information. The CT technologist assesses and monitors patients, and takes appropriate action in emergency situations to maintain quality patient care. A CT technologist exercises independent professional and ethical judgment. Ensures a high quality of images produced. Responsible for availability and sterility of equipment and supplies used for assigned areas. Performs other related duties as assigned.


POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Graduate of an accredited program in Radiology Technology either hospital based or college degree program.
  • Advanced training and certification in CT required.

Experience/Specialized Skills/Aptitudes

  • A minimum of two (2) years’ experience as a staff technologist is preferred.
  • Experience/certification/internship in CT scan is preferred, however cross-training will be provided at the discretion of the Director/Medical Director of Imaging Services.
  • Competency in components of radiography practice as appropriate; radiation safety and protection.
  • Technical expertise; knowledge of anatomy, teach/instruct, manual dexterity, safety conscious, clerical accuracy, communication skills. IV Therapy skill competency.

Licenses/Certificates

  • Registered with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT), with advanced registry/certification in CT
  • If cross-trained or internship in CT, and registry eligible, must have advanced registry/certification in CT within six (6) months of completion of CT training.
  • BLS required

title: Reefer Washer

title: Director of Patient Engagement and Growth
company: Comprehensive Breast Care Center Inc. dba Solis
description:
Director of Patient Engagement and Growth

Looking to elevate your career? Join us!

Work Location: Remote with onsite as needed

Work Hours: Full Time

The Director, Patient Engagement & Growth is the execution owner for the patient channel within the commercial growth engine. Where the VP of Growth sets patient engagement and outreach strategy and owns channel conversion targets, this Director turns that strategy into executed initiatives and recovered volume. The role closes the gaps where patients fall out of the funnel, most notably at order follow-up, scheduling, diagnostic workup, and annual return, and serves as the connective layer that lands engagement initiatives consistently across Operations, Marketing, the Contact Center, and the center network. Success is measured by reduced patient leakage, higher order-to-appointment conversion, and completed exam volume, all rolling up into the VP’s funnel-health and volume, rate, and mix cadence.

Department/Center Highlights:

  • Highly engaged culture.
  • Collaborative team environment
  • Fast-paced and Growth-Oriented


​​​​​​​Here is what you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 7+ years in patient engagement, growth marketing, demand conversion, or funnel and lifecycle management, with at least 3 years leading cross-functional initiatives or teams.
  • Healthcare experience strongly preferred; women’s health, imaging, or multi-site provider operations a distinct advantage.
  • Demonstrated record of reducing funnel leakage or improving conversion through data, campaigns, and process change.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors or outreach partners to measurable performance targets.
  • Strong command of funnel analytics and campaign measurement; comfort with CRM, scheduling, and patient outreach platforms.
  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to lead through others across departments.

A Day in the Life of a Director of Patient Engagement and Growth:

  • Provide services and support for the following areas:
    • Funnel Execution & Leakage Recovery
      • Maintain a clear, data-backed view of patient-channel conversion and drop-off at every stage: referral received, order placed, appointment scheduled, exam completed, diagnostic follow-up, and annual rescreen.
      • Lead the initiatives that recover patients who leak from the funnel, with particular focus on unscheduled and aged open orders.
      • Feed stage-level leakage findings into the VP’s weekly funnel-health reviews and closed-loop reporting rather than operating a parallel analytics function, and translate those findings into prioritized recovery action.
      • Drive closure of incomplete diagnostic pathways, including BI-RADS 0 cases requiring additional imaging, so patients complete the full episode of care.
    • Campaign Execution
      • Execute the multi-channel patient engagement campaigns that deliver on the demand-generation strategy owned by the VP: recall and reactivation, no-show recovery, annual rescreen reminders, and compliance outreach.
      • Operationalize audience, messaging, cadence, and channel mix in partnership with Marketing, and run a disciplined test-and-learn program so effort shifts toward what measurably moves completed exams.
      • Report campaign performance into the VP’s operating cadence against conversion and volume targets.
    • Order & Physician Referral Follow-Up
      • Lead systematic operational follow-up on physician referrals and orders so every order received is pursued to scheduling, with clear ownership and service-level expectations for turnaround.
      • Close the loop back to referring physicians in coordination with the Sales team, which owns the account relationship, surfacing any friction that slows patients from order to appointment.
      • Track order and referral conversion by source and feed lost-conversion reasons back into the Sales, Marketing, and demand-generation teams.
    • Patient Engagement Initiative Leadership (Cross-Functional)
      • Lead patient engagement initiatives across a multi-department team spanning Operations, Marketing, and other functions as initiatives require.
      • Partner with, rather than manage, the VP, Contact Center Operations: align on the engagement initiatives that drive Contact Center volume while that team retains staffing, workforce management, technology, and agent quality.
      • Own the service-level agreement that directs the outbound call team, which stays within the Contact Center under the VP, Contact Center Operations but carries out the order follow-up, referral follow-up, and outreach work this role defines. Set attempt, turnaround, and conversion standards, review performance against them within the funnel-health cadence, and reprioritize the outbound queue as leakage patterns shift.
      • Set shared initiative goals, align the group on priorities, and hold the cross-functional team accountable to engagement and conversion outcomes through influence rather than direct authority.
    • Third-Party Outreach Partner Execution
      • Own day-to-day implementation and execution of the third-party outreach partnerships that the VP establishes, directing successful rollout against the agreed strategy.
      • Manage scopes of work and service levels, monitor partner results, and handle escalations and course corrections.
      • Keep partner activity integrated with internal campaigns and systems so the patient experience stays coherent across every touchpoint.


Why Solis Mammography?

  • A Great Place to Work, earning this prestigious award for multiple years running.
  • Offer competitive benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, PTO, Paid Holidays, Backup Child/Adult Care as well as other unique benefits.

title: Space Launch System (SLS) Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) Engineer
description:
TriVector Services, Inc. provides quality aerospace engineering solutions to complex problems through a renowned team of engineering professionals. We are a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned, SBA-certified Small Business headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. Our experienced team is dedicated to building lasting partnerships based on professional integrity and sound engineering principles. TriVector's Experience and exceptional Performance adds measurable Value to every project. TriVector Services, Inc., is seeking qualified candidates to fill our Space Launch System (SLS) Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) Engineer position.


The SLS GNC Engineer will provide Systems Engineering and Integration (SE&I) expertise to Marshall Space Flight Center (MSFC) in support of the Space Launch System (SLS) Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) team. Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:


  • Guidance algorithm design, development, and test as part of guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) model incorporation into simulations and flight software for SLS.
  • Develop and review technical reports, presentations, and formal documentation on guidance performance analyses, and model development.

  • Implement mitigations for flight software change requests and discrepancy report items as requested by the SLS Guidance Team Lead.
  • Evaluate integrated vehicle system response to various changes in guidance design for verification/validation of vehicle requirements and mission objectives.
  • Conduct Monte Carlo dispersion analyses to assess vehicle and GNC system performance.
  • Conduct guidance subsystem performance analyses to support requirement specification development and requirement compliance.
  • Communicate design and analyses results internally and externally to the Guidance Team.
  • Support technical meetings, working groups, milestone reviews, and task teams in support of integration and analysis with other SLS elements (including SPIE, Stages, VM, Avionics, etc.).
  • Support interrelated areas to guidance in the SLS Vehicle Management discipline as requested by the VM DLE.
  • Assist trajectory/GN&C analysis, production, and delivery as required by the VM DLE.
  • Conduct model development, MAVERIC simulation set-up and analysis, and produce Monte Carlo results as requested by the VM DLE.

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in Italy.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.

title: Director ( Commercial Due Diligence)

  • Work directly with leading private equity firms, growth investors, and Fortune 500 executives on high-stakes strategic and transaction decisions.
  • Lead high-impact engagements with real ownership—Directors shape the work, drive client outcomes, and influence investment decisions from day one.
  • Experience the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial culture and agility of a boutique consulting firm combined with the scale, reach, and platform of Grant Thornton.

As a Commercial Due Diligence Director, you’ll play a leadership role in Grant Thornton | Stax Transactions, partnering with corporate leaders and private equity investors to evaluate growth potential, downside risk, and value creation opportunities across transactions.

You’ll combine deep commercial diligence expertise, strong client leadership, and business development acumen—serving as a trusted advisor while helping grow the firm’s Commercial Due Diligence capability.

  • Drive integrated diligence delivery, partnering closely with Financial DD, Value Creation, IT, and Human Capital leaders

  • Contribute to firm‑building initiatives and practice growth efforts

You have the following technical skills, qualifications, and abilities:

Required

  • Typically, 8–10+ years of experience in commercial due diligence, strategy consulting, transaction advisory, or private equity
  • Proven experience leading PE‑backed and corporate M&A diligence engagements
  • Strong expertise in:

Locations:

  • Chicago, Boston, and NYC.

This role offers competitive compensation, including a base salary range of $230,000–$300,000, plus a target annual bonus. Grant Thornton Stax follows a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy, base salary is commensurate with experience, and total cash compensation may vary based on individual and firm performance.

title: Director of Placement Services
description:

Department: Placement

LifeLine Animal Project is committed to the care and welfare of pets and the people who love them. The values we exhibit as an organization show the strength of our staff, our leadership and our community. We expect all employees to exhibit LifeLine’s core values as we complete daily tasks, provide services to clients and care for our animals.

The Director of Placement Services at DeKalb County Animal Services plays a pivotal role in leading and growing various placement departments within our organization. The position’s primary responsibility is to manage program budgets, auditing and creation. This includes conducting routine SOP reviews, recommending SOP changes, ensuring cross departmental coordination, setting program goals, and conducting weekly meetings with managers.

Essential Job Functions:

This represents a list of essential job duties. Other duties or special projects may be assigned as needed.

Uphold the standards and values of LifeLine Animal Project:

Save Lives -- Build Community -- Be Exceptional Stewards -- Be Courageous --

Be Compassionate -- Take Responsibility -- Respect, Embrace and Celebrate Diversity

Leadership:

  • Courageouslyprovide leadership to multiple placement departments, including adoption, foster, pathways, rescue, and volunteer:
    1. Provide department managers with performance feedback on an informal and formal basis.
    2. Conduct employee performance reviews, performance corrective actions, and discipline meetings as needed for non-staff under immediate direction.
    3. Help managers when difficult situations arise and offer guidance.
  • Monitor and evaluate placement processes and procedures to maintain high standards of care, compliance with organizational policies, and adherence to animal welfare best practices.

Staff Training and Development:

  • Oversee managers in developing and implementing innovative placement strategies to maximize adoption rates, reduce length of stay for animals, and enhance overall placement outcomes in an effort to save lives.
  • Provide placement managers with the support and tools they need to set priorities for their teams.
  • Provide managers with tools and support needed to develop training materials – manuals, videos, etc. – to be used in training for all placement staff.

  • Take responsibility to maintain and suggest updates to program policies, procedures, & protocols; job descriptions; manage the program’s document inventory.

  • Provide leadership and representation in the weekly Pathways meeting and ensure appropriate oversight and coordination of the euthanasia notification process.
  • Cultivate and maintain positive relationships with community members, adopters, rescue groups, and other stakeholders to promote placement needs and responsible pet ownership.
  • Speak with visitors with compassion when a situation has escalated and needs intervention beyond manager capabilities.
  • Respect, embrace, and celebrate diversity by always operating with a judgement-free mindset and welcome visitors with a friendly and professional demeanor.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders and departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and a fast-paced work environment.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain routine work records and reports.
  • Proven ability to effectively supervise the work of assigned subordinates.
  • Basic animal medical and behavior knowledge (preferred)
  • Comfortable working with dogs and cats of all sizes, breeds, and temperaments.
  • Ability to follow safety protocols and handle challenging situations with calmness and professionalism.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and to bend and reach to perform assigned work activities.
  • Ability to serve the public and fellow employees with honesty and integrity.
  • Must be able to work weekends, holidays, and varying shifts based on shelter needs.
  • Must have a means of travel that ensures prompt arrival for work shifts.

Minimum of high school diploma or equivalent. Bachelor's degree preferred.

Two or more years of leadership experience.

One or more years’ experience in animal related field preferred.

Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role, preferably in a customer service-oriented environment.

Fear Free Sheltering Preferred.

While performing the duties of this job, employee may be exposed to unpleasant kennel smells. May have to handle dogs and cats that are stray, injured, diseased or vicious.

title: Product Lead, Acquisition and Activation
description:
About Us


At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavor Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.



About the Role


As Product Lead for Acquisition and Activation, you will lead the cross-functional squad responsible for driving user acquisition and early activation across all of Félix’s consumer lending products.
In this role, you will own the end-to-end journey for acquiring "new-to-Félix" users through loan products, as well as optimizing first-loan conversion and the critical progression from first to second loan. Working across both new and existing user bases, you will establish reliable measurement frameworks for loan funnels, identify high-impact conversion barriers, and design scalable growth loops that balance rapid origination growth with strict credit-quality and unit-economic targets.

Responsibilities


  • Set Growth Direction & Strategy: Define the short-, medium-, and long-term strategy, OKRs, squad priorities, and roadmap for consumer lending acquisition and activation.
  • Own Acquisition & Activation Loops: Design, test, and scale growth loops that attract new users, maximize first-time borrower conversion, and drive progression to a second loan across all lending offerings.
  • Lead Discovery & Experimentation: Combine rigorous user research, funnel and cohort analysis, and unit economics to prioritize opportunities, launch continuous experiments, and scale winning tactics.
  • Lead the Pod: Provide clear direction, foster delivery excellence, and cultivate deep ownership and judgment across your cross-functional engineering, design, and data pod.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner seamlessly with Marketing, Risk, Credit, Compliance, Operations, and Platform teams, ensuring rigorous risk controls and establishing a clean handoff to the Retention team.
  • Address Funnel & Measurement Barriers: Establish robust funnel analytics to track new vs. existing user loan journeys separately, diagnosing and removing friction at every step.

title: Senior ML Engineer - MLOps and AI Evaluation
description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.

Job Description:

Ellkay is looking for an Senior ML Engineer - MLOps and AI Evaluation to build the shared ML operations and evaluation foundation for ELLKAY's classical ML, LLM, and agent services. The engineer will implement reproducible training/deployment pipelines, versioned models and prompts, benchmark execution, synthetic fixtures, release gates, telemetry, and rollback. The role owns the engineering systems that make quality, reliability, and cost visible throughout the AI lifecycle.

POSITION PURPOSE

The computed tomography (CT) technologist performs computed tomography procedures producing sectional and three dimensional images for interpretation by and at the request of a licensed healthcare practitioner. The CT technologist acquires data and reformats it into images needed for diagnosis and for the performance of interventional and therapeutic procedures. The CT technologist integrates scientific knowledge about patient conditions, technical skills, and information obtained through patient interaction to result in diagnostic information. The CT technologist assesses and monitors patients, and takes appropriate action in emergency situations to maintain quality patient care. A CT technologist exercises independent professional and ethical judgment. Ensures a high quality of images produced. Responsible for availability and sterility of equipment and supplies used for assigned areas. Performs other related duties as assigned.


POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Graduate of an accredited program in Radiology Technology either hospital based or college degree program.
  • Advanced training and certification in CT required.

Experience/Specialized Skills/Aptitudes

  • A minimum of two (2) years’ experience as a staff technologist is preferred.
  • Experience/certification/internship in CT scan is preferred, however cross-training will be provided at the discretion of the Director/Medical Director of Imaging Services.
  • Competency in components of radiography practice as appropriate; radiation safety and protection.
  • Technical expertise; knowledge of anatomy, teach/instruct, manual dexterity, safety conscious, clerical accuracy, communication skills. IV Therapy skill competency.

Licenses/Certificates

  • Registered with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT), with advanced registry/certification in CT
  • If cross-trained or internship in CT, and registry eligible, must have advanced registry/certification in CT within six (6) months of completion of CT training.
  • BLS required

  • Partner with Product Owners to ensure backlog readiness, prioritization, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Promote transparency through Agile metrics, sprint reporting, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support release planning, dependency management, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Drive continuous process improvement initiatives to increase team velocity, quality, and predictability.
  • Ensure Agile and Scrum processes are consistently followed across ServiceNow development efforts.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience serving as a Scrum Master in Agile software development environments.
  • Scrum Master certification.

Required Skills:

  • Hands-on experience supporting or delivering projects on the ServiceNow platform.

  • Proven experience overseeing Agile processes and ensuring team effectiveness according to Scrum and Agile methodologies.

Desired Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM), including asset lifecycle management, hardware and software inventory tracking, and license compliance.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Agile Development (SAD) or ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
  • Experience working in federal government, healthcare, or highly regulated environments.
  • SAFe Agile experience preferred.

Security Clearance:

  • US Citizen able to obtain a Public Trust.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.


More About B&A:

B&A delivers secure, innovative, and mission-critical IT solutions to support the United States Government across all three branches—Executive, Legislative, and Judicial—focused on National Security, Defense, and Intelligence. Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Canada.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

Accountabilities

  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage.
  • Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones.
  • Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous.
  • Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your area of work, manage your tasks independently, and contribute directly to operational improvements.
  • Professional Development: Build practical cybersecurity experience through hands-on projects involving vulnerability research, endpoint hardening, incident response, and compliance.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and progress into a broader role as the team grows.
  • Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET).

title: Director of Information Technology
description:
Director of Information Technology - this role will be responsible for both our Tualatin, OR and Albany, OR locations

The Director of Information Technology (IT), SEMI provides strategic and operational leadership over all technology functions within a multi‑site manufacturing organization serving the semiconductor industry. This role is responsible for developing and executing an IT vision that enhances productivity, quality, and decision‑making across the Semiconductor business unit and aligned with the broader Precinmac organization.


The Director leads infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, data management, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives for the SEMI business unit, ensuring technology directly supports business growth, manufacturing excellence, and customer requirements unique to the semiconductor sector.


This role partners closely with the broader Precinmac IT organization, business unit leadership and cross‑functional teams to leverage technology that improves throughput, reduces variability, supports precision manufacturing, and drives real‑time insight across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Technology Vision

  • Develop and execute a forward‑looking IT strategy aligned with business goals, manufacturing requirements, and semiconductor‑industry expectations.
  • Drive digital transformation initiatives including automation, data integration, advanced analytics, and shop‑floor connectivity (MES, SPC, IoT).
  • Serve as the internal thought leader on AI, driving a clear strategy for applying AI tools to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making across business functions (e.g., operations, HR, finance, supply chain).
  • Evaluate emerging technologies for their applicability to manufacturing efficiency, precision, quality, and customer compliance, with consideration for long-term scalability and operational resilience.

Business Systems, Data, and Decision Support

  • Lead application strategy (ERP, MES, QMS, CRM) for the business unit, ensuring systems are well-documented, properly licensed, and optimized for production accuracy, traceability, scalability, and throughput.
  • Build and expand BI capabilities — real-time dashboards, KPI reporting, forecasting tools — designed to give BU leadership direct, self-sufficient visibility into performance.
  • In coordination with the broader organization, establish data governance, data quality, and master data management practices that ensure the business unit's data is clean, well-structured, and independently maintainable for the business unit.

Infrastructure, Cybersecurity & Operations

  • Own IT infrastructure for the business unit — networks, cloud services, servers, storage, end-user computing, and communications — with clear documentation of system architecture, dependencies, and ownership.
  • Implement and mature cybersecurity programs aligned with manufacturing risk profiles and semiconductor customer expectations (e.g., NIST, supply‑chain security).
  • Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical manufacturing systems.
  • Manage IT operations across multiple facilities, ensuring consistent performance and availability.

Cross‑Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to understand requirements and design solutions that reduce downtime, increase yield, and improve process control.
  • Enable technology use across all levels, from shop‑floor operators to executives, enhancing workforce productivity and information access.
  • Serve as primary liaison between IT and external partners, auditors, integrators, and technology providers.

Vendor & Project Management

  • Lead large‑scale IT projects for the business unit including system upgrades, site integrations, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Negotiate and manage vendor contracts and relationships at the business unit level, with attention to contract terms, ownership, and service-level accountability.

Education & Experience Requirement:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field required, Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • Minimum ten years of experience managing IT operations, including leadership responsibilities.
  • ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or other relevant certifications for IT governance and project management are preferred.

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

All leaders at this level are expected to model and develop the following five core competencies, which define how we lead, collaborate, and deliver results across the organization.

Collaboration, Trust & Engagement: Builds strong relationships, fosters open communication, and creates an environment where people feel valued and motivated.

Customer Focus & Impact: Understands customer (internal & external) needs and delivers solutions that create meaningful value and long-term trust

Results & Accountability: Bias toward action to deliver high-quality outcomes, takes ownership, and holds self and others accountable for achieving goals

Business & Financial Insights

Applies sound business judgment and financial understanding to guide decisions and improve performance with a continuous improvement mindset.

Innovation & Courage

Encourages creative thinking and problem solving, challenges assumptions and adapts to evolving challenges, and drives creative solutions that move the organization forward.

Desired Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong leadership and communication skills, capable of influencing at all organizational levels.
  • Deep experience in IT management within manufacturing, industrial, or high‑precision environments; semiconductor‑related exposure highly preferred.
  • Expertise in enterprise systems (ERP/MES), data platforms, analytics tools, and modern IT architectures.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and compliance requirements for industrial environments.
  • Ability to build high‑performing IT teams and elevate organizational technology capability.

title: Financial Management Technician (Pay and Travel)
description:
MDW Associates is seeking knowledgeable Financial Management Technicians (Pay and Travel) to support the Air Force District of Washington (AFDW) by providing front-line financial customer service, case management, pay inquiry resolution, and transaction support to military members, civilians, and other customers across the National Capital Region and worldwide.

Financial Management Technicians will interact directly with customers in person, by phone, through organizational mailboxes, and through financial management and case management systems. Successful candidates must be able to establish rapport with customers of all ranks and temperaments, perform independent research, maintain accurate case documentation, complete timely follow-up actions, and provide accurate, thorough resolutions. The role requires disciplined use of customer service trackers, proper handling of CUI and source documents, and consistent compliance with records management, privacy, and financial management procedures.

The position may support military pay, civilian pay, travel pay, or a combination of these areas using systems such as CSP, LeaveWeb, eFinance, CMS, DJMS, WebDMO, FMWF, Qtrac, and organizational mailboxes. Candidates must be flexible, willing to learn new systems and procedures, and capable of supporting timely correction of pay-related issues.

This role is on-site and is located at Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling, Washington, D.C.

The Financial Management Technician may perform a combination of some or all of the following duties:

  • Provide professional, timely, and accurate financial customer service to military, civilian, and Government customers.
  • Create, update, document, elevate, and track customer cases and inquiries through applicable financial management systems.
  • Maintain a daily customer service electronic tracker and complete follow-up actions within established timeframes.
  • Conduct independent research using applicable regulations, continuity materials, and instructions to resolve customer inquiries.
  • Maintain required financial management system access.
  • Perform accurate data entry and ensure customer resolutions are complete, accurate, and well documented.
  • Follow CUI, Privacy Act, records management, and source document handling requirements.

Financial Management Technicians may support one or more of the following functional areas:

  • Military Pay: Support military pay inquiries, pay record research, entitlement and allowance processing, debt-related actions, rejected transaction correction, and case creation or follow-up using systems such as DJMS, CMS, CSP, WebDMO, and related tools.
  • Civilian Pay: Support civilian PCS-related reimbursement and entitlement inquiries, voucher preparation, inbound and outbound briefings, and coordination with other offices to resolve civilian pay issues.
  • Travel Pay: Support travel entitlement questions, voucher preparation, rejected voucher correction, travel pay documentation, travel briefings, and coordination with the Travel Pay Processing Center or other applicable organizations.

Required Experience/Skills:

  • Strong planning, organization, communication, typing, accurate data entry, attention to detail, confidentiality, thoroughness, decision-making, independence, analysis, and ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to work professionally with military, civilian, and contractor personnel
  • Ability to research and apply financial regulations, policies, procedures, and customer service guidance
  • Ability to maintain accurate trackers, case documentation, source documents, and records
  • Ability to work on-site at JBAB and/or the Pentagon Operating Location

Desired Experience/Skills:

  • At least one year of financial management customer service experience
  • Understanding of Air Force Financial Management organizations, functions, and publications
  • Experience using one or more of the following systems: CSP, LeaveWeb, eFinance, WebDMO, FMWF, CMS, DJMS, Qtrac, or similar financial/case management systems
  • Prior military pay, civilian pay, travel pay, comptroller, disbursing, finance office, or Defense financial management experience

title: Product Manager Privacy
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager Privacy based in United Kingdom.

Take ownership of privacy and consent management across a suite of digital advertising products spanning web, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV). In this strategic product role, you will lead the Privacy squad and report directly to the VP of Product, shaping how consent signals are collected, interpreted, and transmitted across multiple advertising channels. Your mission is to maximize publisher revenue while ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations and industry standards. You will translate complex legal frameworks into practical product specifications, balancing regulatory obligations with commercial opportunities. Working closely with engineering, analytics, UX, engagement teams, and privacy experts, you will drive measurable improvements in consent management and monetization. Join a fast-growing, international, AI-driven environment where analytical thinking, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are central to success.

Accountabilities:

As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV.

  • Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted.

  • Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements.

  • Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision.

  • Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions.

  • Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements.

  • Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent.

  • AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected:

    • Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem.

    • Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws.

    • Commercial and Analytical Judgment: Ability to distinguish legal obligations from recommendations and support product decisions with data, evidence, and measurable revenue impact.

    • Technical Specification Skills: Ability to write precise, implementation-ready specifications that engineers can execute with minimal clarification. Programming experience is not required.

    • Data-Driven Approach: Familiarity with basic SQL, dashboards, analytics, and A/B testing, with a commitment to measuring outcomes before making decisions.

    • AI and Agentic Workflows: Daily use of an AI assistant, such as Claude, and practical experience building AI-enabled skills or agentic workflows within product management.

    • Communication Skills: Fluent in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with legal specialists, engineers, product teams, clients, and business stakeholders.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset: Pragmatic, analytical, and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You understand the Pareto principle and know how to prioritize high-impact improvements.

    • Collaboration and Ownership: Strong listening skills, a willingness to challenge existing practices constructively, and a commitment to continuous improvement and shared team goals.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within a flexible environment, with access to offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

      • International Work Environment: Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, with English as the working language.

      • AI Tools: Access to Claude for everyday work and AI-enabled workflows.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a close-knit, supportive team that values innovation, knowledge-sharing, and collective success.

      • Social Events: Participate in regular team gatherings and company events.

      • Career Development: Benefit from training programs, HR career check-ins, internal mobility opportunities, and regular performance feedback.

      • Health Coverage: Access to a comprehensive health insurance plan.

      • Growth Opportunities: Contribute to a rapidly expanding digital advertising technology environment and help shape the future of privacy-aware monetization.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Work in an environment committed to diversity, equal opportunities, and inclusion.

      • Employment Type: Full-time.

      • Recruitment Process: The process includes a screening call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the VP of Product, a case study with the VP of Product and DPO, and reference checks. Interviews are primarily conducted by video conference, although some stages may require an in-person meeting.

title: Bench Assistant General Manager
description:
NANDOS’ VISION

At Nando’s, we want to be the most loved restaurant brand in North America, sharing the spirit of Nando’s PERi-PERi with everyone who chooses to access it. We will redesign and build a business that thrives as it answers fully it’s consumers’ needs - and endures over time through genuinely putting people at the heart of what we do. We will lead with our values and act with care, compassion, and kindness. By doing this, we will Change Lives Together, every day and everywhere.

ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER (Assistant Patrão)

Being an Assistant Patrão at Nando’s means stepping into the restaurant each day with Pride, Passion, Courage, Integrity, and Family at your core. You bring energy, fun, and focus to every shift—firing up Nandocas, supporting your Patrão, and helping deliver brilliant shifts that make our restaurants feel alive. You lead shoulder‑to‑shoulder, shaping the atmosphere, coaching in real time, and inspiring belief and confidence across your team. You are a culture carrier, a coach, and a catalyst for growth—helping Nandocas become their best selves, both inside and outside of Nando’s.

Your Purpose

As Assistant Patrão, you are the second‑in‑command—the operational engine that keeps the rhythm of the restaurant strong week after week. You bring the vision of the restaurant to life, running brilliant shifts, developing Nandocas, improving KPIs, and protecting Nando’s experience. You support your Patrão in all aspects of people, brand, commercial performance, and Changing Lives—ensuring the restaurant delivers 14 Brilliant Shifts consistently.

Scope & Span of Accountability

You operate with a weekly horizon while supporting elements of the annual plan. You oversee deployment, rotate ownership, training cadence, coaching rhythms, and the day‑to‑day people processes that set the team up for success. You lead shift excellence across all channels, elevate brand execution, and help convert weekly goals into real results.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

People — Grow, Inspire, and Lead the Restaurant Family

You bring Nando’s values to life across every shift. You coach, motivate, and ignite Nandocas—connecting them to the restaurant vision and KPIs. You support your Patrão in hiring, onboarding, and developing capable Nandocas; spotting potential early; and growing individuals into future Shift Leaders and managers. You foster belonging, fairness, psychological safety, and team wellbeing—ensuring everyone feels welcome, supported, and empowered to shine.

Brand — Deliver a Fired‑Up Nando’s Experience

You role‑model hospitality excellence and coach Nandocas to create memorable customer experiences. You ensure the full customer journey is delivered brilliantly—whether in‑restaurant, takeaway, or delivery—protecting the primacy of the eat‑in experience. You maintain consistency of standards, complete quality checks, support customer recovery, and bring local and national marketing plans to life.

Commercial — Fuel Weekly Performance

You bring commercial KPIs to life on shift—managing labor to forecast, reducing waste, adjusting levers to protect speed and quality, and supporting your Patrão to drive sustainable sales. You make smart, informed decisions that balance cost control and customer experience, helping grow the restaurant in a way that delights guests, uplifts Nandocas, and improves the bottom line.

Changing Lives — Make a Difference Every Day

You help create daily moments that change lives—building confidence, nurturing belonging, and giving opportunities to individuals others might overlook. You support scheduling fairness, support wellbeing conversations, champion community partnerships, and help the restaurant deliver on sustainability goals such as reducing waste, recycling, and energy usage.

Decision Authority

You lead multiple shifts each week and make operational decisions around deployment, cross‑training, customer recovery, and stock adjustments. You escalate complex ER, safety, or financial issues to your Patrão and support the execution of corrective actions and weekly plans.

Risk & Compliance

You uphold daily food safety; H&S, and audit routines—ensuring logs, checks, and compliance activities are consistently completed. You support people compliance: Right to Work, contracts, training completions, and safe operations—helping protect the Nando’s brand and legal posture.

Core Outcomes & Measures

  • Happy Nandocas: engaged, confident teams; development progress; stability and retention.
  • Happy Customers: consistent touchpoints; speed, quality, hospitality; reduced detractors; strong shopper metrics.
  • Happy Leadership: labor to forecast accuracy; reduced waste control; channel execution; improved weekly KPIs.
  • Changing Lives: Inclusive hiring support; community participation; sustainability actions.

Key Interfaces

Patrão; Shift Leaders; Nandocas; People Partner/HR; Local Suppliers; delivery partners; Area/Managing Director when required.

Level Differentiators — What Makes an Assistant Patrão Distinct

You own the weekly rhythm, elevate shift performance, build capability through training and sign‑offs, and improve KPIs through root‑cause analysis. You turn weekly plans into consistent execution—and create the conditions for Nandocas to thrive and become future leaders.

Leading in the Nando’s Way

You bring the spirit of Ubuntu into action—leading collaboratively, challenging with heart, and uplifting those around you. You blend having fun, making money, and changing lives; communicate brilliantly; support change with positivity; and role‑model Pride, Passion, Courage, Integrity, and Family.

title: Nested RT Level II Tech
description:
Position Summary

Acuren is currently recruiting for an RT Level II Technician.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and calibrate nondestructive testing equipment
  • Conduct tests to ensure quality or detect discontinuities (defects) using NDT methods of inspection
  • Establish techniques for proper examination of objects under inspection, ensuring strict adherence to safety regulations
  • Apply testing criteria in accordance with applicable specifications or standards and evaluate results
  • Interpret radiographs, cathode ray tube (CRT) or digital readouts, conductivity meters and visual indicators
  • Organize and report test results
  • Perform specialized inspections
  • May instruct and supervise others
  • Perform other job-related tasks as assigned by management

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Some college preferred
  • Certified Level II
  • Technical background in NDT methods and procedures
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively perform assigned NDT tasks and interpret results of inspections
  • Knowledge of NDT equipment
  • Experience in report writing

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance
  • 401K Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off

Company Overview

Acuren’s strength begins with its people. Guided by our values—People First, Integrity Always, One Team, Higher Standards, and Innovative —we work to create safe, respectful, and high-performing environments for our employees, clients, and communities.

We are honored that our people have recognized Acuren as worthy of inclusion in the Forbes 2024 and 2025 list of Canada’s Best Employers. This recognition reflects the importance we place on investing in our people, protecting everyone we work with, and acting with integrity in every engagement.

Acuren delivers comprehensive inspection, testing, certification, and asset integrity solutions that help organizations ensure critical assets are safe, compliant, and optimized for reliable performance. Our specialized expertise and advanced capabilities support clients across energy, industrial, and public infrastructure sectors.

Our services include inspection; traditional and advanced NDE/NDT; failure analysis; rope access; materials, field, and reliability engineering; drones; robotics; V-Deck; and condition-based monitoring. Through these capabilities, we help clients evaluate asset condition, manage operational risk, and make informed decisions throughout the asset lifecycle.

Our work supports the integrity and safety of assets across petroleum refining, pipelines, power generation, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceutical, aerospace, and automotive industries. Acuren employs more than 5,000 professionals who support mechanical integrity and inspection programs across industrial sectors.

Our approach is practical and focused: provide capable local teams with certified, well-equipped personnel supported by trained and experienced leaders. Building on a strong heritage of safety, quality, and professionalism, we continue to advance technical capabilities and support reliability programs that create value for clients and employees.
