title: Greenhouse Technician
description:
Cox Farms

At Cox Farms, we are setting the global standard in growing a safe, secure food supply capable of feeding a growing population, regardless of calendar or climate. Through our multinational network of indoor farms and consumer brands, BrightFarms and Mucci Farms, the business has already become the largest greenhouse operator in the United States and Canada, surpassing $500 million in revenue and growing our workforce to thousands of dedicated and passionate employees. We’re future proofing the world of produce and serving the biggest names in retail across thousands of stores. And we’re just getting started. Want to grow the future of food together? Join Cox Farms today!

Our Yorkville, Illinois, farm is our second and largest greenhouse in Illinois, at around 480,000 square feet. With an annual production of around 6 million pounds of leafy greens, BrightFarms is ensuring fresh greens for Chicagoland communities.

Specifically, you will:

  • Assist in managing the greenhouse production of hydroponic greens at their 8-acre greenhouse in Yorkville, IL. The Greenhouse Technician reports to the Head Grower
  • Be responsible for managing climate alarms, lighting, and environmental controls as set my Ag team. Along with troubleshooting/resolving issues with guidance from Head Grower and Grower
  • Maintain set points, health and productivity of hydroponic gutter systems, including nutrient balance, pH management, temperature, aeration, sanitation, and irrigation mechanicals
  • Assist with crop scouting for disease, nutrient issues, pest, yield impacts, and general data collection. Must ensure daily checklists and regular preventative and corrective maintenance are completed. Regularly reports finding to Head Grower and Grower and collaborates on corrective strategies
  • Be responsible for ensuring the greenhouse is free of insect pests and disease using BrightFarms’ IDPM protocols
  • Collaborate with Head Grower, Grower, and Apprentice Grower to track R&D projects to optimize yields and quality of existing products and develop new products
  • Support the Head Grower and General Manager and is accountable for maintaining a neat and orderly greenhouse facility

The ideal candidate:

  • 2-years’ experience in greenhouse production or similar

Preferred qualifications:

  • Minimum of a 2-year degree in horticulture and or related sciences
  • Experience with good manufacturing practices (GMPs), food safety, and knowledge of IPM
  • Hoogendoorn or PRIVA experience are a plus
  • Preference is given to candidates with experience in controlled environment agriculture and hydroponic production of food crops

Working conditions/Environment/Travel/Schedule required:

  • May require travel to Greenhouses outside of the regular/main working location
  • Will require chemical handling and safety,
  • PPE will be provided
  • Exposure to heat and humid environments on a regular basis.

Physical requirements

  • This position would require the ability to use hands/fingers, reaching with hands and arms, walking, standing, and sitting daily and lifting to 50 pounds

Employment Notice

This role will support all Cox Farms businesses. The employer for this role is BrightFarms Inc. and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For roles based in the United States: Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without the need for employer sponsorship. For roles based in Canada: applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

Let’s grow the future of food together. Join Cox Farms today.

title: Sr. Manager, M&A Integration
description:
Who Are We?

FDH Aero is a trusted global supply chain partner for aerospace and defense companies, providing end-to-end supply chain solutions for OEM and aftermarket customers.

With more than 55+ years of experience and operations in 14 countries, we bring expertise across Commercial, Defense, Space, Business Aviation and Cargo through our specialized business divisions, Electronics, Hardware, Commercial Aftermarket, and Defense Aftermarket.

For more information, please visit the FDH Aero website.


Why Work Here?

Fast-paced & Impactful Work – Every decision helps keep aircraft flying and missions moving

Driven Team & Culture – Supportive, driven colleagues who support you every step of the way

High-Growth Opportunities – We invest in your success with training and development

Competitive Benefits Package – Includes medical, dental, vision insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) 401k matching, wellness activities and more

At FDH Aero, we understand that the strength of our brand comes from our people, and our culture empowers every team member to contribute and grow. As a global team, our culture is rooted in five (5) core values that begin with the words “We are” and include: service-first, respectful, amplifiers, open-minded and accountable.

We Are Looking For

The Sr. Manager, M&A Integration will lead and coordinate post-acquisition integration activities across FDH Electronics, beginning with the transition from diligence through closing, Day 1 readiness, implementation, and post-close stabilization. This role will serve as the central project manager for each integration, ensuring that functional workstreams are aligned, risks and dependencies are actively managed, and commitments made during the transaction process are successfully executed. Working cross-functionally with business and functional leaders, the Sr. Manager, M&A Integration will establish integration plans, governance, timelines, and performance tracking to help newly acquired businesses operate effectively within FDH Electronics. The role will maintain a strong focus on business continuity, operational execution, synergy realization, and sustainable profitability following each acquisition.

What You’ll Do

As a Sr. Manager, M&A Integration, you will be responsible for:

Integration Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end integration process from the completion of diligence through full operational stabilization.
  • Translate diligence findings, transaction commitments, identified risks, and value-creation opportunities into a clear integration strategy and execution plan.
  • Lead cross-functional integration teams and establish priorities, decision rights, deliverables, and accountability across all workstreams.
  • Serve as the central point of leadership for integration decisions, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.


Closing & Day 1 Execution

  • Lead closing and Day 1 readiness to ensure continuity for employees, customers, suppliers, and business operations.
  • Drive completion of all critical pre-close and immediate post-close actions.
  • Identify execution risks early, resolve barriers, and escalate decisions requiring executive leadership.
  • Ensure acquired leadership teams understand integration priorities, expectations, and timelines.


Cross-Functional Integration

  • Lead integration across Operations, Finance, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality, Legal, and Compliance.
  • Hold functional leaders accountable for integration commitments, milestones, and business outcomes.
  • Drive the integration of organizational structures, systems, processes, policies, reporting, and operating practices.
  • Balance FDH standardization requirements with the need to preserve the acquired company’s critical capabilities, customer relationships, and competitive strengths.

Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Partner with Finance and business leadership to convert the acquisition business case into measurable operational and financial objectives.
  • Drive execution of cost synergies, revenue opportunities, margin improvements, and other value-creation initiatives.
  • Evaluate performance against integration commitments and require corrective action when results fall below expectations.
  • Ensure integration decisions support customer retention, profitable growth, operational efficiency, and sustainable EBITDA improvement.

Stabilization & Integration Effectiveness

  • Lead the acquired business through post-close stabilization and transition integration responsibilities into ongoing business ownership.
  • Resolve outstanding operational, organizational, financial, and cultural issues that could prevent the acquisition from achieving its objectives.
  • Conduct post-integration reviews to assess results, reinforce accountability, and capture lessons learned.
  • Build and continuously improve FDH Electronics’ integration playbook, governance model, tools, and best practices.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of five years of experience leading integrations, enterprise programs, business transformations, operations, or comparable cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience with mergers and acquisitions, post-merger integration, or private-equity-backed value-creation initiatives strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, drive decisions, and hold senior functional stakeholders accountable.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience with business cases, profitability drivers, integration costs, synergy realization, and performance reporting.
  • Experience within aerospace and defense, electronics distribution, manufacturing, or another operationally complex industry preferred.
  • Ability to travel to acquired businesses and FDH Electronics locations as required.

Special Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) or asylee/refugee status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) required.
  • ITAR Requirement
  • 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR

Job Type: Full Time

FDH Aero is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Middle Marketing Data Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle Marketing Data Analyst based in United Kingdom.

Join a dynamic, international technology environment where data-driven insights help shape effective marketing strategies and business growth. As a Middle Marketing Data Analyst, you will analyze user behavior across the entire marketing funnel, from initial visits and clicks to registrations and deposits. You will transform complex datasets into actionable insights through clear dashboards, reporting, and statistical analysis. Working closely with business teams, data engineers, and web analytics specialists, you will help improve campaign performance, optimize data collection, and support customer acquisition and retention experiments. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful business decisions while developing your analytical expertise. You will also benefit from a collaborative culture that encourages initiative, continuous learning, and professional growth.

Accountabilities:

As a Middle Marketing Data Analyst, you will turn marketing data into practical recommendations, improve reporting capabilities, and support experimentation across the business. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Marketing data analysis: Analyze data from tracking systems and other sources to understand user behavior throughout the marketing funnel, from visits and clicks to registrations and deposits.

  • Dashboard development and reporting: Build and maintain informative dashboards and reports that help business teams identify funnel issues, uncover performance trends, and discover optimization opportunities.

  • Experimentation and optimization: Support business teams in planning, launching, and evaluating experiments designed to improve customer acquisition and retention.

  • Data collection and pipeline improvement: Collaborate with data engineers and web analytics specialists to optimize the collection and processing of marketing data from multiple sources and improve data pipelines.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate, structured, and up-to-date documentation related to your analytical area.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with relevant stakeholders to translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations and support data-informed decision-making.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in data analytics, strong SQL skills, and the ability to communicate findings through effective visualizations. You should be comfortable working with marketing performance data, applying statistical methods, and collaborating with different teams. The key qualifications include:

    • Professional experience: At least two years of experience in data analytics or related analytical fields.

    • SQL proficiency: Confident use of SQL to retrieve, process, transform, and analyze data.

    • Data visualization: Practical experience with Tableau and the ability to create clear, informative dashboards and visualizations.

    • Statistical knowledge: Understanding of statistical fundamentals and practical experience applying statistical methods to A/B testing.

    • Analytical mindset: Ability to investigate performance trends, identify issues, and translate data into meaningful business insights.

    • Collaboration skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside business stakeholders, data engineers, and web analytics specialists.

    • iGaming experience: Familiarity with the iGaming industry is an advantage.

    • Additional tools: Knowledge of Google Analytics, dbt, and Git fundamentals is beneficial.

    • Tracking and affiliate systems: Experience working with tracking platforms and affiliate systems is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work: Flexibility to work remotely or from available hubs in Kyiv and Warsaw, with a focus on comfort and safety.

      • Paid time off: 20 working days of paid leave, in addition to public holidays and sick leave.

      • Health and well-being: Medical insurance with access to leading clinics and coverage for psychological support through the Pleso platform.

      • Flexible lifestyle benefits: A monthly Benefit Café allowance to spend on personal interests, hobbies, sports, and other preferences.

      • Learning and development: An individual learning budget, corporate English classes, workshops, and access to an online library.

      • Career progression: Structured career planning, performance reviews, training opportunities, and mentoring programs.

      • Collaborative culture: Team-building activities, corporate events, and workshops that encourage connection and knowledge sharing.

      • Modern technology environment: Opportunities to contribute to building technology solutions from the ground up and use automation to reduce routine work.

      • Autonomy and openness: A culture that values initiative, direct communication, feedback, and freedom to improve existing processes.

      • Full-time employment: A full-time role within an international, growth-oriented team.

title: Manager  ( Commercial Due Diligence)
description:
Location: Philadelphia,Pennsylvania,United States

Why Grant Thornton | Stax Transactions

  • Work directly with leading private equity firms, growth investors, and Fortune 500 executives on high-stakes strategic and transaction decisions.
  • Lead high-impact engagements with real ownership
  • Experience the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial culture and agility of a boutique consulting firm combined with the scale, reach, and platform of Grant Thornton.
  • Gain broad exposure across industries, transaction types, and growth challenges in a model designed to accelerate commercial judgment and leadership development.
  • Operate in lean, collaborative teams where senior leaders are accessible, mentorship is real, and contributions are visible.
  • Help build a rapidly growing platform post-acquisition, with opportunities to shape capabilities, develop new offerings, and contribute to firm-wide growth initiatives.
  • Deliver meaningful client impact without the traditional road-warrior consulting lifestyle through a more sustainable, low-travel operating model.
  • Join a high-performance culture that values intellectual curiosity, initiative, collaboration, and merit-based advancement.

As a Commercial Due Diligence Manager, you’ll focus on buy‑side and sell‑side transaction engagements, supporting corporate clients and private equity investors as they evaluate growth opportunities, revenue sustainability, and market risk. You’ll work alongside experienced professionals across Grant Thornton | Stax Transactions to deliver clear, data‑driven insights throughout the transaction lifecycle.

From day one, you’ll be empowered to make an impact—helping clients make confident investment decisions while continuing to build your leadership and advisory skillset.

Your Day‑to‑Day may include:

  • Manage and deliver commercial due diligence engagements for corporate and private‑equity‑backed transactions
  • Analyze markets, customers, competitors, pricing, and go‑to‑market strategies to assess commercial risk and opportunity
  • Conduct market sizing, growth forecasting, customer segmentation, and demand analyses
  • Develop clear, concise, and investment‑committee‑ready findings summarizing key risks and value drivers
  • Draft and review diligence reports, executive summaries, and presentation materials
  • Serve as a primary engagement manager, overseeing scope, timelines, and client expectations
  • Collaborate with Financial Due Diligence, Value Creation, IT, and Human Capital teams to deliver integrated transaction insights
  • Support proposal development and business development activities
  • Coach and mentor senior associates and associates; contribute to performance feedback and team development
  • Other duties as assigned

You have the following technical skills, qualifications, and abilities:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, Strategy, or a related field
  • Typically, 5–8+ years of experience in commercial due diligence, strategy consulting, transaction advisory, or private equity‑related roles
  • Experience supporting M&A or private equity transactions
  • Strong analytical skills across market sizing, customer analysis, and competitive dynamics
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, transaction‑oriented environment

Preferred

  • Experience working directly with private equity clients
  • Consulting or professional services background
  • MBA or other advanced degree

Locations:

  • Chicago, Boston, and NYC.
  • Consistent with the firm’s hybrid work model, this position requires in-person attendance three days per week at a firm office or client site.

Compensation & Benefits

This role offers competitive compensation, including a base salary range of $190,000–$225,000, plus a target annual bonus. Grant Thornton Stax follows a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy, base salary is commensurate with experience, and total cash compensation may vary based on individual and firm performance.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family; expanded family planning benefits; a 401(k) plan with company contributions regardless of your own; open vacation policy; life and disability insurance; generous parental leave; pre-tax transit benefits; mobile phone stipend; wellness reimbursement; charitable gift matching; and more.

Grant Thornton Stax is an equal opportunity employer and affords equal opportunity to all applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability (except where the disability is a bona fide occupational disqualification), sexual orientation, genetic makeup, predisposition or carrier status, familial or marital status, military or veteran status or any other status protected under local, state or federal laws.

title: Child Interventionist - San Jose
description:
Child Interventionist

Part-Time

San Jose, CA

Butterfly Effects' Mission is to make a socially significant change in the lives of children and families by hiring passionate, caring people to serve children and families affected by autism.

We are seeking dedicated Child Interventionists/Behavior Technicians/Registered Behavior Technicians, entry level and experienced, to directly assist children with autism in honing vital skills like communication, social interaction, and self-care. Join us in collaborating with families to execute ABA-based behavior intervention plans.

Are you passionate about positively impacting the lives of children and families? Explore our fulfilling part-time role at Butterfly Effects!

Why Work at Butterfly Effects?

  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $25.00 - $30.00 hourly, based on your experience, education, and certifications.
  • Part-Time Flexibility: 9-15 hours per week, providing the ideal work-life balance.
  • After school hours: 3pm-7pm 3 to 5 days per week.
  • Impactful Work: Contribute to lifelong changes in a child's life.
  • Career Growth: Available for educational and training support, with opportunities to become a Registered Behavior Technician or to grow towards gaining a Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), aided by our guidance and financial assistance.
  • Supportive Environment: Join a team focused on bringing calm, protection, and joy to families affected by autism.

What Would You Be Doing?

  • Implements individualized treatment plans under the direction of a Board-Certified Behavioral Analyst (BCBA).
  • Observes, records, and reports on client's progress, as well as the condition and behavior of the client daily.
  • Manages challenging behaviors.
  • Applies behavioral principles consistently in all interactions with clients.
  • Assists clients, as needed, to acquire academic and/or appropriate life skills.
  • Communicates in a professional and respectful manner with parents, behavior analysts/consultants, trainers, and clients.
  • Functions as an active member of the treatment team.
  • Completes daily paperwork and data collection notes in a detailed, accurate, consistent, and timely manner through our online database.
  • Actively participates in continuous training programs designed to increase overall skills.
  • Maintains confidentiality of client information.
  • Follows BE policies and procedures.

Follow this link to get a better understanding of your role:

What Do You Bring to the Role?

  • Certification: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification is a plus.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Passion for Children: A genuine love for working with children.
  • Positive Attitude: Strong interpersonal skills for working with children and families.
  • Experience: Prior experience with children is advantageous.
  • Continuous Learning: Interest in ongoing development.
  • Transportation: Must have reliable transportation.
  • Background: Must be able to satisfactorily pass a company background check.

Physical Requirements:

This role involves working in natural environments, occasionally requiring lifting or moving up to 50 lbs. and maintaining various postures for extended periods.

title: AI Deployment Director (Copy)
description:
Senpilot builds AI agents that help utilities operate smarter, faster, and more reliably, automating everything from engineering workflows to regulatory filings and compliance. Our mission is to create the intelligence layer for the modern grid: AI systems that understand utility data, reason across it, and act autonomously to improve safety, resilience, and efficiency.

We are building production-grade intelligence that sits at the heart of how critical infrastructure is planned, monitored, and regulated, helping utilities unlock the next generation of reliability.

Joining Senpilot means joining a small, high-performance team that combines deep expertise in AI systems, data engineering, and energy infrastructure. We focus on generating value and we run toward the hard problems because that's where the value is. If you want to join a fast-growing team and help build the future of intelligent infrastructure, this is the place to do it.

The Role
Agent deployment is how Senpilot gets a customer from a pilot or signed contract to regular, measurable use of our AI agents. As an AI Deployment Manager for the regulatory agent, you’ll own the team’s hardest problems: getting users to useful results, turning enterprise pilots into paying customers, and building the playbooks that let this function scale. This includes owning the relationship for a portfolio of utility, consulting, and regulator accounts, guiding them from first login through renewal.

You’ll operate as both a strategic advisor and a hands-on resource. You’ll be as comfortable reviewing usage data, building training, helping users with prompts and setup, and running recurring check-ins as leading a business review with executives. For key moments, such as a major filing, a team-wide rollout, or a renewal conversation, you’ll be on the ground with the client. This is a rare opportunity to define how utilities and their advisors use AI in rate cases, regulatory filings, and research.

What you’ll do
  • Own the relationship and outcomes for a portfolio of regulatory accounts, guiding them from onboarding through conversion, renewal, and long-term adoption of Senpilot’s regulatory agent.
  • Lead activation: agree on use cases and success criteria with each customer at the start of a pilot, set up their users, and make sure each user gets a good first result.
  • Embed on-site during high-stakes windows, such as a rate case filing or a team-wide rollout, working hands-on with the client’s team to resolve blockers, accelerate adoption, and strengthen the relationship in person.
  • Train and enable end users across regulatory, engineering, finance, and customer service teams, from analysts to leadership, teaching them to write effective prompts and use the agent in their day-to-day work.
  • Build and scale the playbooks, prompt libraries, documentation, and self-serve resources that let every account in your portfolio keep getting value between your direct touchpoints.
  • Monitor adoption, usage, value, and account health through data and direct client feedback, and work with the commercial team to decide which pilots to convert, extend with a defined plan, or end.
  • Serve as the link between clients and Senpilot’s product team, surfacing quality issues and feedback that shape the roadmap, and telling customers when the product changes in ways that matter to them.
  • Get to know each customer’s organization beyond the regulatory team, and identify where a regulatory deployment can lead to deploying Senpilot’s other modules, such as engineering and customer service.

What you’ll bring
  • Experience in hands-on account management, technical customer success, or implementation roles, ideally at a high-growth, tech-forward organization; management consulting or generalist experience is also relevant.
  • Strong communication and strategic planning, including the ability to manage pilots and rollouts, build trust quickly, and rally a room of executives or users around a vision.
  • Willingness to travel for on-site client engagements.
  • Familiarity with utility regulation, such as rate cases, regulatory filings, or consulting to utilities or regulators, or genuine excitement to learn it fast.
  • Strong customer instinct and empathy, including the ability to talk to users, uncover their pain points, and help solve them.
  • Track record of moving from problem to shipped implementation in ambiguous environments, with comfort ramping up on technical detail and prioritizing ruthlessly.
  • Strong data analytics instincts and fluency with modern AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.): our product is built on working with regulatory data, and your fluency with that data and with the product’s output is how you build credibility with customers.

Work Location
We appreciate the flexibility of hybrid work, and we also value the energy that comes from being in the same room. Our team gathers at our office in downtown Toronto up to three times a week when not travelling. If you're able to join us in person on those days, we'd love to hear from you. This role also includes travel to client sites for activations, key milestones, conferences and on-the-ground support.

What is in for you
  • Competitive Compensation: The estimated base salary range for this role in Canada is $110,000 CAD - $160,000 CAD with most new hires joining near the midpoint. Actual salaries may vary within the range, or above or below it, based on factors such as experience, skills, location, and business needs.
  • Equity
  • Comprehensive health benefits from day one, for you and your dependents
  • Time Off: 20 vacation days + 5 flex days around EOY holidays

AI at Senpilot
AI is embedded in how we work, and we encourage our team to lean on it to learn new skills, sharpen their craft, and put their energy toward the work that genuinely moves the needle.
That extends to how we hire. We bring AI into our recruitment process not to take the humanity out of it, but to keep things organized and smooth so the experience feels more personal, not less. It gives our team room to focus on the parts that count: genuine conversations and well thought decisions. Above all, every decision is made by real people, drawing on genuine understanding, and rooted in our values and culture.

Senpilot is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workforce. Accommodations are available upon request during the recruitment process.

title: Reg Cardiovascular Tech
description:
About the Role:

The Registered Cardiovascular Technologist (Reg Cardiovascular Tech) plays a critical role in the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases by performing specialized diagnostic procedures and assisting physicians in cardiovascular care. This position involves operating advanced cardiovascular imaging and monitoring equipment to capture accurate data essential for patient evaluation. The technologist collaborates closely with cardiologists and other healthcare professionals to ensure high-quality patient care and effective treatment planning. Attention to detail and adherence to safety protocols are paramount to ensure patient safety and the reliability of diagnostic results. Ultimately, the role contributes significantly to improving patient outcomes through precise cardiovascular assessment and support.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification as a Registered Cardiovascular Technologist (RCVT) or equivalent credential from an accredited organization.
  • Completion of an accredited cardiovascular technology program.
  • Valid state licensure or certification as required by the state of employment.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of cardiovascular anatomy, physiology, and pathology.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced certifications such as Registered Vascular Technologist (RVT) or Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS).
  • Experience with advanced cardiovascular imaging modalities including transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) or cardiac MRI.
  • Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) systems and cardiovascular information systems.
  • Strong background in patient education and communication skills.
  • Previous experience working in a hospital or specialized cardiovascular clinic setting.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform non-invasive cardiovascular diagnostic procedures such as echocardiograms, stress tests, and vascular studies according to established protocols.
  • Operate and maintain cardiovascular imaging and monitoring equipment, ensuring proper calibration and functionality.
  • Prepare patients for procedures by explaining the process, positioning them correctly, and monitoring their condition throughout testing.
  • Collaborate with cardiologists and healthcare team members to review test results and assist in diagnostic interpretation when necessary.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, documenting procedures, observations, and any anomalies encountered during testing.
  • Adhere strictly to infection control, safety standards, and regulatory compliance requirements in all aspects of patient care and equipment handling.
  • Participate in continuing education and training to stay current with advancements in cardiovascular technology and best practices.

Skills:

The required skills enable the technologist to accurately perform and interpret cardiovascular diagnostic tests, ensuring precise data collection critical for patient diagnosis. Proficiency with cardiovascular imaging equipment and technology is essential for daily operation and troubleshooting to maintain high-quality results. Strong communication skills facilitate effective interaction with patients, explaining procedures clearly and providing reassurance to reduce anxiety. Collaboration skills are vital for working alongside cardiologists and healthcare teams to integrate diagnostic findings into patient care plans. Preferred skills such as advanced certifications and familiarity with EMR systems enhance the technologist's ability to manage complex cases and contribute to efficient clinical workflows.

title: Senior Information Systems Security Officer (Sr. ISSO)
description:
Senior Information Systems Security Officer (Sr. ISSO)


Summary

The Senior Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) will lead cybersecurity and compliance efforts supporting mission-critical systems throughout the system lifecycle. The ISSO will ensure security compliance, support authorization activities, manage risk, and coordinate with engineering, operations, and government stakeholders to maintain Authority to Operate (ATO) for enterprise systems. The role includes implementation of RMF controls, development of security documentation, participation in assessments, and support of Zero Trust security architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct technical security assessments and evaluate system security posture.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable security frameworks and regulatory requirements.
  • Support certification, accreditation, IATT, and ATO activities.
  • Collaborate with developers, system administrators, database administrators, and testers to ensure security is integrated throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support security assessment events and remediation efforts.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage security documentation including SSPs, POA&Ms, SAPs, and assessment artifacts.
  • Utilize XACTA to manage RMF documentation and authorization activities.
  • Implement and validate NIST 800-53 security controls.
  • Apply Zero Trust principles to cloud-native and enterprise environments.
  • Manage risk assessments, findings, mitigation strategies, and compliance tracking.
  • Coordinate with ISSMs, ISSEs, System Owners, Security Control Assessors (SCAs), and Authorizing Officials (AOs).
  • Support security monitoring and compliance reporting activities utilizing Splunk and related cybersecurity tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI with Active Polygraph.
  • Security+ or equivalent DoD IAT Level II/III certification.
  • 18 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Security Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience serving as an ISSO, ISSE, or similar cybersecurity role.
  • Proficiency with XACTA and the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
  • Experience managing IATT and ATO processes.
  • Proficiency with Splunk.
  • Experience conducting architecture and security compliance assessments.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining security documentation including:
    • System Security Plans (SSPs)
    • Security Assessment Plans (SAPs)
    • Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms)
    • Security assessment artifacts
  • Experience implementing security controls aligned with frameworks such as ICD 503 and NIST 800-53.
  • Experience coordinating with ISSMs, ISSEs, System Owners, SCAs, and Authorizing Officials.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience supporting large-scale government cybersecurity programs.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting cloud-native or DPaaS environments.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust architectures and security principles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity initiatives across large enterprise programs.
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring cybersecurity teams.
  • Experience supporting intelligence community or classified environments.
  • Strong understanding of identity, segmentation, flow control, and data protection architectures.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal security authorization and continuous monitoring processes.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.
  • Bachelor’s degree may substitute for 4 years of experience.
  • Master’s degree may substitute for 6 years of experience.

Certifications Required

  • Security+ (or equivalent DoD 8570/8140 IAT II/IAT III certification) in active status.

Clearance

  • Active TS/SCI with Active Polygraph.

Salary $125,000- 200,000


Work Location

  • Annapolis Junction, MD
  • Washington, DC
  • Reston, VA

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.

  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.

  • You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.

  • You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.

  • You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • You are highly proficient in Figma, with extensive experience in wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, and scalable design systems.

  • You have a strong understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, interaction design, and responsive design, paired with a keen eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and detail.

  • You have a solid understanding of web development principles, including HTML5, CSS3, front-end capabilities and limitations, and web accessibility standards (WCAG AA).

  • You are a strategic and creative problem solver who can balance user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements to develop thoughtful design solutions.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy giving and receiving constructive feedback, and are comfortable guiding fellow designers while remaining adaptable to other creative disciplines, including graphic and editorial design.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of the UX/UI design process for assigned website and digital projects, from initial discovery and concept development through final execution and developer handoff.

  • Collaborate with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, designers, and developers to translate client objectives, project scopes, brand guidelines, and technical requirements into effective design solutions.

  • Conduct design research and develop information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate design concepts.

  • Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.

  • Develop, maintain, and improve UI design systems, component libraries, and design patterns to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across digital experiences.

  • Work closely with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications, supporting handoffs, and resolving UX/UI challenges to ensure design quality and feasibility.

  • Participate in and help guide internal design reviews and client presentations, communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.

  • Guide fellow designers through specific projects or design challenges, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high standards of design quality and consistency.

  • Proactively coordinate with project leads to manage timelines, communicate progress, identify potential challenges, and ensure deliverables meet project requirements and client expectations.

  • Stay current with emerging UX/UI trends, tools, and technologies, sharing inspiration, best practices, and opportunities to improve design processes and workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

  • 15 observed holidays + 23 PTO days per year
  • Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
  • Permanent remote work
  • Dedicated team budget for professional development
  • Compensated onsite retreats at our Bilbao HQ
  • Access to Wellhub – a wellness benefit with access to thousands of gyms and studios and online classes
  • The opportunity to join a dynamic, close-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day
About Terra
Terra is a digital marketing and creative agency built by an integrated and international team of content creators, strategists, designers, and developers. We help organizations reimagine and deliver their most ambitious digital projects and initiatives by acting as an extension of our clients’ teams and delivering exceptional online experiences, content, and marketing strategies.
Our team is innovative, tech-forward, and creative by nature. We are dedicated to pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve in today’s ever-evolving digital landscape. We believe in the power of collaboration and foster a work environment that encourages creativity and growth. And with a strong focus on work-life balance, we prioritize the well-being and career development of our team members. title: Casino Floor Supervisor - Table Games
description:
Floor Supervisor - Table Games

Lead the Game. Protect the Integrity. Elevate the Guest Experience.

Are you an experienced Table Games professional ready to take the next step in your casino career? We’re looking for a confident, service-driven Table Games Supervisor who can lead a team, maintain the integrity of casino games, and create an exceptional experience for every guest.

In this hands-on leadership role, you’ll oversee daily table games operations, support and develop dealers, ensure compliance with gaming regulations and internal controls, and help maintain a fun, welcoming, and professional gaming environment. The ideal candidate brings strong table games knowledge, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to lead with integrity in a fast-paced casino environment.

If you’re passionate about casino operations, team leadership, and outstanding guest service, we invite you to apply!

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Supervise Table Games Dealers and assigned associates throughout daily operations.
  • Assign dealers to tables and adjust staffing to meet business needs.
  • Coach, train, and provide ongoing feedback to promote accuracy, professionalism, efficiency, and exceptional guest service.
  • Support associate onboarding, performance evaluations, attendance monitoring, and the enforcement of departmental standards.
  • Help foster a respectful, accountable, and service-focused team culture.

Oversee Table Games Operations

  • Coordinate table openings and closings, fills, credits, payouts, chip inventory, and other gaming transactions.
  • Monitor table activity to ensure games are conducted accurately, fairly, and according to established procedures.
  • Verify game activity and transactions in accordance with company policies and internal controls.
  • Maintain a visible presence on the gaming floor to support operational efficiency and a positive guest experience.
  • Stay informed about promotions, special events, and changing operational needs.

Protect Game Integrity and Ensure Compliance

  • Enforce company policies, approved game procedures, internal controls, and applicable gaming laws and regulations.
  • Identify and address procedural errors, irregularities, suspicious activity, and potential violations.
  • Maintain accurate logs, reports, and required documentation.
  • Support compliance with Title 31, anti-money laundering requirements, responsible gaming practices, and other applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with Surveillance, Security, Cage, and other departments to resolve operational, security, and compliance concerns.
  • Assist with investigations involving gaming irregularities, associate incidents, and guest complaints while maintaining confidentiality.

Deliver Exceptional Guest Service

  • Respond to guest questions, concerns, and game disputes with professionalism, fairness, and sound judgment.
  • Resolve routine issues promptly and escalate unusual or unresolved matters to Table Games Management.
  • Promote a fun, welcoming, and entertaining atmosphere while maintaining the integrity of every game.
  • Serve as a role model for professionalism, accountability, and outstanding service.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this position, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Education: High school diploma or GED required.
  • Experience: Minimum of two (2) years of Table Games experience required.
  • Game Knowledge and Skills: Demonstrated knowledge and ability to manage the games required for the assigned shift, including either:
    • Blackjack and Craps; or
    • Blackjack, Roulette, Pai Gow, and Baccarat.
  • Casino Operations: Working knowledge of casino rules, Table Games manuals, departmental policies, procedures, internal controls, and applicable gaming regulations.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to direct, coach, train, and support team members.
  • Guest Service: Strong guest service skills and the ability to professionally handle guest concerns and game disputes.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with guests, associates, management, and other departments.
  • Mathematical Ability: Ability to perform quick and accurate calculations involving chips, wagers, payouts, winners, losers, and U.S. currency.
  • Computer Skills: Basic computer proficiency, including the ability to enter information into tracking systems and complete required documentation.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to observe game activity, review player data and documentation, identify irregularities, and apply established procedures consistently.
  • Judgment Under Pressure: Ability to remain calm, professional, and decisive when addressing disputes, operational challenges, or other stressful situations.

Additional Requirements and Work Environment

  • Ability to read and understand written instructions, policies, procedures, correspondence, and reports.
  • Ability to communicate information clearly in one-on-one and small-group settings.
  • Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, and solve routine operational problems.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and demonstrate the highest standards of integrity.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and move easily throughout the table games pit.
  • Ability to routinely push, pull, carry, and lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, reach, stoop, twist, grip chips and cards, and perform other physical activities associated with the position.
  • Ability to work in a busy casino environment with high noise levels and varying temperatures.
  • Willingness to work the assigned shift and support operational needs, including table openings and closings.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Supervisory Responsibilities

The Table Games Supervisor directly supervises Table Games Dealers and is responsible for directing daily work, assigning duties, supporting training and development, evaluating performance, recognizing strong performance, addressing conduct or performance concerns, and helping resolve associate complaints and operational issues in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Table Games Supervisor is a trusted and visible leader who:

  • Maintains accurate, fair, and secure gaming operations.
  • Builds a knowledgeable, accountable, and guest-focused team.
  • Applies gaming regulations and internal controls consistently.
  • Handles guest concerns and operational challenges with professionalism.
  • Sets the standard for integrity, communication, and teamwork.

Ready to Take the Lead?

Bring your Table Games experience, leadership skills, and commitment to exceptional guest service to a role where your decisions make a difference every day. Apply today to join our team and help deliver a gaming experience built on integrity, professionalism, and outstanding hospitality.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

  • Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations.
  • Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary.

  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage.
  • Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones.
  • Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities.

  • Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus.

Benefits

  • Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET).

title: Senior Network Engineer, Internet Edge, Google Global Infrastructure
description:
Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

The Internet Edge (IE) team, part of Global Network Edge (GNE), is the critical gateway connecting Google's services and Google Cloud customers to the rest of the world. We own the lifecycle of the technologies and products that power Google's edge domain: from conceptualizing and prototyping next-generation architectures to driving automated pilots, global rollouts, and eventual deprecation. We hold ourselves accountable for the holistic health, sublinear growth, and SLO compliance of the Internet Edge. As AI workloads surge globally, we are developing and deploying new edge products and specialized connectivity variants to support massive, third-party AI compute clusters and high-capacity peering integrations. To accomplish this at Google scale, we operate under a critical paradigm shift: writing the systems and SDN automation layers that safely modify and scale our edge network in deep partnership with Software Engineering, SRE, Deployment, and Operations.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

title: Spring 2027 Russia Program Internship
description:
Internship Opportunities

The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD) is a Washington, DC-based nonpartisan 501(c)(3) research institute focusing on national security and foreign policy. FDD conducts in-depth research, produces accurate and timely analyses, identifies illicit activities, and provides policy options – all with the aim of strengthening U.S. national security and reducing or eliminating threats posed by adversaries and enemies of the United States and other free nations. FDD does not accept donations from any foreign governments.

About FDD's Internship Program


The Foundation for Defense of Democracies offers a variety of internship opportunities designed to provide meaningful professional development. Interns participate in a twice-monthly speaker series featuring senior staff members in a small-group setting and are encouraged to strengthen their academic and analytical skills through close collaboration with FDD scholars and experts. The organization offers stipends and can assist students seeking academic credit; however, stipend eligibility requirements must be met. FDD provides both hybrid and remote internship options.


Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. It is recommended that interested candidates submit applications early. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

The Russia Research Program

The Russia Research Program is seeking full-time and part-time interns. Interns will work closely with Dr. Ivana Stradner, research fellow and advisor to FDD's Barish Center for Media Integrity, and John Hardie, deputy director of FDD's Russia Program, to conduct research on projects related to Russia. Projects will focus on topics including Russia's information operations, cybersecurity, international organizations, the Russian military, Russia's war in Ukraine, and Western economic warfare with Russia. Those with an interest in Russia and foreign policy are strongly encouraged to apply. FDD is looking for interns with research experience and strong writing skills. The ability to conduct research in a foreign language - particularly Russian or Ukrainian - is a plus but not required.


Eligibility

  • Must have at least a 3.2 GPA (on a 4.0 scale).
  • Should have a relevant course of study and have completed coursework in any of the following fields: International Relations, Security Studies, History, Communications, Journalism, International Economics, Political Science. Computer science, and/or a relevant STEM field of study.
  • Interns should have knowledge of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, as well as basic Excel skills.
  • Must be able to commit to a minimum of 22 hours per week.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States.


Application Materials Required

  1. Resume/CV
  2. Cover letter (Please review our website and include which FDD projects and issue areas resonate with you and why. Also indicate where you found this internship and your availability for the semester.)
  3. Writing Sample (no more than 3 pages)
  4. Unofficial transcript copy

Please specify the department(s) for which you would like to be considered (feel free to indicate preferences) in your cover letter. While you may use the same cover letter for multiple positions, please submit a separate application for each position of interest.

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Robot Software Engineer Intern — Spring & Summer 2027
description:
Simbe is looking for a Robot Software Engineer Intern to join the team building the software that powers Tally, our autonomous mobile robot operating in live retail environments.

As an intern, you’ll work alongside our Robot Software Engineering team and contribute to a meaningful project tied to the team’s active priorities. Your specific project will be selected by your hiring manager closer to your start date so that your work directly supports what the team is building at that time.

Depending on current priorities and your background & interests, your work may touch areas such as autonomy and navigation, perception, hardware integration and drivers, ROS tooling, or other areas of our software stack.

Why This Internship Is High Impact

  • Work on real robots. Contribute to the software and systems behind Tally robots operating every day in live retail environments.

  • Learn production robotics. Gain hands-on experience with C++, Python, Linux, ROS/ROS2, testing, debugging, hardware integration, and engineering workflows.

  • Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

  • Own a defined project. You’ll be given clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

  • Learn from experienced roboticists. You’ll work directly with Simbe engineers and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.

  • See the full robotics system. Gain exposure to how autonomy, perception, hardware, cloud systems, and field operations come together in a production robot fleet.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Robot Software team’s priorities during your internship.

  • Design, implement, test, debug, and document software primarily in C++ and Python.

  • Work within a Linux development environment and use ROS/ROS2 tools and concepts.

  • Contribute to areas such as autonomy, navigation, perception support, hardware drivers, testing/evaluation, or developer infrastructure depending on current team needs.

  • Debug software and hardware/software integration issues using logs, telemetry, testing tools, and hands-on investigation.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Robot Software, Hardware, Perception, and other technical teams.

  • Communicate progress, technical decisions, challenges, and results throughout the internship.

  • Present your project, approach, results, and key learnings at the end of the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • We primarily target undergraduate students in their junior or senior year, as well as students currently pursuing a master’s degree.

  • Strong programming fundamentals in C++ and/or Python.

  • Comfortable working in a Linux environment.

  • Familiarity with ROS or ROS2 and core concepts such as nodes, topics, messages, services, parameters, and launch systems.

  • Basic familiarity with Git or another source-control system.

  • Strong technical problem-solving and debugging skills.

  • Ability to learn quickly and take ownership of an unfamiliar technical problem.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Personal robotics, programming, or open-source projects outside of coursework.

  • Previous robotics, software engineering, embedded systems, or related internship experience.

  • Experience with autonomous navigation, localization, SLAM, perception, motion planning, controls, or human-robot interaction.

  • Experience integrating sensors, motors, embedded devices, or other hardware with software.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, Docker, build systems, or developer tooling.

  • Experience participating in robotics clubs, research labs, competitions, or hands-on engineering teams.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding and automation tools as part of software development, debugging, or engineering workflows, with good judgment around validating generated output.

Internship Program Structure

Interns join Simbe as part of a structured cohort and work full time from our Burlingame, California headquarters.

Each intern will have:

  • A defined technical project aligned with current team priorities

  • A hiring manager responsible for project scope, performance, and feedback

  • A dedicated mentor separate from the hiring manager

  • Structured midpoint feedback

  • Regular opportunities to collaborate with and learn from Simbe engineers

  • A final project presentation at the end of the internship

We do not believe in creating busywork for interns. Your project will be selected closer to your start date based on active team priorities so that you can contribute to meaningful work alongside our full-time engineering team.

About Simbe

Simbe is building the AI-powered operating system for physical retail. Our autonomous robots and multimodal computer vision platform turn complex, constantly changing stores into accurate, actionable intelligence for leading retailers around the world. Simbe combines robotics, computer vision, machine learning, data infrastructure, and customer-focused product design to help retailers improve shelf availability, price and promo execution, inventory accuracy, and store team productivity.

Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. L.

Result Driven — We are customer-centric and results-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors.

Empathetic — We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally.

Transparent — We value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.

Agile — We are eager to learn and adapt quickly to changes and customer needs.

Innovative — We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design, user experience, and customer value.

Leaders — We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

title: Inventory Control Coordinator
description:
For more than 60 years, Tyndale has helped readers discover the life-giving truths of God’s Word. Today we’re one of the largest independently owned Christian publishers in the world. Though our business has grown, our mission remains the same: to open God’s Word to as many as possible in language they can relate to and understand.


Every Bible and book we ship depends on the right inventory being in the right place at the right time. As our Inventory Control Coordinator, you’ll keep item and location data accurate and inventory moving so orders can be released, picked, and delivered to readers on schedule.


You’ll join a small, two-person Inventory Control team that works hand in hand with Distribution, Sales, Customer Service, and Production, often face to face on the warehouse floor. This is a newly created role, and we provide hands-on training, so we value a quick learner who brings a fresh perspective as much as someone who knows our systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Keep orders flowing: Analyze inventory levels and order demand, enter skid move transactions, stage backorder pick locations, and process backorder releases so high-volume retail and customer orders ship on time.
  • Protect data accuracy: Maintain item and location data, including scheduled price changes, rights restrictions, case quantities, holds, and reservations, so every record and every price that reaches the market is correct.
  • Resolve inventory discrepancies: Research variances and transaction issues, coordinate cycle counts with Distribution, and process documented adjustments that restore accurate records.
  • Manage product transitions: Execute monthly status and phase changes, repackage releases, product exits, and set and bill of materials setup so products move cleanly through their life cycle.
  • Coordinate across teams: Serve as a go-to inventory contact for Sales Operations, Customer Service, Production, Distribution, and Returns, responding to requests by email, phone, and in person.
  • Support receiving, freight, and returns: Process inbound freight and printer pre-shipment invoices, maintain receiving records, and partner with Distribution so only sellable units return to stock.

Skills and Qualifications Needed

  • Associate degree in supply chain management, business, operations, accounting, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 2+ years in inventory control, inventory analysis, distribution, warehouse operations, supply chain, or a related function
  • Working knowledge of cycle counting, backorder management, receiving, returns, item master maintenance, and warehouse location controls
  • Proficiency with JD Edwards (JDE) or a comparable ERP system
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including exporting, sorting, filtering, and using formulas to analyze and reconcile data
  • Sound judgment and analytical problem-solving for situations that don’t come with a playbook
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
  • A sense of urgency and the ability to prioritize competing, time-sensitive requests through to resolution
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with comfort working face to face across departments
  • Dependable attendance and the flexibility to start early or stay late when order volume requires it
  • Ability to learn product information and collaboration tools, including SharePoint
  • Personal alignment with and adherence to the Bible as God’s Word, and agreement with our Statement of Faith

This is a full-time, on-site position at our Carol Stream, IL office.


We want to hear more about you and why you are interested in Tyndale and this role, so we highly recommend including a cover letter.


Tyndale has been repeatedly certified as a Best Christian Workplace. Learn more about us and what we believe at www.tyndale.com/our-mission.


The hiring range for this position is $21 to $25 hourly. Actual offers will take into consideration the candidate’s education, experience, industry knowledge, technical skills, and other relevant factors. A summary of Tyndale’s comprehensive benefits is: https://www.tyndale.com/careers/.
