title: USMC Budget Execution Specialist (Future Opportunity)
description:
Redwood Strategy Group (RSG) is a minority owned, Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) founded on over 17 years of thought-to-action leadership supporting military departments, Department of Defense, and agencies across the U.S. Federal Government with transformation, strategy, and operations. At RSG, we are committed to our company foundation - our employees. The minute you start working here, you become an integral part of our team, our future, and you will play a key role in the continued growth of our company.

Innovative Solutions. Cultivated Talent. Accelerative Success.

The successful candidate will support current and prior year Marine Corps budget execution through detailed transaction analysis, funds monitoring, and reconciliation. Transform financial system data into accurate status reports and proactively identify discrepancies requiring correction or leadership action. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to support sound financial decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Track commitments, obligations, and expenditures by fiscal year, appropriation, program, and other management reporting categories.

  • Reconcile PBIS budget data with DAI execution monthly; review HQMC budget controls by Program Element and Budget Line Item each week and identify discrepancies.

  • Analyze financial hierarchies, DAI project and task structures, and funds distribution mappings to identify coding or reporting inconsistencies.

  • Review spending errors, abnormal balances, and prior year account activity; research causes, document findings, and recommend corrections.

  • Prepare status of funds reports, variance analyses, cost estimates, and leadership briefing inputs using DAI reports, OBIEE/OAS outputs, Excel, and ADVANA data.

  • Support preparation of the monthly draft AR(M) 1002 reconciliation against PBIS and DAI, retaining workpapers and explanations for unresolved differences.

  • Support midyear review and annual closeout analysis to identify underexecution, overexecution, excess funds, and reporting risks; coordinate follow-up with HQMC and field stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant field and at least six years supporting Federal financial management.

  • Advanced expertise in Marine Corps financial systems coding, data structures and standardization, USSGL posting logic, and technical closeout processes and their accounting effects.

  • In-depth knowledge of PBIS, DAI, ADVANA, and WYPC or its successor, including how budget controls and execution data relate across systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to reconcile budget and accounting data, research transaction errors, and analyze current and prior year execution.

  • Advanced Excel, Power BI, Power Query, and data analysis skills; ability to prepare financial requirements analyses, cost estimates, and status reports. Relevant certifications as proposed for the position.

Work location & Access

Must be physically stationed within 50 miles of the Pentagon and available for onsite support.
Must meet Government background investigation, CAC, and system access requirements.

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Summary: Oversee and develop culturally competent, comprehensive, and high-quality services for people living with HIV/AIDS (PLWHA) as part of our Ryan White Supportive Services program. Maintain program standards for regulatory compliance and consumer satisfaction. Ensure that program goals and objectives are achieved. Responsible for staff supervision, quality assurance and coordination of services.

Adapt and tailor as applicable to designated target population(s). Ensure that the Transtheoretical Model of Behavior Change is incorporated, as applicable, into all aspects of programming.

  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities with attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of best practices as applicable to assigned programs and services.
  • Ability to assess and evaluate community trends and recommend adaptation to service delivery. Receptiveness to community feedback and input.
  • Ability to build and support team rapport.
  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries within agency and grant guidelines, as well as with clients and external service providers.
  • Bilingual a plus

title: IT Specialist
description:

This role is responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, managing hardware and software installations, maintaining network security, and ensuring employees have the tools and support needed to work efficiently.

• Respond to help desk tickets, prioritize requests, and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.

• Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining computers, printers, software, and peripheral devices.

• Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritize tasks, and meet service expectations.

title: Laser Operator- Night
location: TRITON METAL PRODUCTS INC., Hamilton, IN, US

title: Data Scientist
description:
ERAKULIS® is an all-in-one wellness experience for Fitness, Nutrition and Mental Balance, founded by Cristiano Ronaldo. Taking care of physical and mental health is essential for a fulfilling life, and we are here to support individuals every step of the way. Behind your customized plan, we have a team of certified experts who will take the time to listen to your story, understand your aspirations, and craft a tailored wellness experience plan that aligns with your goals and lifestyle. Erakulis is present in every corner of the world and our goal is to become a renowned leader in the wellness industry on a global scale.

Were looking for a Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of health tech and advanced analytics. You will help us unlock insights from user behavior, personalize fitness and nutrition journeys, and support the development of our AI wellness assistant. You will work closely with product, and engineering to turn data into action.﻿

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement data models to power personalized recommendations in fitness, nutrition, and mental health.

  • Analyze user engagement data to uncover behavioral trends and retention drivers.

  • Develop and evaluate machine learning models for wellness insights, predictive health outcomes, and segmentation.

  • Collaborate with backend (Golang), mobile (iOS/Android), and web (React/TypeScript) teams to deploy data pipelines and ML features.

  • Support the virtual agent (AI assistant) with NLP-driven insights and contextual understanding from user data.

  • Define and monitor key product metrics, A/B test outcomes, and experiment success.

  • Contribute to the development of internal data tools and dashboards for the team.

What We're Looking For

  • 25 years of experience in data science, preferably in health tech, consumer apps, or wellness platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python (Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch), SQL, and data visualization (e.g. Plotly, Dash, or similar).

  • Experience with NLP, recommender systems, or time-series modeling.

  • Familiarity with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and cloud environments (AWS preferred).

  • Strong communication skills and a product-oriented mindset.

  • A passion for fitness, nutrition, or mental wellness is a big plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with wearable data (e.g. Fitbit, Apple Health).

  • Understanding of gamification mechanics in digital products.

  • Knowledge of Open Food Facts or similar nutrition databases.

  • Familiarity with LLMs or embedding-based search (e.g. SentenceTransformers, GPT).

  • Timezone from GMT-1 to GMT+4.

Why Join Us?

  • Build AI that positively impacts health and daily habits.

  • Remote-first work environment with flexible hours.

  • High ownership: influence product decisions and technical direction

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

  • Dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Access to company wellness programs and other resources.

title: Regional Field Manager, Idaho
description:
Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way.
Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community.

As a Regional Field Manager (internally referred to as a Grassroots Engagement Director) you will identify, recruit, and engage grassroots leaders in Idaho, mobilize them to take action, and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all.

How You Will Contribute

  • Identify activists in various parts of the state who are currently - or could become - leaders in their local communities, and motivate them to advocate for change
  • Equip these local leaders to advocate for changes that are consistent with principles AFP believes in. You will do this, in part, by connecting them to the training and other resources of AFP
  • Organize events where you and other activists can engage the public through phone calls, social media, walking through neighborhoods to talk with people face-to-face. You'll also be free to innovate by creating fun or unique ways to reach people to educate them on public policy issues and initiatives
  • Ensure that AFP stays in regular contact with our activists to keep them motivated, educated, and active
  • Manage part-time canvassing contractors, including but not limited to, time management, compliance with laws and regulations, and best practices

What You Will Bring

  • Passion for people, ability to build relationships quickly with people from all walks of life, and understand how to inspire and motivate them
  • Knowledge of state and federal public policy landscapes
  • Self-motivation, always looking for the best way to use your time to accomplish objectives
  • Organization skills and the ability to keep multiple events and activities on track for yourself and the people you engage to help you
  • Works well with a team of people, including AFP staff and activists
  • Excitement to canvass neighborhoods and make phone calls for AFP priority initiatives and AFP action endorsed candidates, as well as motivate and coordinate volunteers to do the same
  • A valid driver's license to be able to travel to meet with people in your area and across the state, as needed
  • Willingness to work a flexible and changing work schedule, including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Integrity, humility, and an entrepreneurial attitude.
  • Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect

Standout Candidates Will Bring

  • Experience in grassroots advocacy, community organizing, and/or political campaigns
  • Volunteer or staff supervisory experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace.
  • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,400 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges.
  • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents.
  • Competitive compensation: Our approach rewards the value you create through competitive salaries and bonus opportunities, allowing you to share in the success you help drive.
Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: Sr. Scientist/Engineer - Process Microbiology
description:
Celltrion is a leading biopharmaceutical company specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of innovative therapeutics. We are committed to delivering innovative and affordable medications that expand patient access to advanced therapies. Celltrion has been at the forefront of biotherapeutic development, uncovering new ways to target the drivers of disease through next-generation biologics and small-molecule products.

Celltrion Branchburg, LLC is a subsidiary of Celltrion USA, established in 2025 following Celltrion USA’s acquisition of Eli Lilly’s drug substance manufacturing facility in Branchburg, New Jersey. By combining strong local manufacturing capabilities with an established direct-sales network, we aim to create greater synergies across our operations. Looking ahead, we also anticipate expanding into the global contract manufacturing organization sector.

Position Brand Description:

This position is responsible for process microbiological support for biotechnology manufacturing processes, overseeing a robust Product Protection Control Strategy against Adventitious Agents in a cGMP environment, and building the organization’s knowledge of aseptic manufacturing operations. This role partners with Operations, QC Microbiology, Engineering, other TS/MS Scientists, and Quality on risk-based assessments, testing strategies and troubleshooting.


Key Objectives/Deliverables:


Manage for Results /Strategic Planning:

Floor Support

1. Monitors (trends) in-process microbiological data and presents analyses in Manufacturing Process Team meetings.

2. Provide on-the-floor microbiological support for manufacturing processes including generation and maintenance of manufacturing support documentation (e.g. SOPs, trend analyses, evaluation protocols)

3. Assist/Lead deviation investigations. Troubleshoot suspected microbiological contamination incidents.

4. Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to implement equipment, procedure and/or automation improvements to mitigate identified microbiological risk points.

5. Provide microbiology guidance on facility and process-related controls and changes.

Product Protection Control Strategy Oversight

6. Oversee process contamination prevention and control according to Product Protection


Control Strategy.

7. Develop in-process microbiological acceptance criteria, sampling requirements, summations,

procedures, and reports. Collaborate with QC Microbiology on specifications and microbiological control strategy.

8. Serve as subject matter expert for evaluation and mitigation of microbiological trends.


Technology Transfer & Cross-Functional Support

9. Support microbiological requirements for in-process hold time studies as well as small-scale studies to support hold time, resin cleaning, and other process validation activities.

10. Collaborate with Validation Technical Services on microbiological requirements for cleaning/SIP validation and facility/equipment qualification.

11. Collaborate with Quality Control in the development and execution of the facility-based environmental monitoring and clean utilities microbiology programs for the site.


External Interface

12. Build deep technical expertise in the area of responsibility.

Basic Requirements:

1. Knowledge of aseptic manufacturing operations.

2. Strong investigational skill, working knowledge of microbiology assay development and validation.

3. Demonstrated strong data-driven decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.

4. Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills in cross-functional teamwork environment.

5. Demonstrated strong communication skills, both oral and written. Technical writing including position papers, validation reports, and microbiological investigations.

6. Demonstrated ability to participate in and facilitate decision-making.

Education Requirements:

1. B.S. in Microbiology or related science/engineering with a minimum of 0-7 years' experience in a cGMP

biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

2. Position is a banded position; education and years of experience in a cGMP biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical manufacturing and/or development environment will be considered for initial placement within the band.


This role is exempt and the anticipated compensation for this role is $87,000 - $150,000.

This is a banded role, and candidates will be placed within the range based on experience, skills, internal equity, and market considerations.


Celltrion Branchburg, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off (holidays, vacation, and additional leave), medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, a company-matched retirement savings plan, wellness programs, and short- and long-term disability benefits. This role requires up to 10% travel, on-call availability, and may involve shift work. Hybrid work flexibility may be available based on business needs; relocation assistance is not provided.


Celltrion Branchburg, LLC is proud to be Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist based in United States.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

Accountabilities

  • IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications.
  • Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations.
  • Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary.
  • IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage.
  • Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones.
  • Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous.
  • Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your area of work, manage your tasks independently, and contribute directly to operational improvements.
  • Professional Development: Build practical cybersecurity experience through hands-on projects involving vulnerability research, endpoint hardening, incident response, and compliance.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and progress into a broader role as the team grows.
  • Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET).
  • Practical Security Experience: Develop your technical capabilities while working across IT administration, endpoint management, automation, and security operations.

title: Associate Director, Analytical Development and Quality Control
description:
At Kailera, we are bold, authentic and committed to our mission of developing therapies that give people the power to transform their lives and elevate their overall health. Rooted in an entrepreneurial spirit and a team-oriented culture, we are working together to advance Kailera’s mission to advance novel therapies for obesity and related conditions.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes collaboration, integrity, and excellence. As we expand, we seek the most talented individuals with diverse backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and experiences to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

The Associate Director, Analytical Development and Quality Control will support analytical development and QC operations for clinical development and commercialization of Kailera’s pipeline compounds. The individual will provide technical expertise and will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure end-to-end drug development and manufacturing activities are executed seamlessly and in alignment with the company’s integrated development plans and program timelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead analytical development and support QC activities related to the development and commercialization of peptide drug substances..
  • Develop and maintain current knowledge in analytical methods and product and process control strategies supporting the peptide drug substance.
  • Through our external network, lead the development of analytical methods that support Kailera’s product pipeline, including analytical transfers and troubleshooting in CDMO laboratories.
  • Provide input for developing and implementing analytical development strategies, including managing execution of functional activities in support of clinical development, regulatory filings (IND/NDA/MAA), product approvals, and commercialization.
  • Author relevant CMC sections to enable global regulatory filings.
  • Participate on cross-functional CMC teams for the project(s) assigned to ensure adequate development and execution of CMC plan/strategies as needed.
  • Communicate CMC project status to key stakeholders cross-functionally and assist in driving decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional line functions to ensure CMC and program goals are met.
  • Travel to CDMOs and other service providers as needed for vendor technology transfers and analytical activities oversight.

Required Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry with experience in late phase drug substance development, NDA submissions, PAI readiness, and commercial launch in accordance with global CMC regulatory filings (IND/NDA/MAA, etc.).
    • Or an advanced degree with 5+ years
  • Knowledge of peptide chemistry and strong understanding of peptide degradation pathways and impurity control strategy. Experience in the analytical support of drug substance PPQ/Process Validation.
  • Demonstrated analytical project leadership and cross-functional team participation.
  • Experience in setting commercial specifications.
  • Experience in authoring regulatory documents, including NDA experience
  • Knowledge and strong understanding of drug development activities with respect to cGMP, quality systems, global regulatory requirements, and USP, EP, JP, and CHP requirements.
  • Strong understanding of all applicable ICH guidelines.
  • Method validation experience.
  • Experience with oversight of the analytical activities at CDMOs and/or CTLs.
  • Sound problem-solving skills with technically driven decision-making ability.
  • Effective written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Innovative team-player with high energy for our dynamic company environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge and experience in analytical development of injectable products, and associated control strategies
  • Knowledge and experience in analytical development of small molecules and solid oral dosage forms.
  • Successful support of at least one NDA and commercial launch.
  • Synthetic peptide manufacturing knowledge.
  • Experience with statistics and applying statistics to analytical chemistry.
  • Regulatory Inspection experience.

Education:

  • A Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years or an advanced degree with 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Degree in Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or closely related field.

Additional Information:

  • This position requires some travel to domestic and international destinations.
  • In rare occasions, this position may require working in environments where there may be specific gowning or dress code requirements.

$155,000—$190,000 USD

title: Senior UX Designer (Contractor)
description:
What is Findem:

Findem is the AI platform for talent outcomes. Its Labeling Engine transforms billions of unstructured people data points into verified Success Signals — context about what drives success — and Relationship Signals — insight into how people are connected and where influence flows. Together, these give customers a competitive edge in hiring, executive search, mobility, learning, development and workforce planning. That’s why leaders rely on Findem to improve pipeline quality, reduce costs, and deliver faster, more consistent talent impact. Named one of America’s Most Innovative Companies, Findem is redefining how organizations turn people data into business advantage.

Why We Need You:

Findem is looking for a Senior UX Designer for a 6-month contract to help shape the experience of our AI-powered recruiting products. You’ll focus on the craft that makes software feel intuitive and complete: refining workflows, sharpening interactions, and bringing a cohesive, polished feel to products that customers use every day and that we put in front of prospects in demos.

As we scale our agent platform, you’ll design and ship new agentic patterns, defining how users direct, review, and collaborate with AI agents inside their daily workflows. You’ll also help define how our team uses AI tools in its own work, building an AI-native process that brings design and engineering closer together and shortens the path from idea to shipped experience.

As part of the Executive Search team, you’ll work daily with Product and Engineering and get in front of customers early. You’ll prototype with them, help win deals, and see your work through to production, so you can point to the deals and shipped features your designs made possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Leading-edge design for agentic and UX experiences across RRA, RaaS, and Exec Search.
  • Agent artifact design and experience — how multi-agent interactions and agent outputs are shaped, presented, and interacted with.
  • Early customer prototype UX and implementation (Exec Search exploratory work).
  • UX design and user workflows for RRA SaaS.
  • Committing UX code polish PRs (front-end polish only — no back-end code or API contracts).

Your Working Experience:

  • 5+ years designing and shipping digital products, with a portfolio of live, shipped experiences (not just concepts or handoff mocks).
  • Track record of moving quickly from idea to prototype in ambiguous, early-stage contexts.
  • Preferred: 0-to-1 or exploratory product work, ideally in SaaS or B2B.
  • Preferred: comfort collaborating directly in an engineering codebase and workflow (Git, PRs, design QA).
  • Portfolio and demonstrated ability weighted above formal credentials.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong UX and interaction design fundamentals: user journey mapping, information architecture, and turning complex workflows into simple, intuitive flows.
  • Proven design-systems experience — building and applying reusable components consistently across multiple surfaces.
  • Hands-on front-end proficiency: comfortable committing polish-level PRs in a modern stack (React/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, component libraries), including responsive behavior, empty/loading/error states, motion, and accessibility.
  • Ability to take work from idea to design to working prototype, reusing existing services and APIs rather than building them.
  • Preferred: experience designing for AI-native or agentic products — agent artifacts, streaming outputs, chat/canvas interfaces, human-in-the-loop review, and non-deterministic states.
We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Bilingual Clinician
description:
Overview

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit, nonsectarian human services organization founded in 1943. Today, it has grown to be the largest provider of licensed outpatient community behavioral health services and one of the largest human service agencies in Westchester County. WJCS delivers innovative programs and services and compassionate care to more than 20,000 people of all ages and backgrounds throughout the county.


We are currently seeking a bilingual (English/Spanish) Clinical Social Worker or Mental Health Counselor to join our team. In this role, you will provide trauma-informed mental health services to individuals through the DA’s office (located in White Plains, NY), as well as members of the community seeking care through a licensed mental health clinic. Services are provided to children, adolescents, adults, and families who have experienced a wide range of traumatic events, including child and elder abuse, sexual and physical assault, domestic violence, homicide-related loss, and other forms of victimization.


Training, supervision, and ongoing professional development in providing trauma-informed intervention services for children and adults is provided by the agency.


The salary range for this full-time position is $75,000 - $85,000, determined by licensure.


Responsibilities

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide trauma-informed treatment in various modalities, including individual, family, and group therapy for ongoing treatment cases.
  • Provide trauma therapy, supportive counseling, criminal justice support and other related follow-up services to crime victims.
  • Deliver services in-person, via telehealth, and by telephone.
  • Maintain a small caseload of clients who have experienced other types of non-crime trauma, including individuals affected by COVID and racial injustice, and those who are from the LGBT and undocumented communities.
  • Accompany victims to court when requested.
  • Develop Victim Impact Statements with clients.
  • Advocate on behalf of victims with healthcare providers, community organizations, schools, courts, and other service systems.
  • Research and provide information and referrals to victims.
  • Conduct comprehensive intake assessment and develop written treatment plan with the client (collaborative documentation).
  • Monitor and update the treatment plan and work with client to fulfill the goals of the treatment plan.
  • Complete clinical documentation, treatment plans, progress notes, and agency reports accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Learn, understand, and use evidence-based practice techniques.
  • Provide crisis intervention as needed.
  • Meet or exceed monthly productivity requirements.
  • Maintain necessary patient related contacts with other agencies and resources (courts, schools, etc.), via phone, correspondence or in-person visits.
  • Professionally represent the agency at community meetings and in the media.
  • Attend agency in-service trainings and staff meetings; receive supervision.
  • Consult with other members of the interdisciplinary team in a professional and collegial manner.


Requirements

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Social Work from an accredited school of social work, or Masters in Mental Health Counseling.
  • Possession of license to practice in New York State (LMSW or LCSW, or LMHC) issued by the New York State Education Department.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish, with strong verbal and in written communication skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal relationship skills; ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Familiarity with the criminal justice system and victim services.
  • Three-five years of experience counseling victims of crime, preferred.
  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and principles and clinical best practices.
  • Knowledge of/skill with at least one evidence-based practice for treating adults and one for children.
  • Ability to use time effectively in order to meet or exceed monthly productivity requirements.
  • Knowledge of community resources and referral systems.
  • Ability to conduct interviews to obtain social and medical information necessary to perform diagnostic evaluation.
  • Ability to observe for the purpose of analysis and treatment.


What WJCS has to offer you

In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • Generous paid time off
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
  • 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
  • Ongoing Professional Development and Training
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
  • Disability and life insurance
  • Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives

title: Product Manager
description:
At Staritas, we help healthcare organizations make every choice clear. We're looking for a Product Manager to drive the strategy and development of innovative analytics, AI-enabled, and decision-support solutions that help healthcare organizations turn complex data into actionable insights. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and product innovation, partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to solve meaningful challenges and deliver measurable value.

Technical Skills

What We Offer

The role also requires the ability to occasionally move throughout a workspace to access files, office equipment, and work-related materials. Effective communication, both written and verbal, is essential for interacting with employees, clients, and stakeholders.

Staritas posts compensation ranges and benefits for all open roles. The base compensation range for this position is $175,000 - $185,000 annually, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Compensation offered will depend on factors including experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plans with company contributions; paid time off and company holidays; paid parental and family leave; and access to employee assistance and wellness resources. Additional benefits include life and disability insurance, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements.

title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Greece.

Join a distributed technology team dedicated to delivering reliable IT operations and strengthening cybersecurity for organisations that handle sensitive data. In this remote, hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day IT administration, support users, and maintain secure digital environments for multiple clients. You will work with modern cloud productivity platforms, endpoint management tools, and automation technologies to ensure systems remain secure, compliant, and operational. Beyond routine IT support, you will contribute to security initiatives involving vulnerability research, device hardening, and incident response documentation. This position offers an opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise while taking ownership of operational responsibilities. You will thrive in an autonomous, asynchronous working environment that values reliability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.

Accountabilities

  • IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications.
  • Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations.
  • Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary.
  • IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
  • Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role.
  • Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage.
  • Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones.
  • Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous.
  • Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your area of work, manage your tasks independently, and contribute directly to operational improvements.
  • Professional Development: Build practical cybersecurity experience through hands-on projects involving vulnerability research, endpoint hardening, incident response, and compliance.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and progress into a broader role as the team grows.
  • Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET).
  • Practical Security Experience: Develop your technical capabilities while working across IT administration, endpoint management, automation, and security operations.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). description:
At Flagler Technologies, Pre-Sales Engineers are trusted technical advisors and architects who shape strategy, influence outcomes, and own solutions end-to-end. We’re expanding our engineering team and looking for high-caliber PreSales Engineers who have a track record of Enterprise IT sales, technical depth, and customer trust. If you thrive in complex environments, enjoy designing real-world solutions, and want to work alongside our experienced sales team, this role is built for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership & Customer Advisory:
    1. Experienced technical advisor to large enterprise customers across infrastructure, cloud, and data platforms.
    2. Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, business drivers, risk tolerance, and growth plans.
    3. Translate customer challenges into scalable, secure, and supportable architectures.
  • Solution Architecture & Design:
    1. Own solution design from concept through close
    2. Design solutions spanning data center, hybrid cloud, networking, security, backup/DR, and enterprise platforms.
    3. Evaluate tradeoffs across cost, performance, resilience, and operational complexity
  • Sales Partnership:
    1. Work with sales counterparts to drive technical strategy and influence deal outcomes
    2. Ability to challenge status-quo, when better solutions/architectures exist
    3. Help elevate technical conversations from product features to business outcomes
  • Proof of Concept & Technical Validation:
    1. Architect and execute Proofs of Concept that validate real customer workloads.
    2. Ensure technical wins translate cleanly into production-ready designs.
  • Engineering Culture & Collaboration:
    1. Collaborate with internal engineering, services, and leadership teams to ensure seamless handoffs and successful implementations.
    2. Share knowledge, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to raising the technical bar across the organization.
  • What We Are Looking For
  1. Proven experience in Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Consulting within an IT VAR, OEM, integrator, or enterprise environment.
  2. Strong hands-on knowledge across:
    • Data center infrastructure (compute, storage, virtualization)
    • Networking and security
    • Cloud and hybrid architectures
    • Backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity
  3. Ability to explain complex technical designs in a clear and business-relevant way
  4. Real-world experience/Vendor certifications (Nutanix, Dell, Cisco, cloud platforms, etc.) are a plus


Why Join Us?

• Opportunity to shape complex enterprise solutions from discovery through implementation.

• Work alongside experienced sales and engineering teams.

• Collaborative engineering culture that values technical leadership and continuous improvement.

Network Optimization Manager

Position Overview

This position plays a vital role in: (1) designing, deploying, and maintaining Network Optimization Models, (2) developing tools and processes to assess long-range distribution capacity and mitigation plans, and (3) performing analysis and business case development of capital investment and divestment opportunities.

The Network Optimization Manager has extensive experience in supply chain design and optimization and can synthesize insights from complex, system-based evaluations. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining core tools and processes that enable multi-year, strategic planning across the US. Additionally, this role will oversee multiple large-scale, complex initiatives and provide coaching and mentoring to other specialists through their daily work. This role will also assess transportation outsourcing vs. within-fleet capacity determinations.

By leading network optimization projects and utilizing advanced tools and data analytics, this role will drive significant improvements in logistics operations, collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution, and leverage solutions to streamline distribution center processes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Network Optimization and Modeling

  • Design, deploy, and maintain network optimization models to identify investment and divestment opportunities
  • Establish and execute processes to assess system capacity/capability to support multi-year growth targets
  • Lead network optimization projects using advanced modeling tools to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of logistics operations

Data Analysis and Strategic Planning

  • Identify interdependencies of model outcomes, synthesize insights, and make recommendations on which opportunities to prioritize
  • Build business cases to inform strategic decisions and investments in supply chain improvements, deliver structured communications (both written and verbal)

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree required, Master’s Degree preferred, in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, or Mathematics
  • Three (3) years of experience specifically in Network optimization tools such as Llamasoft, O9, Kinaxis
  • Six (6) years of experience in analytics and visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Alteryx, and SQL
  • Deep understanding of supply chain metrics, manufacturing, production network optimization, transportation, demand planning, or other areas related to Logistics and Supply Chain

Technical Skills

  • Experience with routing optimization software such as SAP TM, Direct Route, Aptean, Route4Me, Descartes
  • Geographical Information Systems (GIS) such as ARCGIS, knowledge for spatial data analysis using telematics data
  • Statistical analysis skills for identifying patterns and anomalies in delivery data
  • Programming abilities in Python or R, SQL, Tableau Prep/Power BI for custom analysis and solutions, ideally within the network optimization space

As one of the oldest and finest clubs in the south, we know that a great experience starts with great people. We have a tradition of excellence not only with club history but also with our team members. Our work environment is fast-paced, collaborative, flexible, and mission-oriented. title: GBV Advocate
description:
OVERVIEW:


Provide culturally responsive support, advocacy, referral, and assistance to survivors of color who have experienced domestic violence, sexual assault, or commercial sexual exploitation. This position is responsible for crisis intervention, safety planning, outreach and education, and planning and facilitating weekly support group sessions for survivors. The Advocate works collaboratively with other domestic violence, sexual assault, and community agencies to ensure seamless response to survivors’ needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Provide support, advocacy, referrals, case management, crisis intervention, and safety planning services to survivors.
  • Assist survivors with accessing emergency assistance, legal and immigration support, and other community services.
  • Conduct community outreach and education and facilitate weekly support-group sessions.
  • Maintain accurate participant documentation and complete required reports and paperwork to meet contract requirements.
  • Maintain survivor confidentiality and collaborate with community providers to ensure a seamless response to survivors’ needs.


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Survivor Advocacy & Support

  • Provide support, advocacy, referrals, and case management services to domestic violence and sexual assault survivors.
  • Work with survivors to create, implement, monitor, and update individual safety plans.
  • Assist survivors in emergency situations with obtaining shelter, financial assistance, and other basic needs.
  • Assist survivors with accessing legal and immigration services, including referrals for U visas, T visas, and VAWA self-petitions.
  • Connect survivors with job training, counseling, housing, medical services, and other community resources.
  • Set up appointments and provide transportation to and from appointments as needed.

Outreach & Collaboration

  • Conduct domestic violence and sexual assault community outreach and education.
  • Recruit participants and work with program staff to facilitate weekly support-group sessions.
  • Work with legal providers to help survivors navigate multiple systems.
  • Network with community providers to help survivors access appropriate resources.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate participant files, progress notes, and data entry.
  • Submit timely monthly reports and paperwork to meet contract requirements.
  • Maintain survivor confidentiality in accordance with VAWA, FVPSA, VOCA, and agency policy.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Gender-Based Violence.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

EXPERIENCE: Minimum of two years of paid experience working with survivors of domestic violence. Experience working with culturally diverse populations, primarily African American and Hispanic women.


SPECIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Completion of 20 to 30 hours of training in domestic violence and sexual assault, with continuing education as required.
  • Knowledge of contributing factors related to gender-based violence among African American survivors and other survivors of color.
  • Knowledge of best practices for addressing survivors’ needs and supporting equitable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated advocacy skills and ability to navigate multiple systems to ensure seamless services.
  • Ability to navigate and handle complicated situations.
  • Ability to identify and understand the broader context of a situation.
  • Ability to exercise good judgment and take initiative.
  • Strong organizational and outreach skills.
  • Ability to respect others’ experiences, opinions, languages, values, cultures, and knowledge.
  • Ability to work effectively with communities of color and people from cultures different from one’s own.
  • Commitment to empowering families and survivors from diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working environment.
  • Ability to participate in continuing education related to advocacy-based domestic violence counseling for survivors and their children.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Work Hours: Between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm, Monday through Friday, with some evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to lift 30 pounds
  • Must pass a criminal background check prior to hire
  • Position requires driving whenever necessary to meet program needs, including travel between multiple work sites within a day. A valid Washington State driver’s license and proof of insurance is required upon employment.

title: Surveillance Operator
description:
Surveillance Operator | Be the Eyes Behind the Action!

Think like a detective. Stay one step ahead. Make a difference.

The action never stops—and neither does the opportunity to make an impact! As a Surveillance Operator, you’ll be at the center of casino security, using cutting-edge technology, sharp observation skills, and a keen eye for detail to help keep our guests safe, protect our assets, and ensure fair play throughout the property.

If you’re naturally curious, love solving problems, or have an interest in security and investigations, this could be your next big move!

🔎 What You’ll Do

  • Keep Your Eyes on the Action: Monitor advanced surveillance systems throughout the property and spot what others might miss.
  • Think Fast, Act Smart: Identify suspicious activity, recognize potential risks, and communicate concerns promptly.
  • Follow the Evidence: Review video footage, document findings, and prepare detailed reports for leadership and outside agencies when needed.
  • Learn the Game: Build your knowledge of table games and casino operations to recognize irregularities and protect game integrity.
  • Stay One Step Ahead: Help identify safety, security, and loss-prevention concerns before they escalate.
  • Work as a Team: Partner with the appropriate departments to support a safe, secure, and fair gaming environment.

⚡ Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Every Shift Is Different: Work in a dynamic environment where awareness, critical thinking, and quick decisions matter.
  • No Experience? No Problem! We provide hands-on training to help you build the knowledge and confidence to succeed.
  • Build Real-World Skills: Develop investigative thinking, analytical abilities, attention to detail, and professional reporting skills.
  • Get Behind the Scenes: See how casino operations work from a unique perspective that most people never experience.
  • Make an Impact: Play a vital role in protecting guests, employees, and the integrity of the entire property.

🕵️ What You Bring to the Team

  • A sharp eye for detail and strong observation skills.
  • The ability to stay focused, alert, and professional in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good judgment, critical-thinking skills, and a commitment to confidentiality.
  • An interest in security, investigations, surveillance, or loss prevention.
  • A high school diploma or GED.
  • A willingness to learn casino games, procedures, and surveillance technology.

Experience in security, law enforcement, military service, or investigations is a plus—but a strong attitude and willingness to learn go a long way!

🎥 What the Work Environment Is Like

You’ll work behind the scenes in a technology-driven surveillance setting while maintaining awareness of activity throughout the casino. The environment is fast-paced, detail-oriented, and built around teamwork, professionalism, and vigilance.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys staying engaged, analyzing situations, and knowing their work makes a real difference.

🎁 Perks & Benefits

We believe taking care of our team matters. Eligible employees can enjoy benefits and perks that support life at work and beyond, including:

  • On-site daycare 7 days a week with employee rates and possible subsidy.
  • 401(k) plan with 100% immediate vesting.
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance for full-time employees.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and holiday pay.
  • Tuition reimbursement for eligible employees.
  • Discounts on hotels, dining, spa services, and more.

🚀 Ready to Put Your Skills to Work?

If you’re observant, curious, dependable, and ready to take on a role where what you notice can make all the difference, we want to hear from you!

You don’t have to be a detective to think like one. Bring your focus, your instincts, and your willingness to learn—and discover what a career in casino surveillance can offer.

title: Technical Services Representative
description:
The Technical Services Representative profiles hazardous and non-hazardous waste and serves as the primary point of contact with disposal facilities, coordinating waste approvals, transportation logistics, and customer service. This role also supports Inside Sales, billing, and administrative functions for its assigned location(s), and reports to Technical Services management.

  • Ensure Health and Safety is the top priority by following all safety policies, processes, and practices.
  • Educate team members and customers on local, state, and federal regulations, including RCRA and TSCA, to support proper waste approval and disposal.
  • Review analytical and waste classification data for team members and customers.
  • Determine the proper Class I, II, and III landfills for hazardous waste disposal.
  • Interface with disposal facilities to schedule and finalize the waste approval process.
  • Administer and maintain waste profiles, job log tracking, manifests, labels, and land ban documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for client inquiries and service coordination, ensuring timely, professional communication with customers and internal teams.
  • Manage customer needs for hazardous and non-hazardous waste disposal, transportation, and environmental field services.
  • Provide inside sales and technical support for waste disposal, transportation, and environmental field services as needed for assigned location(s).
  • Support Industrial Sales Representatives in selling to customers, including assistance with proposal development, presentations, and sales materials.
  • Prepare quotes for transportation and disposal services.
  • Manage the logistics for the transportation of hazardous and non-hazardous waste shipments.
  • Coordinate service scheduling based on customer needs and operational capacity, communicating updates between field teams, operations, and clients.
  • Review, enter, and manage work orders within ERP (NetSuite) and EOS systems (WasteLinq), ensuring all necessary details are recorded and communicated to Operations and Finance for accurate service completion and billing.
  • Maintain accurate client, pricing, and job data across all systems to support data integrity, billing, and reporting accuracy.
  • Manage accounts payable and receivable for assigned location(s).
  • Reconcile completed job packets against the Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest, Bill of Lading (BOL), work orders, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing, verifying that waste quantities, profiles, disposal facilities, pricing, labor, transportation, and disposal charges match the executed work.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies with Operations, Field Personnel, Transportation, and Billing before a job is released for invoicing.
  • Support audit readiness by maintaining complete, accurate, and organized documentation across internal systems.
  • Assist in preparing customer reports, annual summaries, and Branch Revenue Reporting on a daily basis.
  • Complete job walks for waste lab packing and consolidation as needed.

Hourly pay range: $23.29-$37.19

title: Spring 2027 Economic and Financial Power Internship
description:
Internship Opportunities

The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD) is a Washington, DC-based nonpartisan 501(c)(3) research institute focusing on national security and foreign policy. FDD conducts in-depth research, produces accurate and timely analyses, identifies illicit activities, and provides policy options – all with the aim of strengthening U.S. national security and reducing or eliminating threats posed by adversaries and enemies of the United States and other free nations. FDD does not accept donations from any foreign governments.

About FDD's Internship Program


The Foundation for Defense of Democracies offers a variety of internship opportunities designed to provide meaningful professional development. Interns participate in a twice-monthly speaker series featuring senior staff members in a small-group setting and are encouraged to strengthen their academic and analytical skills through close collaboration with FDD scholars and experts. The organization offers stipends and can assist students seeking academic credit; however, stipend eligibility requirements must be met. FDD provides both hybrid and remote internship options.

It is recommended that interested candidates submit applications early. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

The Center on Economic and Financial Power

FDD's Center on Economic and Financial Power (CEFP) seeks a full-time or part-time intern. The intern will work closely with the CEFP team to provide research support for critical projects relating to U.S. economic security. Projects may include working on issues related to sanctions and economic statecraft, illicit finance, global corruption risks, supply chain dependencies, digital currencies, and positive economic power projection. CEFP is looking for candidates with research experience, strong writing skills, and an interest in the intersection of U.S. foreign, national security, and economic policy. For more background on CEFP, please visit

Please apply by midnight on Sunday, November 8, 2026 for your application to be considered. Applications submitted prior to November 8 will be reviewed on a rolling basis.


Eligibility

  • Must have at least a 3.2 GPA (on a 4.0 scale).
  • Should have a relevant course of study and have completed coursework in any of the following fields: International Relations, Security Studies, History, Communications, Journalism, International Economics, Political Science. Computer science, and/or a relevant STEM field of study.
  • Interns should have knowledge of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, as well as basic Excel skills.
  • Must be able to commit to a minimum of 22 hours per week.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States.


Application Materials Required

  1. Resume/CV

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Quality Senior Lead - External Manufacturing
description:
About Us:

Finlays Solutions is a leading partner to the B2B beverage manufacturing industry, recognized for its deep expertise, strong industry relationships, and commitment to innovation. The company plays a central role in supporting beverage brands, flavor houses, private label partners, and manufacturers through high-quality products, technical capabilities, and collaborative problem-solving. With a strong presence in the ready-to-drink beverage market, Finlays Solutions focuses on identifying emerging opportunities, expanding into new market spaces, and delivering solutions that meet evolving customer and consumer needs.


Finlays Solutions operates with a strong commitment to its mission, values, ethics, and long‑term goals, ensuring that every initiative reflects the company’s dedication to integrity, partnership, and sustainable success.

Job Summary:

The Senior Quality Lead – Co-manufacturing owns all quality systems, governance, and relationships associated with Finlays’ third‑party manufacturing network — including co‑manufacturers, co‑packers, warehouses, roasters, blenders, and other external partners. This role ensures that all co- manufacturing sites consistently meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and customer requirements, and that Finlays maintains a robust, standardized, and risk‑aware co-manufacturing program. This individual acts as both a hands‑on quality leader and a strategic system owner, capable of independently driving workstreams, building strong partner relationships, and creating structure in ambiguous or immature processes.

This position is hybrid, based out of the Glenview, IL office, with regular onsite presence required. Travel to co-manufacturing sites is required (approx. 30%).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and govern the quality and food safety management systems for all U.S.‑based third‑party manufacturing supporting Finlays Solutions.
  • Standardize quality expectations across all co‑manufacturers, and external partners, ensuring consistent application of Finlays’ requirements.
  • Create structure where processes are immature or ambiguous, establishing clear workflows, documentation, and governance.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Owner Relations & Asset Strategy

    • Serve as the key liaison between assigned owners and SHG's Operations, Commercial (revenue management, sales, and marketing), Accounting, Design & Construction, and IT teams, coordinating all needs for the owners' hotels as a single point of accountability.
    • Lead recurring owner performance calls and portfolio reviews, presenting results, drivers, and the operating plan to close gaps.
    • Consult with owners and their representatives on strategies to maximize hotel value, such as improving operating efficiency, recommending value-add capital projects, and capturing savings through procurement strategies.
    • Translate owner priorities into clear, actionable direction for regional and property leadership.
    • Track owner commitments and follow-up items through to resolution, protecting the relationship and SHG's management contracts.

    Performance Analysis & Reporting

    • Lead the weekly and monthly performance cadence for the assigned portfolio, directing the team to ensure flash results, forecast updates, and operations' P&L variance commentary are complete, accurate, and on time.
    • Proactively analyze hotel and portfolio results against budget, forecast, prior year, and market benchmarks to identify revenue, margin, and flow-through opportunities, bringing recommendations to owners and operations before they are requested.
    • Track market trends, supply and demand shifts, and competitive position using STR and CoStar data, including RevPAR index, ADR, and occupancy.
    • Prepare clear, accurate owner reporting packages and executive summaries on a fixed calendar.
    • Partner with Accounting and Business Intelligence to improve consistency, timeliness, and automation of performance reporting.

    Budgeting & Capital Planning

    • Serve as the finance owner of the annual operating and capital budgets for the assigned portfolio, partnering with Operations leadership to set the calendar, templates, and review standards.
    • Partner closely with commercial (sales and revenue management) and operations leaders, who provide the key budget inputs, pressure-testing revenue, labor, and expense assumptions and preparing teams to present budgets in owner reviews.
    • Monitor capital plans and renovation spending against approved budgets and timelines.

    Project Management & Operational Partnership

    • Lead cross-functional projects that improve hotel results, from revenue and cost initiatives to underperforming-hotel action plans, from scoping through measured outcome.
    • Participate in strategy and performance meetings with operations, revenue management, and sales to align commercial plans with profit goals.
    • Coordinate the financial and reporting workstreams of hotel onboardings, transitions, and owner-driven initiatives.
    • Continuously drive efficiency through automation, new technology, and the elimination of outdated, inefficient processes and practices, across both the team and the hotels it supports.

    Team Leadership

    • Lead, develop, and set priorities for a team of three analysts and managers, building a high-standard, deadline-driven culture.
    • Establish standard templates, review practices, and workflows that scale as the portfolio grows.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Hospitality Management, Business, or Real Estate; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in hotel asset management, hotel FP&A, multi-property operations finance, or lodging advisory.
  • Experience working directly with hotel owners, asset managers, or capital partners strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years of people leadership.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Deep command of hotel P&Ls under USALI, including flow-through, GOP, and labor productivity metrics.
  • Proficiency with ProfitSword for financial reporting and budgeting.
  • Working fluency with STR and CoStar benchmarking data.
  • Advanced Excel (financial modeling, scenario analysis, Power Query); Power BI experience preferred.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including presenting to owners and executives.
  • Sound judgment in reconciling owner expectations with operating realities.
  • Project management discipline, with consistent follow-through on deadlines and commitments.
  • Discretion with confidential owner and company information.

title: Product Operations Lead
description:

title: Construction Assistant w/CDL - MIDLAND, TX
description:
This position requires the ability to travel, regularly, outside of the Midland/Odessa area with assignments lasting multiple weeks at a time. Daily per diem and hotel accommodations are provided when traveling.

About the Role:

You will support construction projects through hands-on work in the field, equipment operation, and commercial driving. This position plays a critical role in the successful completion of corrosion control projects.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Valid Class A CDL with no restrictions and an acceptable driving record.
  • Basic knowledge of construction site safety practices and protocols.
  • Ability to perform physical labor, including lifting heavy materials.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to follow instructions accurately.
  • Ability to travel for multiple weeks at a time as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience as a construction assistant, equipment operator, or laborer.
  • Hydrovac and/or airvac experience is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with construction equipment and tools.
  • OSHA 10 certification or higher.
  • Basic mechanical skills.
  • Experience operating equipment (backhoe, trencher, mini-excavator, auger, and forklift).
  • Experience in the corrosion control industry.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate commercial vehicles safely.
  • Assist construction crews with loading and unloading materials, setting up equipment, and performing general labor tasks.
  • Conduct routine vehicle inspections and maintenance checks.
  • Follow all safety protocols and regulatory requirements related to vehicles operation and construction activities.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members to coordinate deliveries, schedules, and on-site support tasks.
  • Prepare construction site and clean up when job is completed.
  • Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, and compact and level earth to grade specifications, using picks, shovels, tampers, and rakes.
  • Other duties as needed.

Other Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to move safely over uneven terrain or in confined spaces, such as trenches, pits, and manholes
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push or pull objects up to 50 pounds regularly
  • Must be able to climb stairs, ramps and ladders regularly
  • Must be able to sit, stand, walk, or drive for long periods of time (1-3 hours).
  • Must be able to see, hear, and respond quickly to dangerous situations
  • Must be comfortable working outdoors, including in extreme weather conditions.
  • Must be comfortable around moving machinery, vehicles, and heavy equipment.
  • Must be comfortable wearing personal protective gear while working (safety glasses, steel-toed shoes, hard hat, gloves, safety vest, FRCs).
  • Ability to adhere to OSHA and site-specific PPE and safety requirements.

For over 40 years, ONEMESA has been providing solutions for corrosion control and rust mitigation across all sectors. Headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, ONEMESA encompasses multiple companies - MESA Products, MESA Services, BASS, and Hansen Drilling - each delivering specialized expertise and innovative solutions to meet our customers’ diverse needs. With regional offices across the country and an in-house team of project managers and engineers, ONEMESA is one of the top three providers of corrosion control solutions in the United States. Our commitment to delivering SAFE, innovative solutions for the protection of people, property, and the planet means we’re as invested in the solution as our customers.


Joining the ONEMESA team means you’ll have access to benefits designed to meet the needs of you and your family. We offer comprehensive medical benefits, including dental and vision. Our compensation package includes a company-matched 401(k), life insurance, competitive pay, annual salary reviews with a job progression plan, and a generous profit-sharing program.


Compensation Range: $25.00 - $30.50 per hour

The compensation range listed for this position represents ONEMESA's good-faith estimate of the pay range it reasonably expects to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and business needs. Eligible employees may participate in ONEMESA's profit-sharing program and benefit offerings; which includes health insurance, 401(k) with generous company match, paid time off, and other company-sponsored benefits.
